Amos 2:12-15: Vattashku et-hannezirim yayin veal-hanneviim tzivvitem lemor lo tinnavu
Hinne anochi meik tachtechem kaasher taik haagala hamelea lah amir
Veavad manos mikkal vechazak lo-yeammetz kocho vegibbor lo-yemallet nafsho
Vetofes hakkeshet lo yaamod vekal beraglav lo yemallet verochev hassus lo yemallet nafsho
Amos 2:16-3:4: Veammitz libbo baggibborim arom yanus bayyom-hahu neum-Adonai {p}
Shimu et-haddavar hazze asher dibber Adonai alechem bene yisrael al kol-hammishpacha asher heeleti meeretz mitzrayim lemor
Rak etchem yadati mikkol mishpechot haadama al-ken efkod alechem et kol-avonotechem
Hayishag arye bayyaar veteref en lo hayitten kefir kolo mimmeonato bilti im-lachad
Amos 2:6-11: Ko amar Adonai al-shelosha pishe yisrael veal-arbaa lo ashivennu al-michram bakkesef tzaddik veevyon baavur naalayim
Hashshoafim al-afar-eretz berosh dallim vederech anavim yattu veish veaviv yelchu el-hannaara lemaan challel et-shem kodshi
Veal-begadim chavulim yattu etzel kol-mizbeach veyen anushim yishtu bet elohehem
Veanochi hishmadti et-haemori mippenehem asher kegova arazim govho vechason hu kaallonim vaashmid piryo mimmaal veshorashav mittachat
Veanochi heeleti etchem meeretz mitzrayim vaolech etchem bammidbar arbaim shana lareshet et-eretz haemori
Vaakim mibbenechem linviim umibbachurechem linzirim haaf en-zot bene yisrael neum-Adonai
Amos 3:11-15: Lachen ko amar adonay Adonai tzar useviv haaretz vehorid mimmech uzzech venavozzu armenotayich
Ko amar Adonai kaasher yatztzil haroe mippi haari shete cheraayim o vedal-ozen ken yinnatzlu bene yisrael hayyoshvim beshomron bifat mitta uvidmeshek ares
Shimu vehaidu bevet yaakov neum-adonay Adonai elohe hatztzevaot
Ki beyom pokdi fishe-yisrael alav ufakadti al-mizbechot bet-el venigdeu karnot hammizbeach venaflu laaretz
Vehikketi vet-hachoref al-bet hakkayitz veavdu batte hashshen vesafu battim rabbim neum-Adonai {s}
Amos 3:5-10: Hatippol tzippor al-pach haaretz umokesh en lah hayaale-pach min-haadama velachod lo yilkod
Im-yittaka shofar beir veam lo yecheradu im-tihye raa beir vaAdonai lo asa
Ki lo yaase adonay Adonai davar ki im-gala sodo el-avadav hanneviim
Arye shaag mi lo yira adonay Adonai dibber mi lo yinnave
Hashemiu al-armenot beashdod veal-armenot beeretz mitzrayim veimru heasfu al-hare shomron ureu mehumot rabbot betochah vaashukim bekirbah
Velo-yadu asot-nechocha neum-Adonai haotzrim chamas vashod bearmenotehem {p}
Bava Kamma 94b:5-10: Tanu rabbanan: haggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru – en mekabbelin mehen. vehamekabbel mehen – en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu.

Amar rabbi yochanan: bime rabbi nishnet mishna zo. detanya: maase beadam echad shebbikkesh laasot teshuva, amra lo ishto: reka! im atta ose teshuva, afillu avnet eno shellecha! venimna velo asa teshuva. beotah shaa amru: haggazlanin umalve ribbiyyot shehechziru – en mekabbelin mehem, vehamekabbel mehem – en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu.
Metivi: hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit, af al pi shehen yodin shehen ribbit – en chayyayvin lehachezir. inhu hu dela, ha avihem chayyayv lehachezir.

Bedin hu daavihem name eno chayyayv lehachezir; veha dekatane bedidhu – mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa: "hinniach lahem avihem para vetallit vechol davar hamesuyyaym – chayyayvin lehachezir mippene kevod avihem", tena resha name bedidhu.
Umippene kevod avihem – chayyayvin lehachezir? ekre kan: "venasi veammecha lo taor" – beose maase ammecha?!
Kidamar rav pinchas: besheasa teshuva; hacha name, besheasa teshuva. i asa teshuva, may bae gabbeh? ibbei leh leahdore! shello hispik lehachezir ad shemmet.
Berakhot 54a:10-13: Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "vayyomer yitro baruch Adonai asher hitztzil vegomer".

Annissa derabbim mevarchinan, annissa deyachid la mevarchinan?! veha hahu gavra dahava ka azel baavar yammina. nefal aleh arya, itavid leh nissa veittatztzal minneh. ata lekammeh derava, vaamar leh: kol immat dematet lehatam — barech "baruch sheasa li nes bammakom hazze".
Umar bereh deravina hava kaazel befakta daaravot utzecha lemayya. itavid leh nissa, ibberi leh ena demayya, veishti.

Vetu, zimna chada hava kaazel berasteka demachoza unefal aleh gamla peritza. itparaka leh ashita, al legavva. ki meta laaravot barech: "baruch … sheasa li nes baaravot uvegamal". ki meta lerasteka demachoza barech: "baruch … sheasa li nes begamal uvaaravot"! amri: annissa derabbim — kulle alma michayyeyvi levaroche, annissa deyachid — ihu chayyayv levaroche.
Mishnah Keritot 1:1-2:
Sheloshim vashesh keretot battora. habba al haem, veal eshet haav, veal hakkalla, habba al hazzechur, veal habbehema, vehaishsha hamevia et habbehema aleha, habba al ishsha uvittah, veal eshet ish, habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda, hamegaddef, vehaoved avoda zara, vehannoten mizzaro lammolech, uvaal ov, hamechallel et hashshabbat, vetame sheachal et hakkodesh, vehabba lammikdash tame, haochel chelev, vedam, notar, ufiggul, hashshochet vehammaale bachutz, haochel chametz befesach, vehaochel vehaose melacha veyom hakkippurim, hamefattem et hashshemen, vehamefattem et hakketoret, vehassach beshemen hammishcha. happesach vehammila bemitzvot ase: 
Al ellu chayyavim al zedonam karet, veal shiggatam chattat, veal lo hoda shellahen asham taluy, chutz min hametamme mikdash vekadashav, mifne shehu veole veyored, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, af hamegaddef, shenneemar (Bamidbar 15), tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga, yatza megaddef, sheeno ose maase:
Mishnah Kilayim 4:2-5:
Eze hu mechol hakkerem. ben kerem laggader. im en sham shetem esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham. hayu sham shetem esre amma, notnin lo avodato vezorea et hammotar: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, en ze ella geder hakkerem. veeze hu mechol hakkerem. ben shene hakkeramim. eze hu gader, shehu gavoah asara tefachim. vecharitz, shehu amok asara verachav arbaa: 
Mechitztzat hakkanim, im en ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim, kede sheyyikkanes haggedi, hare zo chimchitztza. vegader shennifratz, ad eser ammot hare hu chefetach, yater mikken, keneged happirtza asur. nifretzu vo feratzot harebe, im haomed merubbe al happarutz, muttar, veim happarutz merubbe al haomed, keneged happirtza asur: 
Hannotea shura shel chamesh gefanim, bet shammay omrim, kerem. uvet hillel omrim, eno cherem, ad sheyyehu sham shete shurot. lefichach, hazzorea arba ammot shebbakkerem, bet shammay omrim, kiddesh shura achat. uvet hillel omrim, kiddesh shete shurot:
Mishnah Kilayim 4:6-9:
Hannotea shetayim keneged shetayim, veachat yotza zanav, hare ze cherem. shetayim keneged shetayim veachat bentayim, o shetayim keneged shetayim veachat baemtza, eno cherem, ad sheyyehu shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav: 
Hannotea shura achat betoch shello, veshura achat betoch shel chavero, vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim baemtza, vegader shehu namuch measara tefachim, hare ellu mitztarfot. gavoah measara tefachim, enan mitztarfot. rabbi yehuda omer, im ersan milmala, hare ellu mitztarfot: 
Hannotea shete shurot, im en benehen shemone ammot, lo yavi zera lesham. hayu shalosh, im en ben shura lachavertah shesh esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer mishshum chanina ven chachinay, afillu charva haemtzait veen ben shura lachavertah shesh esre amma, lo yavi zera lesham, sheillu mittechilla netaan hare ze muttar bishmone ammot: 
Hannotea et karmo al shesh esre amma shesh esre amma, muttar lehavi zera lesham. amar rabbi yehuda, maase vetzalmon, beechad shennata et karmo al shesh esre shesh esre amma, vehaya hofech sear shete shurot letzad echad vezorea et hannir, uveshana acheret haya hofech et hassear lemakom acher vezorea et habbur, uva maase lifne chachamim, vehittiru. rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim, af hannotea et karmo al shemone shemone ammot, muttar:
Mishnah Kilayim 5:1-4:
Kerem shecharav, im yesh bo lelakket eser gefanim levet sea, unetuot kehilchatan, hare ze nikra kerem dal. kerem shehu natua irbuveya, im yesh bo lechavven shetayim neged shalosh, hare ze cherem. veim lav, eno cherem. rabbi meir omer, hoil vehu nire chetavnit hakkeramim, hare ze charem: 
Kerem shehu natua al pachot pachot mearba ammot, rabbi shimon omer, eno cherem. vachachamim omrim, kerem, veroin et haemtzaiyyot keillu enan: 
Charitz shehu over bakkerem, amok asara verachav arbaa, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, im haya mefullash merosh hakkerem vead sofo, hare ze nire keven shene cheramim, vezorim betocho. veim lav, hare hu chegat. vehaggat shebbecherem amukka asara urechava arbaa, rabbi eliezer omer, zorim betochah, vachachamim osrim. shomera shebbakkerem, gevoha asara urechava arbaa, zorin betochah. veim haya sear kotesh, asur: 
Gefen shehi netua vegat o veneka, notnin lah avodatah, vezorea et hammotar. rabbi yose omer, im en sham arba ammot, lo yavi zera lesham. vehabbayit shebbakkerem, zorin betocho:
Mishnah Kilayim 5:5-6:1:
Hannotea yarak bakkerem o mekayyem, hare ze mekaddesh arbaim vachamishsha gefanim. ematay, bizman shehayu netuot al arba arba, o al chamesh chamesh. hayu netuot al shesh shesh, o al sheva sheva, hare ze mekaddesh shesh esre amma lechol ruach, agullot velo merubbaot: 
Haroe yarak bakkerem, veamar kesheaggia lo alakketennu, muttar. kesheechezor alakketennu, im hosif bematayim, asur: 
Haya over bakkerem venaflu mimmennu zeraim, o sheyyatzu im hazzevalim o im hammayim, hazzorea vesiarattu haruach laachorav, muttar. siarattu haruach lefanav, rabbi akiva omer, im asavim, yofach. veim aviv, yenappetz. veim hevia dagan, tiddalek: 
Hamekayyem kotzim bakkerem, rabbi eliezer omer, kiddesh. vachachamim omrim, lo kiddesh ella davar shekkamohu mekayyemin. hairus vehakkissom veshoshannat hammelech vechol mine zeraim, enan kilayim bakkarem. hakkanbos, rabbi tarfon omer, eno chilayim, vachachamim omrim, kilayim. vehakkinras, kilayim bakkarem: 
Ezehu aris, hannote shura shel chamesh gefanim betzad haggader shehu gavoah asara tefachim, o vetzad charitz shehu amok asara tefachim verachav arbaa, notnin lo avodato arba ammot. bet shammay omrim, moddin arba ammot meikkar haggefanim lassade. uvet hillel omrim, min haggader lassade. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, toim kol haomrim ken, ella im yesh sham arba ammot meikkar gefanim velaggader, notnin lo et avodato, vezorea et hammotar. vechamma hi avodat haggefen. shishsha tefachim lechol ruach. rabbi akiva omer, shelosha:
Mishnah Kilayim 6:2-5:
Aris shehu yotze min hammadrega, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, im omed baaretz uvotzer et kullo, hare ze oser arba ammot bassade, veim lav, eno oser ella chenegdo. rabbi eliezer omer, af hannotea achat baaretz veachat bammadrega, im gavoah min haaretz asara tefachim, enah mitztarefet immah, veim lav, hare zo mitztarefet immah: 
Hammadle et haggefen al miktzat appifyarot, lo yavi zera el tachat hammotar. im hevi, lo kiddesh. veim hillech hechadash, asur. vechen hammadle al miktzat ilan serak: 
Hammadle et haggefen al miktzat ilan maachol, muttar lehavi zera el tachat hammotar. veim hillech hechadash, yachazirennu. maase shehalach rabbi yehoshua etzel rabbi yishmael lichfar aziz, veherahu gefen mudle al miktzat teena. amar lo, ma ani lehavi zera el tachat hammotar. amar lo, muttar. veheelahu mishsham levet hammagniyya, veherahu gefen shehi muddele al miktzat hakkora, vesaddan shel shikma, uvo korot harebe. amar lo, tachat hakkora zo asur, vehashshear muttar: 
Ezehu ilan serak. kol sheeno ose ferot. rabbi meir omer, hakkol ilan serak, chutz min hazzayit vehatteena. rabbi yose omer, kol sheen kamohu notin sadot shelemot, hare ze ilan serak:
Mishnah Kilayim 6:6-9:
Piske aris, shemone ammot vaod. vechol middot sheamru chachamim bakkerem, en bahem vaod, chutz mippiske aris. elu hen piske aris, aris shecharav meemtzao venishtayyeru vo chamesh gefanim mikkan vechamesh gefanim mikkan. im yesh sham shemone ammot, lo yavi zera lesham. shemone ammot vaod, notnin lo chede avodato, vezorea et hammotar: 
Aris shehu yotze min hakkotel mittoch hakkeren vechale, notnin lo avodato, vezorea et hammotar. rabbi yose omer, im en sham arba ammot, lo yavi zera lesham: 
Hakkanim hayyotzim min hearis vechas alehen lefaskan, kenegdan muttar. asaan kede sheyyehallech alehen hechadash, asur: 
Happerach hayyotze min hearis, roin oto keillu metuttelet teluya vo, kenegdo asur. vechen bedalit. hammoteach zemora meilan leilan, tachteha asur. sippekah bechevel o vegemi, tachat hassippuk muttar. asaah kede sheyyehallech alav hechadash, asur:
Mishnah Nedarim 5:2-5:
Haya echad min hashshuk muddar meechad mehem hanaa, lo yikkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, yachol hu lomar lo, letoch shel chavercha ani nichnas, veeni nichnas letoch shellach: 
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero, veyesh lo merchatz uvet habbad muskarim bair, im yesh lo vahen tefisat yad, asur. en lo vahen tefisat yad, muttar. haomer lachavero, konam levetcha sheani nichnas vesadcha sheani lokeach, met o shemmecharo leacher, muttar. konam levayit ze sheani nichnas, sade zo sheani lokeach, met o shemmecharo leacher, asur: 
Hareni alecha cherem, hammuddar asur. hare at alay cherem, hannoder asur. hareni alecha veat alay, shenehem asurin. ushenehem muttarin bedavar shel ole vavel, vaasurin bedavar shel otah hair: 
Veezehu davar shel ole vavel, kegon har habbayit vehaazarot vehabbor shebbeemtza hadderech. veezehu davar shel otah hair, kegon harchava vehammerchatz, uvet hakkeneset vehatteva vehassefarim. vehakkotev chelko lannasi. rabbi yehuda omer, echad kotev lannasi veechad kotev lehedyot. ma ben kotev lannasi lechotev lehedyot, shehakkotev lannasi eno tzarich lezakkot. vachachamim omrim, echad ze veechad ze tzerichin lezakkot. lo dibberu vannasi ella vahove. rabbi yehuda omer, en anshe galil tzerichin lichtov, shekkevar katvu avotehem al yedehem:
Mishnah Nedarim 5:6-6:3:
Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veen lo ma yochal, notno leacher leshum mattana, vehalla muttar bah. maase veechad bevet choron shehaya aviv muddar hemennu hanaa, vehaya massi et beno, veamar lachavero, chatzer useuda netunim lecha vemattana, veenan lefanecha ella chede sheyyavo abba veyochal immanu basseuda. amar lo, im shelli hem, hare hem mukdashin lashshamayim. amar lo, lo natatti et shelli shettakdishem lashshamayim. amar lo, lo natatta li et shellecha ella shettehe atta veavicha ochlim veshotim umitratztzim ze laze, vihe avon taluy berosho. ucheshebba davar lifne chachamim, amru, kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah enah mekuddeshet, enah mattana: 
Hannoder min hamevushshal, muttar batztzali uvashshaluk. amar konam tavshil sheeni toem, asur bemaase kedera rach, umuttar beave umuttar bevetzat teramita, uvidlaat harmutza: 
Hannoder mimmaase kedera, eno asur ella mimmaase retachta. amar, konam hayyored lakkedera sheeni toem, asur bechol hammitbashshelin bakkedera: 
Min hakkavush, eno asur ella min hakkavush shel yarak. kavush sheeni toem, asur bechol hakkevushim. min hashshaluk, eno asur ella min hashshaluk shel basar. shaluk sheeni toem, asur bechol hashshelakim. min hatztzali, eno asur ella min hatztzali shel basar, divre rabbi yehuda. tzali sheeni toem, asur bechol hatztzeluyim. min hammaliach, eno asur ella min hammaliach shel dag. maliach sheeni toem, asur bechol hammeluchim:
Mishnah Nedarim 6:4-8:
Dag dagim sheeni toem, asur bahen, ben gedolim ben ketannim, ben meluchin ben tefelin, ben chayyin ben mevushshalin, umuttar betarit terufa uvetzir. hannoder min hatztzachana, asur betarit terufa, umuttar betzir uvemuryas. hannoder mittarit terufa, asur betzir uvemuryas: 
Hannoder min hechalav, muttar bakkum. verabbi yose oser. min hakkum, muttar bechalav. abba shaul omer, hannoder min haggevina, asur bah ben melucha ben tefela: 
Hannoder min habbasar, muttar barotev uvakkippa. verabbi yehuda oser. amar rabbi yehuda, maase veasar alay rabbi tarfon betzim shennitbashshelu immo. amru lo, vechen haddavar, ematay, bizman sheyyomar basar ze alay, shehannoder min haddavar venitarev beacher, im yesh bo venoten taam, asur: 
Hannoder min hayyayin, muttar betavshil sheyyesh bo taam yayin. amar konam yayin ze sheeni toem, venafal letavshil, im yesh bo venoten taam, hare ze asur. hannoder min haanavim, muttar beyayin. min hazzetim, muttar beshemen. amar konam zetim vaanavim ellu sheeni toem, asur bahen uvayyotze mehen: 
Hannoder min hattemarim, muttar bidvash temarim. missitvaniyyot, muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, kol sheshshem toladto keruya alav venoder hemennu, asur af bayyotze hemennu. vachachamim mattirin:
Mishnah Nedarim 6:9-7:2:
Hannoder min hayyayin, muttar beyen tappuchim. min hashshemen, muttar beshemen shumshemin. min haddevash, muttar bidvash temarim. min hachometz, muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot. min hakkereshin, muttar bekaflotot. min hayyarak, muttar beyarkot hassade, mippene shehu shem levay: 
Min hakkeruv, asur beispargos. min haispargos, muttar bichruv. min haggerisim, asur min hammikpa, verabbi yose mattir. min hammikpa, muttar bigrisin. min hammikpa, asur beshum, verabbi yose mattir. min hashshum, muttar bemikpa. min haadashim, asur baashishin, verabbi yose mattir. min haashishim, muttar baadashim. chitta chittim sheeni toem, asur bahen ben kemach ben pat. geris gerisin sheeni toem, asur bahen ben chayyin ben mevushshalim. rabbi yehuda omer, konam geris o chitta sheeni toem, muttar lachos chayyim: 
Hannoder min hayyarak, muttar bidluin. verabbi akiva oser. amru lo lerabbi akiva, vahalo omer adam lishlucho kach li yarak vehu omer lo matzati ella deluin. amar lahem, ken haddavar, o shemma omer hu lo lo matzati ella kitnit, ella shehaddeluin bichlal yarak, vekitnit enan bichlal yarak. veasur befol hammitzri lach, umuttar bayyavesh: 
Hannoder min haddagan, asur befol hammitzri yavesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno asur ella vachameshet hamminin. rabbi meir omer, hannoder min hattevua, eno asur ella mechameshet hamminin. aval hannoder min haddagan, asur bakkol, umuttar beferot hailan uveyarak:
Mishnah Nedarim 7:3-6:
Hannoder min hakkesut, muttar besak, biria, uvachamila. amar konam tzemer ole alay, muttar lehitkassot begizze tzemer. pishtan ole alay, muttar lehitkassot baanitze fishtan. rabbi yehuda omer, hakkol lefi hannoder. taan vehizzia vehaya recho kashe, amar konam tzemer ufishtim ole alay, muttar lehitkassot veasur lehafeshil laachorav: 
Hannoder min habbayit, muttar baaliyya, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, aliyya bichlal habbayit. hannoder min haaliyya, muttar babbayit: 
Hannoder min hammitta, muttar bedargash, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, dargash bichlal mitta. hannoder min haddargash, muttar bemitta. hannoder min hair, muttar likkanes litchumah shel ir, veasur likkanes leibburah. aval hannoder min habbayit, asur min haagaf velifnim: 
Konam perot haellu alay, konam hen al pi, konam hen lefi, asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. sheani ochel vesheani toem, muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen, bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, afillu giddule giddulin asurin:
Mishnah Nedarim 7:7-8:2:
Haomer leishto, konam maase yadayich alay, konam hen al pi, konam hen lefi, asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. sheeni ochel, sheeni toem, muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen, bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, afillu giddule giddulin asurim: 
Sheat osa eni ochel ad happesach, sheat osa eni mitkasse ad happesach, asta lifne happesach, muttar leechol ulehitkassot achar happesach. sheat osa ad happesach eni ochel, vesheat osa ad happesach eni mitkasse, asta lifne happesach, asur leechol ulehitkassot achar happasach: 
Sheat nehenet li ad happesach im telchi levet avich ad hechag, halcha lifne happesach, asura vahanaato ad happesach. achar happesach, belo yachel devaro. sheat nehenet li ad hechag im telchi levet avich ad happesach, vehalcha lifne happesach, asura vahanaato ad hechag, umutteret lelech achar happasach: 
Konam yayin sheani toem hayyom, eno asur ella ad shettechshach. shabbat zo, asur bechol hashshabbat, veshabbat sheavra. chodesh ze, asur bechol hachodesh, verosh chodesh lehabba. shana zo, asur bechol hashshana, verosh hashshana leatid lavo. shavua ze, asur bechol hashshavua, usheviit sheavra. veim amar yom echad, shabbat echat, chodesh echad, shana echat, shavua echad, asur miyyom leyom: 
Ad happesach, asur ad sheyyaggia. ad sheyyehe, asur ad sheyyetze. ad lifne happesach, rabbi meir omer, asur ad sheyyaggia. rabbi yose omer, asur ad sheyyetze:
Mishnah Temurah 3:3-4:1:
Hammafrish nekeva leola veyalda zachar, yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi vedamav ola. rabbi eliezer omer, hu atzmo yikrav ola. hammafrish nekeva leasham, tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi vedameha asham. im karav ashamo, yippelu dameha lindava. rabbi shimon omer, timmacher shello vemum. temurat asham, velad temuratah uveladan uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyippelu demehen lindava. rabbi eliezer omer, yamutu. verabbi elazar omer, yavi vidmehen olot. asham shemmetu vealav, veshekkipperu vealav, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer, yamutu. verabbi elazar omer, yavi vidmehen olot: 
Vahalo af hannedava ola hi. ma ben divre rabbi elazar ledivre chachamim. ella, bizman shehi vaa chova, hu somech aleha umevi aleha nesachin, unesacheha mishshello. veim haya chohen, avodatah veorah shello. uvizman shehi vaa nedava, eno somech aleha veeno mevi aleha nesachin, unesacheha mishshel tzibbur. af al pi shehu chohen, avodatah veorah shel anshe mishmar: 
Temurat habbechor vehammaaser, uveladan, uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu chivchor uchemaaser, veyeachlu vemumam labbealim. ma ben habbechor vehammaaser leven kol hakkodashim. shekkol hakkodashim nimkarim beitlis venishchatin beitlis venishkalin belitra, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. veyesh lahen pidyon, velitmurotehen pidyon, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. uvaim mechutza laaretz, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. im bau temimim, yikrevu. veim baale mumin, yeachlu vemuman labbealim. amar rabbi shimon, ma hattaam. shehabbechor vehammaaser yesh lahen parnasa vimkoman, ushear kol hakkodashim af al pi shennolad lahem mum, hare ellu vikdushshatan: 
Velad chattat, utemurat chattat, vechattat shemmetu vealeha, yamutu. sheavra shenatah vesheavda venimtzet baalat mum, im mishshekkipperu habbealim, tamut, veenah osa temura, lo nehenin, velo moalin. im ad shello chipperu habbealim, tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi vedameha acheret, veosa temura, umoalin bah:
Mishnah Temurah 4:2-5:2:
Hammafrish chattato veavda, vehikriv acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona, tamut. hammafrish maot lechattat veavdu, vehikriv chattat tachtehen, veachar kach nimtzeu hammaot, yelchu leyam hammelach: 
Hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu, vehifrish maot acherim tachtehen, lo hispik likkach bahen chattat ad shennimtzeu hammaot harishonot, yavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu, vehifrish chattat tachtehen, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzeu hammaot, vahare chattat baalat mum, timmacher, veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish maot tachteha, lo hispik likkach bahen chattat ad shennimtzet chattato, vahare hi vaalat mum, timmacher veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen baalot mum, yimmachru, veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen temimot, achat mehen tikrav chattat vehashsheniyya tamut, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, en chattat meta ella shennimtzet meachar shekkipperu habbealim, veen hammaot holchot leyam hammelach ella shennimtzeu meachar shekkipperu habbealim: 
Hammafrish chattato, vahare hi vaalat mum, mochrah veyavi vedameha acheret. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer, im karva hashsheniyya ad shello nishchata harishona, tamut, shekkevar kipperu habbealim: 
Ketzad maarimim al habbechor. mevakkeret shehayta meubberet, omer, ma shebbemeeha shel zo, im zachar, ola, yalda zachar, yikrav ola. veim nekeva, zivche shelamim, yalda nekeva, tikrav shelamim. im zachar ola, im nekeva zivche shelamim, yalda zachar unekeva, hazzachar yikrav ola, vehannekeva tikrav shelamim: 
Yalda shene zecharim, achad mehen yikrav ola, vehashsheni yimmacher lechayyave ola, vedamav chullin. yalda shete nekevot, achat mehen tikrav shelamim, vehashsheniyya timmacher lechayyave shelamim, vedameha chullin. yalda tumtum veanderoginos, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, en kedushsha chala alehen:
Mishnah Temurah 5:3-6:
Haomer, veladah shel zo ola vehi shelamim, devarav kayyamim. hi shelamim uveladah ola, hare zo velad shelamim, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi yose, im lechen nitkavven mittechilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat, devarav kayyamim. veim mishsheamar hare zo shelamim, nimlach veamar veladah ola, hare zo velad shelamim: 
Hare zo temurat ola utemurat shelamim, hare zo temurat ola, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi yose, im lechen nitkavven mittechilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat, devarav kayyamin. veim mishsheamar temurat ola, nimlach veamar, temurat shelamim, hare zo temurat ola: 
Hare zo tachat zo, temurat zo, chalufat zo, hare zo temura. zo mechullelet al zo, eno temura. veim haya hekdesh baal mum, yotze lechullin vetzarich laasot damim: 
Hare zo tachat chattat, vetachat ola, lo amar kelum. tachat chattat zo, vetachat ola zo, tachat chattat vetachat ola sheyyesh li vetoch habbayit, haya lo, devarav kayyamin. im amar al behema temea, veal baalat mum, hare ellu ola, lo amar kelum. hare ellu leola, yimmachru veyavi vidmehem ola:
Mishnah Temurah 6:1-4:
Kol haasurin al gabbe hammizbeach, osrim kol shehen. harovea, vehannirba, vehammuktze, vehanneevad, veetnan, umechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen. eze hu muktze. hammuktze laavoda zara. hu asur, uma shealav muttar. ezehu neevad. kol sheovdin oto. hu uma shealav asur. ze vaze muttarin baachila: 
Ezehu etnan. haomer lezona, he lich tale ze vischarech, afillu mea, kullan asurin. vechen haomer lachavero, he lecha tale ze vetalin shifchatcha etzel avdi, rabbi omer, eno etnan. vachachamim omrim, etnan: 
Eze hu mechir kelev. haomer lachavero, he lecha tale ze tachat kelev ze. vechen shene shuttafin shechalku, echad natal asara, veechad natal tisha vachelev, shekkeneged hakkelev, asurim, sheim hakkelev, muttarim. etnan kelev umechir zona, hare ellu muttarim, shenneemar (Devarim 23), shenayim, velo arbaa. valdotehen muttarim, shenneemar (sham) hen, velo valdotehen: 
Natan lah kesafim, hare ellu muttarin. yenot, shemanim, uselatot, vechol davar shekkayyotze vo karev al gabbe mizbeach, asur. natan lah mukdashin, hare ellu muttarin. ofot, hare ellu asurin. shehaya vaddin, ma im hammukdashin, shehammum posel bahem, en etnan umechir chal alehem, ofot, sheen hammum posel bahen, eno vaddin shello yehe etnan umechir chal alehen. talmud lomar (sham), lechol neder, lehavi et haof:
Mishnah Temurah 6:5-7:4:
Kol haasurim al gabbe hammizbeach, valdotehen muttarim. velad terefa, rabbi eliezer omer, lo yikrav al gabbe hammizbeach. vachachamim omrim, yikrav. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa, pesula meal gabbe hammizbeach. kol hakkodashim shennaasu terefa, en podim otam, sheen podim et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim: 
Yesh bekadshe mizbeach ma sheen bekadshe vedek habbayit. veyesh bekadshe vedek habbayit ma sheen bekadshe mizbeach. shekkadshe mizbeach osim temura, vechayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar, vetame, veladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonam, vehashochatam bachutz chayyav, veen notnin mehem laummanim bischaran, ma sheen ken bekadshe vedek habbayit: 
Yesh bekadshe vedek habbayit ma sheen bekadshe mizbeach, shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit. hekdesh bedek habbayit chal al hakkol, umoalin begiddulehen, veen bahem hanaa lechohanim: 
Echad kadshe mizbeach veechad kadshe vedek habbayit, en meshannin otan mikkedushsha likdushsha, umakdishin otan hekdesh illuy, umacharimin otan. veim metu, yikkavru. rabbi shimon omer, kadshe vedek habbayit, im metu, yippadu: 
Veellu hen hannikbarim. kadashim shehippilu, yikkavru. hippila shilya, tikkaver. shor hanniskal, veegla arufa, vetzippore metzora, usear nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vechullin shennishchatu vaazara. rabbi shimon omer, chullin shennishchatu vaazara, yissarfu, vechen chayya shennishchata vaazara:
Mishnah Temurah 7:5-6:
Veellu hen hannisrafim. chametz befesach, yissaref. uteruma temea, vehaarla, vechile hakkerem, et sheddarko lissaref, yissaref. veet sheddarko likkaver, yikkaver. umadlikin befat uveshemen shel teruma: 
Kol hakkodashim shennishchatu chutz lizmannan vechutz limkoman, hare ellu yissarfu. asham taluy, yissaref. rabbi yehuda omer, yikkaver. chattat haof habbaa al safek, tissaref. rabbi yehuda omer, yetilenna laamma. kol hannisrafin lo yikkavru, vechol hannikbarim lo yissarfu. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza lehachamir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarim, rashshay. amru lo, eno muttar leshannot:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:1-3:
Hadela [ka] 400 ner beshabbat enah reshut im ratza madlik veim ratza eno madlik. velo mitzva sheeno chayyav lirdof achareha ad sheyyaasena kegon eruve chatzerot o netilat yadayim laachila ella ze chova. veechad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin lihyot bevattehen ner daluk beshabbat. afillu en lo ma yochal shoel al happetachim velokeach shemen umadlik et hanner shezze bichlal oneg shabbat. vechayyav levarech kodem hadelaka baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehadelik ner shel shabbat. kederech shemmevarech al kol haddevarim shehu chayyav bahem middivre sofrim: 
Muttar lehishtammesh bener shel shabbat. vehu shello yehe haddavar tzarich iyyun harebe. aval davar shetztzarich ledakdek biriyyato asur lehavechino leor hanner gezera shemma yatte: 
Hammadlik tzarich lehadelik mibbeod yom kodem shekiat hachamma. venashim metzuuot al davar ze yoter min haanashim lefi shehen metzuyot babbattim vehen haasukot bimlechet habbayit. veaf al pi chen tzarich haish lehazehiran velivdok otan al kach velomar lahen uleanshe beto erev shabbat kodem shettechshach hadeliku et hanner. sefek chashecha venichnas hashshabbat safek lo nichnas en madlikin:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5:10-12:
Vechol talmid chacham sheddeotav mechuvvanot eno medabber bifne mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma af al pi shello lamad mimmennu kelum:
Harav hammuvhak sheratza limchol al kevodo bechol haddevarim haellu o beechad mehen lechol talmidav o leechad mehen harshut beyado. veaf al pi shemmachal chayyav hattalmid lehaddero vaafillu beshaa shemmachal:
Keshem shehattalmidim chayyavin bichvod harav kach harav tzarich lechabbed et talmidav ulekarvan. kach amru chachamim <small>(mishna avot 4 12)</small> "yehi kevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha". vetzarich adam lehizzaher betalmidav uleohovam shehem habbanim hamehannim laolam hazze velaolam habba:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5:7-9:
Vechayyav laamod mippene rabbo mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav ad sheyyitkasse mimmennu velo yire komato veachar kach yeshev. vechayyav adam lehakebil pene rabbo baregel:
En cholkin kavod letalmid bifne rabbo ella im ken derech rabbo lachalok lo kavod. vechol hammelachot shehaeved ose lerabbo talmid ose lerabbo. veim haya bemakom sheen makkirin oto velo hayu lo tefillin vechash shemma yomru eved hu eno noel lo minalo veeno choltzo. vechol hammonea talmido milleshammesho monea mimmennu chesed uforek mimmennu yirat shamayim. vechol talmid shemmezalzel davar mikkol kevod rabbo gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael:
Raa rabbo over al divre tora omer lo limmadtanu rabbenu kach vechach. vechol zeman shemmazkir shemua befanav omer lo kach limmadtanu rabbenu. veal yomar davar shello shama merabbo ad sheyyazkir shem omro. uchesheyyamut rabbo korea kol begadav ad shehu megalle et libbo veeno meache leolam. bamme devarim amurim berabbo muvhak shellamad mimmennu rov chachmato. aval im lo lamad mimmennu rov chachmato hare ze talmid chaver veeno chayyav bichvodo bechol ellu haddevarim. aval omed millefanav vekorea alav keshem shehu korea al kol hammetim shehu mitabbel alehem. afillu lo lamad mimmennu ella davar echad ben katan ben gadol omed millefanav vekorea alav:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6:1-3: Kol talmid chacham mitzva lehaddero veaf al pi sheeno rabbo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken". zaken ze shekkana chachma. umeematay chayyavin laamod mippanav. mishsheyyikrav mimmennu bearba ammot ad sheyyaavor mikkeneged panav:

En omdin mippanav lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "takum vehadarta" kima sheyyesh bah hiddur. veen baale ummanuyyot chayyavin laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskin bimlachtan shenneemar takum vehadarta ma hiddur sheen bah chesron kis af kima sheen bah chesron kis. uminnayin shello yaatzim enav min hechacham kede shello yirehu ad shello yaamod mippanav. shenneemar veyareta meelohecha. ha kol davar shehu masur lallev neemar bo veyareta meelohecha:

En rauy lechacham sheyyatriach et haam vichavven atzmo lahen kede sheyyaamdu mippanav ella yelech bederech ketzara umitkavven shello yiru oto kede shello yatrichen laamod. vehachachamim hayu makkifin veholchin bederech hachitzona sheen makkirehen metzuyin sham kede shello yatrichum:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6:4-7: Rochev hare hu kimhallech ucheshem sheomdim mippene hamehallech kach omdin mippene harochev:
Shelosha shehayu holchin badderech. harav baemtza gadol mimino vekatan missemolo:

Haroe chacham eno omed mippanav ad sheyyaggia lo learba ammot. vechevan sheavar yoshev. raa av bet din omed millefanav mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyaavor meacharav arba ammot. raa et hannasi omed millefanav melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyeshev bimkomo o ad sheyyitkasse meenav. vehannasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul. keshehannasi nichnas kol haam omdim veenan yoshvin ad sheyyomar lahem shevu. kesheav bet din nichnas osin lo shete shurot veomdin mikkan umikkan ad shennichnas veyoshev bimkomo ushear haam yoshvin bimkoman:

Chacham shennichnas kol sheyyaggia lo bearba ammot omed millefanav echad omed veechad yoshev ad shennichnas veyoshev bimkomo. bene chachamim vetalmide chachamim bizman sheharabbim tzerichin lahem mekappetzin al rashe haam venichnasim limkomam. veen shevach letalmide chachamim sheyyikkansu laacharona. yatza letzorech chozer limkomo. bene chachamim bizman sheyyesh bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe avihen. en bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe haam:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6:8-10: Talmid shehu yoshev lifne rabbo tamid eno rashshay laamod mippanav ella shacharit vearvit bilvad shello yehe kevodo merubbe mikkevod shamayim:

Mi shehu zaken muflag bezikna af al pi sheeno chacham omdin lefanav. vaafillu hechacham shehu yeled omed bifne hazzaken hammuflag bezikna. veeno chayyav laamod melo komato ella kede lehaddero. vaafillu zaken kuti mehadderin oto bidvarim venotnin lo yad lesamcho shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 32)</small> "mippene seva takum" kol seva bemashma:

Talmide chachamim enam yotzin beatzman laasot im kol hakkahal bevinyan vachafira shel medina vechayyotze bahen kede shello yitbazzu bifne amme haaretz. veen govin mehen levinyan hachoma vetikkun hashshearim usechar hashshomrim vechayyotze bahen velo litshurat hammelech. veen mechayyevim otan litten hammas ben mas shehu katzuv al bene hair ben mas shehu katzuv al kol ish vaish shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 8 10)</small> "gam ki yitnu vaggoyim atta akabbetzem vayyachellu meat mimmassa melech vesarim". vechen im hayta sechora letalmid chacham menichim oto limkor techilla veen menichim echad mibbene hashshuk limkor ad sheyyimkor hu. vechen im haya lo din vehaya omed bichlal baale dinim harebe makdimin oto umoshivin oto:

Hachammarim — mehen reshaim mehen tzaddikim. ikka deamri: ha demikkaf, ha dela mikkaf; veikka deamri: ha dimtarten, ha dela metarten.

Shabbat 89b:2-5: Minnayin shekkoshrin lashon shel zehorit vechulei. "kashshanim"? "kashshani" mibbee leh! amar rabbi yitzchak, amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: im yihyu chataechem kashshanim hallalu shessedurot uvaot mishsheshet yeme bereshit vead achshav — kashsheleg yalbinu. daresh rava, may dichtiv: "lechu na venivvachcha yomar Adonai" — "lechu na"? "bou na" mibbee leh! "yomar Adonai"? "amar Adonai" mibbee leh! leatid lavo yomar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: lechu na etzel avotechem veyochichu etchem.

Veyomru lefanav: ribbono shel olam etzel mi nelech? etzel avraham sheamarta lo "yadoa teda" velo bikkesh rachamim alenu?! etzel yitzchak shebberach et esav "vehaya kaasher tarid" velo bikkesh rachamim alenu?! etzel yaakov sheamarta lo "anochi ered immecha mitzrayma" velo bikkesh rachamim alenu?! etzel mi nelech? achshav "yomar Adonai". amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: hoil utelitem atzmechem bi — "im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv: "ki atta avinu ki avraham lo yedaanu veyisrael lo yakkiranu atta Adonai avinu goalenu meolam shemecha" — leatid lavo yomar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham: banecha chatu li. omer lefanav: ribbono shel olam, yimmachu al kedushshat shemecha. amar: emar leh leyaakov dahava leh tzaar giddul banim, efshar devae rachame alayyhu. amar leh: banecha chatu. omer lefanav: ribbono shel olam, yimmachu al kedushshat shemecha. amar la besave tama vela bedardakke etza. omer lo leyitzchak: banecha chatu li. omer lefanav: ribbono shel olam, banay velo banecha?! beshaa shehikdimu lefanecha "naase" lenishma" karata lahem "beni vechori", achshav banay velo banecha?!

Veod, kamma chatu? kamma shenotav shel adam — shivim shana. dal esrin dela anshat alayyhu — pashu lehu chamshin. dal esrin vechamsha delelavata — pashu lehu esrin vechamsha. dal tarte sere ufalga detzalloye umechal udevet hakkisse — pashu lehu tarte sere ufalga, im atta sovel et kullam — mutav, veim lav — palga alay ufalga alaych. veim timtza lomar kullam alay — ha karevit nafshi kammach. potchin veomrin: "ki atta avinu". omer lahem yitzchak: ad sheattem mekallesin li, kallesu lehakkadosh baruch hu, umachve lehu yitzchak lekudesha berich hu beeneh. miyyad nosim enehem lammarom veomrim: "atta Adonai avinu goalenu meolam shemecha".
Yevamot 21a:4-13: Amar rava: remez lishniyyot min hattora minnayin — shenneemar: "ki et kol hattoevot hael asu anshe haaretz", "hael" — kashot, mikkelal deikka rakkot, umay ninhu — sheniyyot.
Umay mashma dehael" lishshana dekashe hu — dichtiv: "veet ele haaretz lakach".
Lema peliga derabbi levi, deamar rabbi levi: kashe onshan shel middot yoter meonshan shel arayot, shezze neemar bahen "el", veze neemar bahen "elle"! "el" kashe, veelle" kashe meel".
Gabbe arayot name ha ketiv "elle"! hahu lemaote middot mikkaret.
Ella may chumerayyhu? hane — efshar bitshuva, hane — la efshar bitshuva.

Rav yehuda amar mehacha: "veizzen vechikker tikken meshalim harebe", veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: kodem shebba shelomo, hayta tora doma lichfifa sheen lah oznayim, ad shebba shelomo veasa lah oznayim.
Rabbi oshaya amar mehacha: "peraehu al taavor bo sete mealav vaavor".

Amar rav ashe: mashal derabbi oshaya lema haddavar dome — leadam meshammer pardes, meshammero mibbachutz — kullo mishtammer. meshammero mibbifnim, shellefanav — mishtammer, shelleacharav — eno mishtammer. veha derav ashe beduta hi. hatam, shellefanav miha mishtammer. hacha, i lav sheniyyot, paga beerva gufa.
Rav kahana amar mehacha: "ushemartem et mishmarti" — asu mishmeret lemishmarti.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ha deorayyta hi! deorayyta, ufershu rabbanan. kol hattora name pershu rabbanan! ella: midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.
Zevachim 85b:17-86a:7: Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" – lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidim vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim. yachol afillu pershu? talmud lomar: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam".
Yachol yachlotz gidin vaatzamot, veyaale basar legabbe mizbeach? talmud lomar: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol". ha ketzad? mechubbarin – yaalu, pershu – afillu hen berosh hammizbeach, yerdu.
Man tanna deshamat leh deamar: pershu yardu? rabbi hi, detanya: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" – lerabbot haatzamot vehaggidin vehakkeranayim vehattelafayim, afillu pershu.
Veella ma ani mekayyem: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam"? lomar lach: ikkule ola atta machazir, vei atta machazir ikkule gidin vaatzamot.

Rabbi omer, katuv echad omer: "vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha" – ribba, vechatuv echad omer: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam" – miet. ha ketzad? mechubbarin – yaalu, pershu – afillu hen berosh hammizbeach, yerdu.
Pershu lo yaalu [vechulei]. amar rabbi zera: lo shanu ella sheppershu kelappe matta, aval kelappe mala – karove hu deakrivu leikkul. vaafillu pershu?!
Amar rabba, hachi kaamar: lo shanu ella sheppershu leachar zerika, aval pershu kodem zerika – atay zerika usheritinhu, afillu lemebad minnayyhu (kata) [kattata] desakkine.
Savar la ki ha deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: neemar "lo yihye" beola, veneemar "lo yihye" beasham; ma asham – atzmotav muttarin, af ola – (atzamot) [atzmoteha] muttarin.
Zohar, Beshalach 7: (Shemot 14:14) Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. ribbi abba patach (Yeshayahu 58:13) im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beyom kadshi. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itrae behon, leitdabbeka behu, mikkol shear ammin dealma, umiggo rechimuta dilhon, kariv lon legabbeh, veyahav lon orayyta, veyahav lon shabbat, deihu kaddisha mikkol shear yomin, venayycha mikkolla, vechedva decholla, veshakil shabbat, lokovel orayyta kella, uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Vekarata lashshabbat oneg, innuga decholla, innuga denafsha vegufa innuga deillain vetattain. vekarata lashshabbat, may vekarata. deyazmin leh. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 23:2) mikrae kodesh, kelomar, zeminin, kema dimzammin ushepiza leveteh. veal da vekarata lashshabbat oneg, deyazmin leh, kema dimzamnin ushepiza, befatora metakkena, beveta metakkena kedka yeot, bemechla uvemishteya kedka yeot, yattir al shear yomin. vekarata lashshabbat mibbeod yom. (emor 22 amud alef) likdosh Adonai mechubbad: da yom kippurim. tere deinnun chad. vechibbadto measot derachecha, kema deokimna.
Mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, veha ittemar, begin dehahi milla salleka, veittear milla dechol leella. man dimzammin ushepiza, beh bae leishtaddela, vela baochora.

Ta chaziyi hahu milla denafik mippumeh devar nash, salleka veittear itaruta leella, i letav, i levish. uman deyativ beinnuga deshabbeta, asir leh leitteara milla (43 2) dechol, deha pagim pegimu beyoma kaddisha. man deyativ behillula demalka, la yitchaze lemishbak lemalka, veyitassek beachara.
Uvechol yoma bae leachazaa ovada, uleitara ataruta mimma deitzterich. uveshabbat, bemille dishmayya, uvikdushsha deyoma bae leitteara, vela bemilla achara.

Ta chaze, hacha kad itkeriv paro leaggacha kerava behu beyisrael, behahi zimna, la bae kudesha berich hu, deyittearun yisrael itaruta letatta kelal, deha itaruta leella hu, deha avahan akdimu veattearu itaruta da leella, uzechuta dilhon kaim kameh, (veattearu itaruta da) vela baa kudesha berich hu deyisrael yittearun letatta kelal. (deha beatrah leella hava) hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. tacharishun vadday, vela titarun milla, dela itzterich lechu, vehacha itkelil shema kaddisha beatvavn reshiman, veha itaru beh chavrayyay.

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda havo azle bearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda, vadday tannina, Adonai, bechol atar rachame, veaf al gav deaggach kerava, veavid dina, hahu dina birchimuta hu. vehacha chamena, dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem, vela itchaze behahu dina rachame kelal, deha ketiv lo nishar bahem ad echad.

Amar leh, milla da shemana meribbi shimon deamar, deafillu hacha dina berachame hava, dechafa alehon yamma umitu, ulevatar appik lon yamma, vekudesha berich hu baa bikarehon, veitkevaru beara, vela baat ara lekabbela lon, ad deoshit lah kudesha berich hu yemineh, vekabbilat lon, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:12) natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz. uvegin da, (hava) hay dina berachame hava.

Veal da, la baa kudesha berich hu deyittearun yisrael milla bealma, dei yitarun yisrael milla, la yitarun shema derachame, vela yitavid dina berachame, hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun, dela titarun midi. deha shema derachame bae leitteara alayyhu, lemebad dina berachame. veal da bae, dela taavdun pegimu, vetitarun milla achara.

Amar leh, veha ketiv, (zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem. i hachi da dina berachame hava. amar leh, hachi hava vadday, dina hu berachame, demota dilhon la ishtechach kemotana dishar bene alma, ella chas alayyhu kudesha berich hu, dela yehon kemotana dishar bene alma, dekatilu lon, ella benachat belo tzaara, ha dina berachame ihu.

Uvechol atar, shema da, dina berachame ihu, bar atar chad, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kagibbor yetze vegomer. vechi kagibbor velo gibbor. ella yeshanne levushoy, veyilbash levushin acharanin. keish milchamot, yeshanne zineh.

Veim kol da, dina hu yattir, aval rachame beh, kema dichtiv, kagibbor, velo gibbor. keish milchamot, velo ish milchamot. devadday af al gav deavid dina, chas al ovadoy, veal da, Adonai yillachem lachem vadday veattem tacharishun. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu barir lon lechulakeh veachasanteh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.
Zohar, Vayeshev 1: Vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (tehillim la) rabbot raot tzaddik umikkullam yatztzilenu Adonai. ta chaze, kamma mekatregin it leh levar nash miyyoma dekudesha berich hu yahav beh nishmata (davar acher 33 levar nash) (leitkayyeyma) behay alma. dechevan denafik var nash laavira dealma, miyyad izdamman leishtattefa bahadeh yetzer hara kema deittemar. dichtiv, (Bereshit 4:7) lappetach chattat rovetz vegomer. ucheden ishtattaf bahadeh yetzer hara.

Veta chaze, dehachi hu, deha beire miyyoma deityallidu, kullehu natre garmayyhu, vearkin min go nura, umin kol atrin bishin. uvar nash, miyyad ate laarama garmeh go nura, begin deyetzer hara share begavvih, umiyyad aste leh learcha visha.

Veokimna dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:13) tov yeled misken vechacham mimmelech zaken uchesil asher lo yada lehizzaher od. tov yeled, da hu yetzer tov dehu yeled miyyomin zeirin immeh devar nash, deha mittelesar shenin vaelach (immeh) kema deittemar.

Mimmelecha zaken uchesil. mimmelech, da hu yetzer hara deihu ikre melech veshallit bealma al bene nasha. zaken uchesil, deihu zaken vadday, kema deukemuha, dechad ityelid var nash venafik laavira dealma ihu izdamman immeh devar nash. veal da ihu melech zaken uchesil.

Asher lo yada lehizzaher od, lehazehir la ketiv, ella lehizzaher, begin deihu chesil. vealeh amar shelomo alav hashalom (Kohelet 2:14) vehakkesil bachoshech holech. deha messusita dechoshech ka atya velet leh nehora lealmin.

Ribbi shimon amar, ta chaze, ketiv tov yeled misken vechacham. man yeled misken, ha ukemuha veittemar deihu yetzer tov. aval tov yeled, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 37:25) naar hayiti gam zakanti. veda hu naar deihu yeled misken delet leh miggarmeh kelum. veammay ikre naar, begin deit leh chadtu desihara demitchaddesha tadir, vetadir ihu yeled misken kema deamran. vechacham, begin dechachma sharya beh.

Mimmelecha zaken, da hu yetzer hara kema deittemar. deha min yoma dehava la nafak mimmesaavuteh lealmin, veihu chesil. dechol archoy inun leorach bisha, veazil vesate livni nasha vela yada leizdahara. veihu ate im var nash betiskufin begin leastaa lon meorach tava leorach bisha.

Ta chaze, al da akdim im bar nash beyoma deityelid begin diyhemin leh. deha kad ate yetzer tov la yachil var nash limhemna leh vedame aleh kematula. kegavvna da taninan, man hu rasha arum, da hu man deakdim leatana milloy lekamme dayyna ad la yete chavreh mare dedina. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 18:17) tzaddik harishon berivo vegomer.

Kegavvna da (hu nusach acher hay) rasha arum, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arum. vehu akdim veshare immeh devar nash ad la yete chavreh leashraa aleh. uvegin deihu akdim veha atin taanateh immeh, kad ate chavreh deihu yetzer hattov, avish leh levar nash bahadeh vela yachil lezakfa resheh, keillu atin al kitfeh kol matolin dealma. begin hahu rasha arum deakdim immeh. veal da amar shelomo (Kohelet 9:16) vechachmat hammisken bezuya udevarav enam nishmaim, begin deha akdim ochora.

Veal da kol dayyne dekabbil mibbar nash milla ad la yete chavreh, keillu mekabbel aleh taavav ochora limhemnuta. ella (Mishlei 18:17) uva reehu vachakaro, veda hu orach devar nash zakkaa, deha var nash zakkaa da hu, dela hemin lehahu rasha arum deyetzer hara, ad deyete chavreh deihu yetzer tov. uvegin da bene nasha inun kashlin lealma deate.

Aval hahu zakkaa deihu dachil lemareh, kamma bishin savil behay alma begin dela yehemin vela yishtattaf behahu yetzer hara. vekudesha berich hu sheziv leh mikkullehu, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim la) rabbot raot tzaddik umikkullam yatztzilenu Adonai. rabbot raot latztzaddik la ketiv, ella tzaddik. begin dekudesha berich hu itrae beh. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu itrae behahu var nash vesheziv leh mikkolla behay alma uvealma deate, zakkaa chulakeh.

Ta chaze, kamma bishin avru aleh deyaakov, begin dela yitdabbak behahu yetzer hara veyitrechak mechulakeh. uvegin kach savil kamma onshin kamma bishin vela shakit. patach veamar, (iyyov 3:26) lo shalavti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez. ta chaze, kamma bishin savlin tzaddikaya behay alma. bishin al bishin, keevin al keevin. begin lemizke lon lealma deate.

Yaakov kamma savil bishin al bishin tadir, kema deat amer lo shalavti, beveta delavan, vela yachilna leishtezava minneh. velo shakatti, meesav. mehahu tzaara detzier li hahu memanna dileh, ulevatar dechilu deesav. velo nachti, min dina umin shechem.

Vayyavo rogez, da rugeza veirbuveya deyosef deihu kashya mikkullehu, miggo rechimuta deyaakov legabbe deyosef deihu raza divrit, al bemitzrayim. begin dilvatar ketiv, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vaezkor et beriti, leishtakkacha shechinta (nusach acher shemesh) tamman bahadeh.

Vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan, ribbi yose patach, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad veen ish sam al lev veanshe chesed neesafim been mevin ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik. hatztzaddik avad, bezimna dekudesha berich hu ashgach bealma vela have alma kedka yeut, veizdamman dina lesharyay al alma. keden kudesha berich hu natil zakkaa deishtakkach benayyhu, begin deyishre dina al kullehu ochoranin, vela yishtakkach man deyagin alayyhu.

Deha kol zimna dezakkaa share bealma, dina la yachil leshaltaa al alma. menalan mimmoshe, dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:23) vayyomer lehashemidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav vegomer. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu natil lezakkaa mibbenayyhu vesallik leh mealma, ucheden itpera vegave dileh. sofeh dikra, ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik. ad dela yete raa leshaltaa al alma neesaf hatztzaddik. (davar acher ki mippene haraa neesaf ad lo yishlot haraa bealma) davar acher ki mippene haraa, da yetzer hara.
Ta chaze, yaakov shelimu daavahan hava veihu kaim lekayyma begaluta. aval miggo deihu tzaddik itakkav dina dela shalta bealma. deha kol yome deyaakov la shara dina al alma, vechafna itbatlat.

Veuf hachi beyomoy deyosef deihu diukena deavoy (kevan deihu met miyyad). la shera galuta (dina al alma). begin deihu agin alayyhu kol yomoy, kevan deihu met, miyyad shara alayyhu galuta. kema deat amer (Shemot 1:14) vayyamat yosef vegomer, vesamich leh hava nitchakkema lo. uchetiv vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha bechomer uvilvenim vegomer.
Kegavvna da bechol atar desharya zakkaa (al) bealma begineh kudesha berich hu yagin al alma, vechol zimna deihu kayyaym, dina la sharya al alma veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv, may megure aviv, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 6:25) magor misaviv, dechol yomoy hava dachil vehava bidchilu: vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv. ribbi elazar amar, deitkashshar veyativ behahu atar deitachid bachoshech. eretz megure aviv dayyka, beeretz kenaan, itkashshar atra beatreh. megure aviv, da dina kashya. beeretz megure aviv, kema deittemar hahu dina rafya deihi eretz, deitachid min dina kashya uveh ityashshev yaakov veitachid beh, (vehahi eretz ihi aspaklarya dela nahara):
Zohar, Vayeshev 13: Vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora vehabbor rek en bo mayim. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 19:8) torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh (man devatil mile deorayyta keillu chariv alma shelim). kamma it lon livne nasha leishtaddela beorayyta, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta lehve leh chayyim bealma den uvealma deate, vezache bitren almin. veafillu man deishtaddal beorayyta vela yishtaddal bah lishmah kedka yaot, zache leagar tav bealma den, vela dayynin leh behahu alma.

Veta chaze, ketiv, (Mishlei 3:16) orech yamim biminah bismolah osher vechavod. orech yamim behahu deishtaddal beorayyta lishmah, deit leh orech yamim behahu alma deveh orcha deyomin. veinun yomin inun yomin vadday, tamman ihu rachatzanu dikdusha dilela deitrechitz bar nash behay alma leishtaddela beorayyta, leittakkefa behahu alma bismolah osher vechavod, agar tav veshalva it leh behay alma.

Vechol man deyishtaddal beorayyta lishmah, kad nafik mehay alma, orayyta azla kammeh veachrazat kammeh veaginat aleh, dela yikrevun bahadeh marehon dedina. kad shachiv gufa bekivra, hi natrat leh. kad nishmata azla leistalleka lemetav leatrah, ihi azla kammah dehahi nishmata. vechamma tarin ittavru mikkammah deorayyta ad dealat leduchetah. vekayyma aleh devar nash ad deyitar bezimna dikumun metayay dealma, veihi malfa sannegora aleh.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 6:22) behithallechcha tanche otach beshachbecha tishmor alecha vahakitzota hi tesichecha. behithallechcha tanche otach, kema deittemar. beshachbecha tishmor alecha, beshata deshachiv gufa bekivra, deha keden behahu zimna itdan gufa bekivra ucheden orayyta aginat aleh. vahakitzota hi tesichecha kema deittemar bezimna deyitarun mete alma min afra. hi tesichecha lemeheve sannegorya alach.

Ribbi elazar amar, hi tesichecha. may hi tesichecha. begin deaf al gav dehashta yekumun meafra, orayyta la yitneshe minnehon. deha keden yindeun kol hahi orayyta deshavku kad istalku mehay alma, hahi orayyta netira mehahu zimna vetiul bemeayyhu kemillekaddemin veihi temallel bemeayyhu.

Vechol millin mittakkenan yattir mikkema dehavu bekadmita, deha kol inun millin deihu la yachil leadbaka lo kedka yaot veihu ishtaddal behu vela itdabbak behu. kullehu alin bemeoy mittaknan, veorayyta temallel beh. hada hu dichtiv vahakitzota hi tesichecha. ribbi yehuda amar, kegavvna da kol man deishtaddal beorayyta behay alma, zache leishtaddela bah lealma deate veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, hahu var nash dela zache leishtaddela behay alma beorayyta, veihu azil bechashocha, kad nafik mehay alma, natlin leh vealin leh laggehinnom, atar tattaa dela yehe merachem aleh, deikre bor shaon tit hayyaven. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 40:3) vayyaaleni mibbor shaon mittit hayyaven vayyakem al sela raglay konen ashuray.

Ubbegin kach hahu dela ishtaddal beorayyta behay alma veittannaf betinnufe alma, ma ketiv vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora. da hu gehinnom, atar dedayynin lehu leinun dela ishtaddelu beorayyta. vehabbor rek, kema deihu hava rek. may tama begin dela hava beh mayim.

Veta chaze, kamma hu onsha deorayyta, deha la itgalu yisrael meara kaddisha, ella begin deistallaku meorayyta, veishtevaku minah. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 9:11) mi haish hechacham veyaven et zot vegomer al ma avda haaretz vegomer. vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati vegomer. ribbi yose amar, mehacha, (Yeshayahu Adonai:13) lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat.

Begin kach kolla kayyma al kiyyuma deorayyta, vealma la itkeyyaym bekiyyumeh ella beorayyta, deihu kiyyuma dealmin ela vetatta dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti:

Vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora, ramaz al dearmiu leh lego mitzrae atar dela ishtakkach raza dimhemnuta kelal. ribbi yitzchak amar, i nechashin veakrabbin havu beh, ammay ketiv biruven lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashivo el aviv. vechi la chayyish reuven lehay. deha inun nechashin veakrabbin yenazkun leh, veech amar lahashivo el aviv, uchetiv lemaan hatztzil oto.

Ella chama reuven denizka ishtakkach bidayyhu deachoy, begin deyada kamma sanin leh ureuta dilhon lekatla leh. amar reuven, tav leminpal leh lego gova dinchashin veakrabbin, vela yitmesar bida desanoy dela merachame aleh. mikkan amru yappil var nash garmeh leesha o leguva dinchashin veakrabbin, vela yitmassar bida desanoy (dizirin inun daykaley leishtezava. uvegin kach amar lemaan hitztzil oto miyyadam).

Begin dehacha atar dinchashim veakrabbim. i ihu tzaddika, kudesha berich hu yarchish leh nisa. ulezimnin dizchu deavahan mesayyin leh levar nash veyishteziv minnayyhu. aval kevan deyitmassar bida desanoy, zeirin inun deyachlin leishtezava.

Uvegin kach amar, lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam. miyyadam dayyka, vela ketiv lemaan hatztzil oto vetu la. ella amar reuven, yishteziv min yedayyhu, vei yemut beguva yemut. uvegin kach ketiv vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam.

Ta chaze, kamma chasiduteh diruven, divgin deyada deshimon velevi shuttefuta vachachimuta vechavruta dilhon, kashya inun. dechad itchabbaru bishchem, katlu kol dechura (sefer acher 33 veha dekatlu kol dechura) la day lon. ella denatlin nashin vataf vechaspa vedahava vechol beire vechol mane dikar vechol man deishtakkach bekarta. vela day kol da, ella deafillu kol ma divchakla natlu. dichtiv, (Bereshit la) veet asher bair veet asher bassade lakachu.

Amar, uma karta rabbata ki hay la ishteziv minnehon, ilmale ravya da yippol bidayyhu, la yasharun minneh umetza bealma. veal da amar, tav leishtezava minnayyhu dela yasharun minneh ishtaaruta bealma, vela yechome abba minneh kelum lealmin.

Vehacha i yemut, la yachlin leh veyishtaar kol gufeh shelim, vaativ leh leabba shelim. veal da lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashivo el aviv, af al gav dimut hatam. uvegin kach amar hayyeled enennu. vela amar ennnu chay, ella amar enennu, afillu met.

Ta chaze, may deavad, deihu bechachmeta hava shattif garmeh bahadayyhu, dichtiv lo nakkennu nafesh, vela ketiv la takkuhu. veihu la hava tamman kad izdabban yosef, deha kullehu meshammeshe laavuhon kol chad vechad yoma chad. vehahu yoma diruven hava. veal da baa divhahu yoma dehava shimmusha dileh la yitavid yosef. uvegin kach ketiv vayyashav reuven el habbor vehinne en yosef babbor vayyikra et begadav. vehine en yosef dayyka. afillu (chay o) mit, miyyad vayyashav el echav vayyomer hayyeled enennu.
Veafillu reuven la yada mehahu zevina deyosef, veha ukemuha deishtattif behu shechinta, veal da la yada reuven mehahu zevina deyosef vela itgalyay leh ad hahu zimna deitgele yosef laachohi.

Ta chaze, kamma garim leh liruven begin deihu ishtaddal leachayay leh leyosef, ma ketiv, (Devarim 33:6) yechi reuven veal yamot vegomer. deha begin da, af al gav deyada deishtekil becheruteh minneh veityehiv leyosef, ishtaddal leachayay leh, vetzalle moshe veamar yechi reuven veal yamot, veitkeyyaym bealma den veitkeyyaym bealma deate. may tama, begin da, uvegin deavad teshuva mehahu ovada. dechol man deavid teshuva, kudesha berich hu kayyaym leh bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, vayyikchu et ketonet yosef vegomer, ha ukemuha divgin dedama desair damya ledama devar nash. aval ta chaze, af al gav demilla atya kedka chaze, kudesha berich hu medakdek behu betzaddikayay afillu kechut hassaara.

Yaakov avad ovada kedka yaot. bemay, begin deakriv legabboy avoy sair, deihu sitra dedina kashya. veim kol da, begin deihu akriv sair veakkechish leh leavoy deihu sitra dileh, itanash behay sair ochora, deakrivu leh benoy dama dileh.

Beihu ketiv, (Bereshit 27:16) veet orot gedaye haizzim hilbisha al yadav veal chelkat tzavvarav, begin kach vayyitbelu et hakkuttonet baddam, akrivu leh kuttonta leakkechasha leh, vecholla da lokovel da, ihu garim dichtiv vayyechorad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod, begin kach garmu leh decharad charada behahu zimna dichtiv hakker na hakketonet bincha hi im lo.
Ribbi chiyyay amar, beh ketiv, (Bereshit 27:21) haatta ze beni esav im lo. leh ketiv, hakketonet bincha hi im lo. ubbegin kach kudesha berich hu medakdek behu betzaddikaya bechol ma deinun avdin.

Ribbi abba amar, (nusach acher ameraz rabbi abba) kevan dechamu kullehu shivtin hahu tzaara deavuhon, itnechamu vavday, vihivu garmayyhu aleh deyosef, deyifdun leh ilmale yishkechun leh. kevan dechamu dela yachilu, ahadaru legabbeh dihuda veaavaru leh mealayyhu, begin deihu hava malka alayyhu. (ucheden sefer acher vechevan 4) aavaruhu mealayyhu, ma ketiv, vayhi baet hahi vayyered yehuda vegomer.
Zohar, Vayeshev 16: Vayyomer yehuda leonan bo el eshet achicha vegomer. ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 41:25) hairoti mitztzafon vayyaat mimmizrach shemesh yikra vishmi veyavo seganim kemo chomer uchemo yotzer yirmas tit. ta chaze, kamma inun beni nasha tippeshin dela yadin vela mistakkelin leminda archoy dekudesha berich hu. deha kullehu nayymin, dela mitare shenta bechorehon.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avad leh levar nash, kegavvna dilela. kolla ihu bechachmeta. delet lach shayyfa veshayyfa bevar nash dela kayyma bechachmeta illaa. deha kevan deittakkan kol gufa beshayyfoy kedka yeut, kudesha berich hu ishtattaf (nusach acher ittakkaf) bahadeh, veail beh nishmata kaddisha. begin leolafa leh levar nash lemehach bearchoy deorayyta ulemitar pikkudoy, begin deyittakkan bar nash kedka yeut.

(Sefer acher uvegin da beod) (uvegin sefer acher uveod) deit beh nishmata kaddisha mibbae leh levar nash leasgaa diukena demalka illaa bealma. veraza da, deha hahu nahar denagid venafik la paskan memoy lealmin. veal da mibbae leh levar nash dela yafsik nahara umekora dileh behay alma (gillayon 255 247 lekayyeyma kaddisha dechatim bivsareh, deihu dugema dehahu 255 raza detzaddik deitchabbar 196 kachada leella, begin kach bae bar nash letatta leitchabbera beitteteh bikdushsha begin deittakkaf beh behahu alma). vechol zimna devar nash la yatzlach behay alma (sefer acher veal da mibbae leh levar nash dela yafsik nahara umekora dileh behay alma, vei lo) kudesha berich hu akar leh venata leh bechamma zimnin kemillekaddemin.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, hairoti mitztzafon vayyat. hairoti, da itaruta deziuuga devar nash behay alma, deihu itaruta missitra detzafon. vayat, da hi nishmata kaddisha deatya milleela, vekudesha berich hu meshadder lah milleela. atya behay alma vealat bego bene nasha kidkaamaran.

Mimmizrach shemesh, da atar dehahu nahar denagid venafik demittamman nafkat nishmata veitnehirat. veyavo seganim (kemo chomer) illen inun chelin dealma deatyayn begin (sefer acher bego) hahu itaruta denishmatin. kemo chomer, kegavvna deitar bar nash begufa.

Deha begin da, kudesha berich hu avid zivugin veattil nishmatin bealma, vechavruta ishtakkach leela vetatta umekora decholla hu (sefer acher yehe) baruch. ubbegin kach kudesha berich hu avad leh levar nash begin leishtaddala bearchoy, vela yafsik mekoreh umabbua dileh lealmin.

Vechol man defasik mekoreh, (mittatta umeyabbesh leh kivyachol keillu garim leh laatapesakea leella, keden (Iyov 14:11) azlu mayim minni yam venahar yecherav veyavesh, hoil uvar nash ittakam letatta kedugema dilella, man dimkoreh yamish millemebad perin, kegon din dela baa lemetav itteta, o nasiv la deishtaddal velo yachil, ellu ditren happakkin inun da mida, (o sefer acher hahu) daymaysh millemebad perin, let leh takkana leolam. (Kohelet 1:15) maavavet lo yachol letikkun, begin dela baa lemesav itteta uleishtaddela bifriyya ureviyya, vehahu deishtaddal venasav itteta velo yachil, da mittakken baperaykayh dekariv leh dehu achoy, vehahu demit belo benin) kad nafik mehay alma hahu bar nash la al befargoda vela natil chulak behahu alma (venishmateh lo itkelilat baatar dechol nishmatin itkelilu, veitgezar diyyukeneh mittamman. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:3) venichreta hannefesh hahi millifne, hoil ucheden hu, bara leh kudesha berich hu parik deyifrok leh mida dimchabbelin, veda achoy dekariv leh shenneemar (Devarim 25:5) ki yashvu achim yachdav vegomer. uchetiv ba el eshet achicha veyibbem otah vegomer. begin daneshametayh lo alat kammeh kudesha berich hu, ella hi keyama levar. begin dela zacha leanhara behay alma behahu gufa. man dela zacha behay atar, yehach laatar achara veyizke beh. kegavvna da aa dadelayk unehora lo salik ybetashevan leh visallek nehora beh vaynaheyr. aa hu adam dichtiv (sham 20) ki haadam etz hassade. retzono lomar bar nash kad ihu behay alma vaazal vateayb veachil ushete vaazadevaveg beitteta velo zache levinyan. da hu aa dadelayk unehora lo salik, kelomar nishmateh lo zachat behahu gufa leitnahara ella ihi bechashocha). ta chaze, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 45:18) lo tohu beraah leshevet yetzarah, dekudesha berich hu begin da avad leh levar nash kedka yeut kedamaran. vekudesha berich hu avad tivu im alma. ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 25:1) vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura, raza denishmata atat leittakkana kemilkaddemin.

Ta chaze, hahu gufa ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 53:10) vaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecholi im tasim asham nafsho yire zera yaarich yamim vechefetz Adonai beyado yitzlach. vaAdonai chafatz dakkeo, hay kera it leistakkala beh, ammay chafetz begin deyitdakke. im tasim asham, im yasim asham mibbae leh, may im tasim. ella lenishmata ahadar milla. i hahi nishmata baya leittakkana kedka yaot, yire zera. begin dehahi nishmata azlat veshatat veihi zemina leoola behahu zera deitassak bah bar nash bifriyya ureviyya, ucheden yaarich yamim. vechefetz Adonai da orayyta bideh atzlach.

Ta chaze, af al gav devar nash ishtaddal beorayyta yemama velelya, umekoreh umabbueh kayyma beh lemaggana, let leh atar leaala lefargoda. veha ittemar devera demaya i hahu mekora umabbua la al beh, lav ihu beer, devera umekora, kechada inun, veraza chada ihu, veokimna.

Ketiv, (Tehillim 127:2) shav lachem mashkime kum meachare shevet ochle lechem haatzavim ken yitten lidido shena. ta chaze, kamma chavivin inun mille deorayyta. dechol milla umilla deorayyta it beh razin illain kaddishin. veha ittemar dechad yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael, kol genizin illain kaddishin kullehu yahav lehu (vechullehu) beorayyta, vechullehu ityehivu lehu leyisrael beshata dekabbilu orayyta besinay.

Ta chaze, shav lachem mashkime kum, ilen inun yechidim deishtakkachu, delav inun dechar venukeva kedka yeut, veakdeman betzafra laavidtayhu. kema deat amer, (Kohelet 4:8) yesh echad veen sheni vegomer veen ketz lechol amalo. meachare shevet. meacharin nayycha, kema deat amer, ki vo shavat. begin deitteta legabbe bar nash ihi nayycha legabbeh vadday.

Ochle lechem haatzavim, may lechem haatzavim. dechad bar nash it leh benin, hahu nahama deachil, achil leh bechedva uviruta delibba. vehahu delet leh benin, hahu nahama deachil ihu nahama daatzivu. veillen inun ochle lechem haatzavim vadday.

Ken yitten lidido shena, may yitten lidido, da hu dimkoreh mevarach, dekudesha berich hu yahav leh shena behahu alma kema deat amer, (Mishlei 3:24) veshachavta vearva shenatecha. begin deit leh chulaka bealma deate. begin dehahu bar nash shachiv veyithanne behahu alma deate kedka yeut.

Yesh echad veen sheni vegomer. yesh echad, da hu bar nash deihu yechiday bealma, la yechiday kedka yeut, ella deihu bela ziuuga. veen sheni, delet immeh semech. gam ben, deyokim shemeh beyisrael la shavak. veach (en lo) leayytaa leh letikkuna.

Veen ketz lechol amalo, deihu amel tadir deakdim yemama velelya. gam eno lo tisba osher, velet leh libba leashgacha ulememar lemi ani amel umechasser et nafshi mittova. vei tema divgin deyechul veyishte yattir veyaaved mishtaya bechol yoma tadir, lav hachi. deha nafsha la ithanni minneh, ella vadday ihu mechasser lenafsheh mittivu dinhora dealma deate. begin deda hi nafsha chasra, dela ishtallimat kedka yeut. ta chaze, kamma chas kudesha berich hu al ovadoy, begin deka bae deyittakkan, vela yitavid mehahu alma deate kidkaamaran.

Ribbi chiyyay baa, hay deihu zakkaa shelema veishtedal beorayyta yome velele vechol ovadoy lishma dekudesha berich hu, vela zacha livnin behay alma kegon deishtaddal behu vela zacha, o dehavu leh umitu. ma inun lealma deate. amar leh ribbi yose, ovadoy vehahi orayyta, ka maginan aleh lehahu alma.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, alayyhu veal inun zakkae keshot, (kegon rabbi yochanan dahavo leh benin umitu, uchegon rabbi chizkiyya deihu ikkar) alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) ko amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay uvacharu baasher chafatzti umachazikim bivriti. ma ketiv batreh, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo asher lo yikkaret. begin deillen it lon chulaka lealma deate. amar leh ribbi yose, yaot hu veshappir.

Ta chaze, zakkaa shelim dehavu kol illen beh, veishtelim kedka yeut, umit bela benin, veha ka yarit ducheteh behahu alma, itteteh baya livume o la. i tema delibbae livume, ha berekanya ihu, deha atreh ka yarit behahu alma.

Ella vadday baya livume, begin dela yadinan i hava shelim beovadoy i lav. vehi i ityaybmat la hava berekanya. begin deatar it leh lekudesha berich hu deha (30) bar nash (4) hava bealma umit bela benin ufuraka la have leh bealma, kevan demit hay zakkaa shelim veittete ityaybmat, veihu atreh yarit. ata hahu bar nash veishtallim hacha, uven kach uven kach kudesha berich hu, atar zammin leh (lealma) (bealma) ad deyemut hay zakkaa shelim, veyishtelim ihu bealma. hada hu dichtiv (Bamidbar 35:28) ki veir miklato yeshev ad mot hakkohen haggadol vegomer.

Veda hu detaninan, benin zeminin inun letzaddikaya bemitathon, bechayyehon la zachu uvemitathon zachu. uvegin kach kol ovadoy dekudesha berich hu kullehu keshot uzechu, (sefer acher vechayis) vechayyim al kolla.

(Kohelet 4:9) tovim hashshenayim min haechad asher yesh lahem sachar tov baamalam, illen inun demitassekin behay alma leolada benin. deinun benin deshavku, beginehon it lon agar tav behahu alma, uveginehu yartin avahan dilhon chulaka behahu alma veukemuha.
Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu nata ilanin behay alma i atzlachu yaot, la atzlachu aakar lon veshatal lon afillu kamma zimnin. ubbegin kach kol archoy dekudesha berich hu kullehu letav uleatkana alma:

Bo el eshet achicha veyabbem otah, deha yehuda vechullehu shivtin havu yade da. veikkera demilleta, vehakem zera. begin dehahu zera itzterich leittakkana milla ulemiglam golama letikkuna dela yitperash giza mishsharsheh kedka yeut, hada hu dichtiv (iyyov la) veadam al afar yashuv.

Vechad mittakkan levatar kedka yaot, illen mishtabbechin behahu alma begin dekudesha berich hu itrae behu. uvegin kach ketiv, (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, dayyka. min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim adenna. may adenna, kema deat amer (Bereshit 18:12) achare veloti hayta li edna. uchetiv (iyyov 33:25) yashuv lime alumav.

Vetov mishshenihem et asher aden lo haya (dela shav lime alumav) asher lo raa et hammaase hara asher naasa tachat hashshemesh. vetov mishshenihem et asher aden lo haya, dela shav lime alumav vela itzterich leittakkana, vela savil chovin kadmae, begin dekudesha berich hu yahav leh atar metakna behahu alma kedka yaot.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Kohelet 8:10) uvechen raiti reshaim kevurim vegomer, kema deittemar. begin dekudesha berich hu avid tivu vela vaa leshetzaa alma ella kema deittemar, vechol archoy kullehu keshot uzechu leotava lehu behay alma uvealma deate. zakkaa chulekehon detzaddikayay deinun azle beorach keshot, alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 37:29) tzaddikim yirshu aretz:
Zohar, Vayeshev 21: Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vattissa eshet adonav et eneha el yosef. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 103:20) barchu Adonai malachav gibbore choach ose devaro lishmoa bekol devaro. ta chaze, kamma itzterich leh levar nash leistammera mechovoy, ulemehach beorach mittakkena. begin dela yiste leh hahu yetzer hara, deihu mekatrega leh kol yoma veyoma, kema deittemar.

Uvegin deihu mekatrega leh tadir, bae bar nash leittakkefa aleh, uleistalleka aleh beatar takkifu. devae lemeheve gavar aleh, uleishtattefa beatar digvura. begin dechad var nash itkaf aleh, keden ihu bistar gevura, veitdabbak beh leittakkefa. uvegin dehahu yetzer hara takkif, bae var nash dihe takkif mineh.

Veillen bene nasha deittakkefu aleh, ikrun gibbore choach, leishtakkecha zina im zineh. veillen inun malachav dekudesha berich hu, deatyayn missitra digvura kashya, leittakkefa aleh, gibbore koach ose devaro. barchu Adonai malachav, keyosef, deikre tzaddik vegibbor venatar berit kaddisha deitreshim begavveh.

Ribbi elazar amar, vayhi achar haddevarim haelle, may hi, ha ukemuha atar da deyetzer hara mekatreg, deihu darga achar haddevarim. begin deyosef yahav leh ducheta lekatraga, dehava yosef mesalsel besaareh veatkin garmeh vekashshit leh, keden ityehiv ducheta layetzer hara lekatrega. deamar, uma avoy deihu mitabbel aleh, veyosef mekashshit garmeh, umesalsel besaareh, keden itgare beh dubba vekatrig leh:

Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle. ta chaze, bezimna dekudesha berich hu ashgach beh bealma, lemedan yateh, veashkach chayyayvin bealma, ma ketiv, (Devarim 11:17) veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar vehaadama lo titten et yevulah, ucheden vaavadtem mehera. deha begin chovin divne nasha, shemaya veara itatzaru, vela nahage nimmusehon kedka yeut.

Veta chaze, inun dela natru lehay keyayma dekudesha, garme perishu ben yisrael laavuhon devishmaya, begin dichtiv vesartem vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem, uchetiv veatzar et hashshamayim velo yihye matar. dehay ihu keman desagid lelaha ochora, dimshakker behay at keyayma kaddisha.

Vechad keyayma kaddisha itnetir bealma kedka yaot, keden kudesha berich hu yahiv birchan leela leatraka bealma. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 68:10) geshem nedavot tanif elohim nachalatcha venila atta chonanta. geshem nedavot, da geshem diruta. kad itrae kudesha berich hu bichneset yisrael, uvae laaraka lah birchan, keden nachalatcha venila atta chonanta.

Nachalatcha, inun yisrael, deinun achsanteh dekudesha berich hu. kema deat amer, (Devarim 32:9) yaakov chevel nachalato. venila, da keneset yisrael, deihi nila beara ochora, deihi tzachya lemishte, ucheden ihi nila. vechad hahu geshem diruta ityehiv, keden atta konanta.

Veal da, shemaya veara, vechol chelehon, kullehu kayyma al kiyyuma da. dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. ubbegin kach bae leizdahara beda, veha ukemuha. uvegin kach ketiv, vayhi yosef yefe toar vife mare, uvatreh ketiv vattissa eshet adonav et eneha el yosef.
Zohar, Vayeshev 23: Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle chatu mashke melech mitzrayim vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach, (Amos 3:4) hayishag arye bayyaar veteref en lo hayitten kefir kolo mimmeonato bilti im lachad. hayishag arye bayyaar. ta chaze, kamma it lon livne nasha leashgacha befulechana dekudesha berich hu. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, uvefulechana dekudesha berich hu, dachalteh veemateh hu al kolla. deha kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, avad kol biryayn dealma, kol chad vechad bediukeneh kedka chaze leh. ulevatar bara leh levar nash bediukena illaa, veshalteh al kullehu, bediukena da.

Dechol zimna devar nash kaim bealma, kol inun biryayn dealma zakfin resha, umistakkelan bediukena illaa devar nash. keden kullehu dachalin vezain mikkammeh, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz veal kol of hashshamayim vegomer, vehanne mile, kad mistakkelan vechaman beh, hay diukena, venishmata beh.

Amar ribbi elazar, af al gav denishmata lav beh, tzaddikaya la mishtanyayn mikkema dehava deyukenhon bekadmita. vechad bar nash la azil bearchoy deorayyta, hay diukena kaddisha itchallaf leh. ucheden chevat bera veofa dishmaya yachlin leshalletaa aleh, begin deitchallaf leh hay diukena kaddisha, itchallaf leh hay diukena devar nash.

Veta chaze, kudesha berich hu achlaf ovadin dilela vetatta, begin leahadara millin leatrayyhu, uleishtakkecha reuteh bechol ovade dealma. daniyyel la ishtanne diukeneh kad appilu leh beguva dearyevata, uvegin kach ishteziv. amar ribbi chizkiyya, i hachi, ha ketiv, (Daniel 6:23) elahi shelach malacheh usagar pum aryavata vela chabbeluni. mashma divgin malacha deasgar lefumayyhu, la itchabbal.

Amar leh, begin da la itchabbal, deha hahu diukeneh devar nash zakkaa, ihu malacha mammash, disgir puma, vekashir lon, lenatra leh, dela yechabbelun leh. ubbegin kach elahi shelach malacheh, hahu dechol diukenin dealma mitchakkekan beh, veihu atkif diukeni bi, vela yachilu leshaltaa bi, vesagar pumayyhu, veal da shalach malacheh vadday.

Vehay malacha, hahu dechol diukenin mitchakkekan beh. dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:6) yadin baggoyim male geviyyot, ihu dela ishtanne kammeh kol diukenin dealma. veal da mibbae leh levar nash, leistammera archoy usheviloy, begin dela yechota kammeh demareh, veyitkayyaym bediukena deadam.

Ta chaze, yechezkel natar pumeh mimmaachale deissure, dichtiv, (ychezakealed) vela ba befi besar piggul, zacha veikre ben adam. daniyyel ma ketiv beh, (Daniel 1:8) vayyasem daniyyel al libbo asher la yitgaal befat bag hammelech uveyen mishtav, zacha hu, veitkeyyaym bidiukeneh deadam. begin dechol millin dealma, kullehu dachalin mikkamme diukena deadam, deihu shallita al kullehu, veihu malka al kolla.

Amar ribbi yose, begin da itzterich leh levar nash, leistammera mechovoy, vela yiste limina velismala. veim kol da, bae leh levar nash lemivdak bechovoy bechol yoma veyoma. deha kad var nash kaim mearseh, teren sahadin kayymin kammeh, veazle bahadeh kol yoma.

Bae bar nash lemekam, inun sahade amrin leh beshata deaftach enoy, (Mishlei 4:25) enecha lenochach yabbitu veafappecha yayshiru negdecha. kam veatkin ragloy lemehach, inun sahadin amrin leh, (sham) palles magal raglecha vegomer. veal da kad azil var nash, bechol yoma, bae leh leistammera mechovoy.

Bechol yoma veyoma, kad ate lelya, bae leistakkela ulemivdak, bechol ma deavad kol hahu yoma. begin deyetuv minnayyhu, veyistakkel behu tadir, begin deyetuv kamme mareh. kema deat amer (Tehillim 51:5) vechattati negdi tamid, begin deyetuv minnayyhu.

Veta chaze, bezimna dehavu yisrael beara kaddisha, la ishtakkach bidayyhu chova, kema deukemuha. begin deinun karbanin, dehavu makrivin bechol yoma, havu mechappere alayyhu. hasheta deitgalon yisrael meara, velet man dimchapper alayyhu, orayyta hi mechappera alayyhu, veovadin dechashran, begin dishchinta immehon begaluta. uman deihu la mistakkal bearchoy dekudesha berich hu, garim lishchinta leitkafya bego afra, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 26:5) yashpilenna yashpilah ad aretz vegomer.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, vechen man deishtaddal beorayyta uveovadin dechashran, garim lah lekneset yisrael, laarama resha bego galuta. zakkaa chulakehon deinun demishtaddele beorayyta yemama velele.

Ta chaze, gilgel kudesha berich hu gilgulin bealma, begin laarama resha detzaddikayay, deha begin deyarim yosef resheh bealma, al deishtakkach zakkaa kammeh, argiz ribbona al avdoy. kema deat amer chatu mashke melech mitzrayim vehaofe laadonehem lemelech mitzrayim. vecholla begin laarama resha deyosef zakkaa. veta chaze, al yeda dechelma, itkafyay meim achoy, veal yeda dechelma itrabbe al achoy, veitrabbe al kol alma:

Vayyachalmu chalom shenehem ish chalomo belayla echad ish kefitron vegomer, ta chaze, deha ittemar dechol chelmin azlin batar puma, yosef kad pashar lehu chelma, ammay pashar lehay pishra tava, ulehay pishra bisha. ella, inun chelmin aleh deyosef hava, uvegin deyada milla al ikkara vesharsha dilah, begin kach pashar chelma lehu kema deitzterich. lechol chad vechad pashar lehon pishra, leahadara milla al atreh.

Ma ketiv vayyomer alehem yosef halo lelohim pitronim sapperu na li. may tama, begin dehachi mibbae leh lemifshar chelma, lefakda pishra lekudesha berich hu, begin detamman ihu kiyyuma decholla, uveh kayyma pishra.
