Ta chaze, ha ittemar dedarga dechelma letatta ihu, veihu darga shetitaa. begin deha meatar dinvua sharya ad hay darga dechelma, shitta dargin inun. vesalka pishra middarga dechelma, ledarga ochora. chelma ihu darga diltatta, ufishra kayyma alayyhu. ufishra kayyma bedibbur, veal da bedibbur kayyma milla. dichtiv halo lelohim pitronim, halo lelohim vadday.

rashi: Vaysapper el aviv veel echav. leachar shessipper oto leechav chazar vesippero leaviv bifnehem:
Vayyigar bo. lefi shehaya metil sina alav:

Havo navo. vahalo immecha chevar meta, vehu lo haya yodea shehaddevarim maggiin levilha sheggiddelattu keimmo. verabbotenu lamdu mikkan sheen chalom belo devarim betelim, veyaakov nitkavven lehotzi haddavar millev banav shello yakniuhu, lechach amar lo havo navo vegomer – keshem shei efshar beimmecha kach hashshear hu vatel:
ohc: Vayyigar bo vegomer. lehasir kinat haachim, vesatar hachalom bekushyat "ani veimmecha", ki mehammenia hammuchletet hi. vehattaam ki lo yaale al haddaat ki bene yaakov tassigem haggedulla mehaummot ella davka meavihem, umeatta en metziut sheyyishtachave lo aviv, umimmela satar hachalom bifne haachim, ulevavo lo ken yachshov.

rashi: Hayishag arye bayyaar veteref en lo. keshearye ochez teref darko lishog, veeno shoeg ella im ken lachad, vechen hu omer "yishag kakkefirim veyinhom veyochez teref" (Yeshayahu 5:29), vechen "kaasher yehge hakkefir vehaarye al tarpo" (Yeshayahu 31:4):
targum: Hayinhom arye bechuresha vetzeda let leh hayerim bar aryevan kaleh mimarbuateh elahen im achad:

rashi: Lemaan hatztzil oto. ruach hakkodesh meida al reuven shello amar zot ella lehatztzil oto sheyyavo hu veyaalennu mishsham, amar ani vechor vegadol shebbechullan, lo yittale hasserachon ella vi:

Yamim rabbim. 22 shana, mishshepperesh mimmennu ad sheyyarad yaakov lemitzrayim, shenneemar yosef ben sheva esre shana vegomer, uven sheloshim shana haya beamdo lifne faro, vesheva shene hassava, ushenatayim haraav keshebba yaakov lemitzrayim, hare 22 shana, keneged 22 shana shello kiyyem yaakov kibbud av vaem (Megila 16) – 20 shana shehaya bevet lavan, uv shana vadderech beshuvo mibbet lavan, shana vachetzi vesukkot veshishsha chodashim bevet el – vezehu sheamar lelavan ze li esrim shana bevetecha, li hen, alay, vesofi lilkot kenegdan:
Nissachti merosh. leshon nesiche bene adam (Micha 5:4):
targum: Umin kodam alma ittaknet min resheh umin kodam deteheve ara:

rashi: Ba elay. letzachek bi haeved haivri asher heveta lanu:
ohc: Vattedabber elav vegomer lemor. perush amro lemor ki chen yomru anshe habbayit edim baddavar, velaze timtza shello chara appo al yosef ella al ma shennatna chozek lidvareha mehodaot hazzulat, vehu amro kishmoa adonav vegomer lemor kaddevarim vegomer, ki lo haya tzarich hakkatuv lomar ella "kishmoa adonav divre ishto", ella nitkavven lomar shello chara appo ella kesheshshama sheyyesh maggidim al haddevarim, vehu amro "lemor kaddevarim" vegomer. od yitbaer besamuch:

Lemor kaddevarim vegomer. perush, lo sheheemin bah ki kidvareha ken haya, ella letzad sheamra ishto ken asa tenua ketanna, velaze lo yissero velo asa lo davar kammishpat hannaase leeved hannoten enav beeshet adono.

rashi: Bi melachim yimlochu. shehaddinim vehammishpatim ani melammedam:
targum: Metul ana malche milchin veshalite ana mashcha vetzidkuta:

rashi: Kemishlosh chodashim. rubbo shel rishon verubbo shel acharon veemtzai shalem (nidda 90). uleshon kemishlosh chodashim kehishtallesh hachodashim, kemo umishloach manot (Ester 9), mishloach yadam (Yeshayahu 11), vechen tirgem unkelos kitlatut yarchayya:
Hara liznunim. shem davar, meubberet kemo ishsha hara, uchemo bara kachamma:
Vetissaref. amar efrayim mikshaa mishshum rabbi meir, bitto shel shem hayta, shehu chohen, lefichach danuha visrefa:
ohc: Hotziuha vetissaref. hattaam mishshum devet din shel shem gazru al zenut im haummot, keamram (avoda zara lo:), umashma afillu en sham issur erva lo haasura livne noach velo haasura leyisrael, af al pi chen gazru aleha. veulay ki masoret hayta beyadam ligzor gezerot velaharog haover al haggezera. velaze kesheyyada ki immo hayu haddevarim niftera, ki haggezera hayta al zenut goy davka. veen bah gam ken issur erva ki kallato mutteret leven noach. ulefi divrehem sheamru (sota 10:) "velo yasaf ledatah" shello pasak mimmenna od, hare ze maggid ki haav haya meyabbem lechallato.

rashi: Niftal veikkesh. akmumiyyut:
targum: Uvetzidkuta inun kol memre fumi velet behon pittula veikuma:

rashi: Arom yanus vegomer. artilay belo keli zayin:
targum: Udetakif libbeh begibbaraya artila dela zeyan yaarok beyoma hahu amar Adonai:

rashi: Mecharutz. mimmine hazzahav hu:
targum: Kabbilu marduta vela chaspa ugevu lechon yediata min dahava senina:

rashi: Im yittaka shofar. shehatztzofe roe geyasot baim bair vetokea bashshofar lehazehir et haam, en ellu ella divre mashal vedimyon:

Hayishag arye. hu nevuchadnetztzar. davar acher: hanneviim medammin et ruach hakkodesh habba alehem lishagat arye kemo sheamru lematta "arye shaag mi lo yira", vechan ze perush haddugema: hayavo ruach hakkodesh befi hanneviim ledabber davar meet hakkadosh baruch hu leraa ella im ken happureanut nigzar millefanav, zehu hatteref. hayitten hakkadosh baruch hu kolo ledabber kashe bilti im lachad etchem bemokesh avon. hatippol tzippor al pach. veen happach machshilah, kelomar vechi efshar sheattem ovrim averot velo yihye lachem lemokesh. hayaale pach vegomer. kach hayaale avonotechem lemala velo yilkedu etchem. im yittaka shofar beir. kach haya lachem lihyot charedim el divre hanneviim shehem tzofim lachem lemallet etchem min haraa shello tavo, ucheshettavo lachem haraa halo tedu ki hakkadosh baruch hu ose lachem al shello nizhartem binviav.
targum: Im yitka shofara bekarta bela zimneh veama di vah la yezuun im tehe vishta bekarta umin kodam Adonai la itabbedat:

rashi: Yissa faro et roshecha. l cheshbon, kesheyyifkod shear avadav lesharet lefanav basseuda, yimne otcha immahem:
Kannecha. basis shellecha umoshavcha:
Vayyet elav chased. shehaya mekubbal lechol roav, leshon "kalla naa vachasuda" shebbammishna:
ohc: Vayhi Adonai et yosef vayyet vegomer. perush, ki behasheraat shechina al haadam yushepa hannismach mehammashre shechinato mimma shebbo, veyadua hu chen hammakom baruch hu ki hu mekor hachen, vehu amro "vayhi Adonai et yosef" uvaze "vayyet elav chased" perush, mimmela, veamro vayyitten chinno leheyot ki lo targish bechinat hara bemetek hachen, laze hutzerach Adonai leharekiv been sar bet hassohar emtzai learev elav chen tzaddik, vehu amro "vayyitten chinno beene" vegomer, vehaven:

rashi: Ven zekunim. shennolad lo leet ziknato. veunkelos tirgem bar chakkim hu le – kol ma shellamad mishshem vaever masar lo. davar acher, shehaya ziv ikonin shelo dome lo:
Passim. leshon keli melat, kemo karpas utechelet, uchemo ketonet happassim detamar veamnon, umia ashe tzarotav, shennimkar lefotifar velassocharim velayyishmeelim velammidyanim:
ohc: Veyisrael ahav vegomer. hikdim latet taam lemastematam shel achim leach katan veamar veyisrael vegomer, perush ki hagam sheyyosef hotzi dibbat echav, af al pi chen lo haya davar ra yotze, ki hayu haachim mitvakkechim immo umochichim oto vesara kinatam. ella letzad ki nosaf davar ze sheahav yisrael vegomer mikkol echav, perush yoter mikkullan yachad, gam pirsem haahava vehodiah lahem bema sheasa lo ketonet passim, vahare ze maggid sheyyadu veyada avihen sheyyadu, vehu amro vayyiru echav ki vegomer. umeatta bevo hassina lo haya lah tikva letakken velasum shalom, vehu amro vayyisneu oto, perush mimma shekkadam maasav shehevi dibbatam raa velo yachlu vegomer, letzad roam ki hu ahuv mikkullan leaviv en metziut lehitvakkeach immo ki devarav yitzdeku velo divrehem, vechevan sheenam yecholin lehaemido betochachat megulla sheyyikkalem al asher asahu velo yashuv od baddavar hazze en metziut lachzor bo. vehu amro velo yachlu dabbero bekoshi leshalom, perush laasot beemtzaut ze shalom.

rashi: Vattashku et hannezirim yayin. shello yoru etchem, shehashshikkor asur lehorot. vattashku et hannezirim yayin, tirgem yonatan: veatetun yat malfechon bechamra:
Lo tinnavu. leamos tzivva ken amatzya kohen bet el: "choze berach lecha el eretz yehuda" (lekamman 7:12):
targum: Veatitun yat malfechon bechamra veal neviyaya pakedtun lememar la titnabbun nevua:

rashi: Ra beene Adonai. keraato shel onan, mashchit zaro, shenneemar beonan vayyamet gam oto, kemitato shel er mitato shel onan. velamma haya er mashchit zaro? kede shello titabber veyachchish yafyah:
Et kuttonto. ze chaluk:
Et ketonet happassim. hu shehosif lo aviv yoter al echav:
ohc: Vayyafshitu et yosef vegomer. lefi peshat hakkatuv, amro kuttanto hu hechaluk, ketonet happassim hu levush haelyon sheasa lo aviv. ulefi ze haya lehakedim hafeshatat levush haelyon shehu ketonet happassim. ulehavin kavvanat hakkatuv yesh ledakdek od lamma lo amar "veet ketonet happassim".

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi shehaachim leolam lo ratzu lehafeshito lachalutin ulehannicho arom, ella lehasir mealav ketonet happassim shebbah hayta hakkina bo, umodia hakkatuv ki keshehesiru ketonet happassim berov hakkaas vehassina lo dikdeku lehasir otah bemittun uvenachat ruach, ella besina gedola uvechol kach achzariyyut ad shehesiru immah gam hakketonet shehu hechaluk. veze hu shiur hakkatuv vayyafshitu et yosef, perush, lo nishar ki im gufo shel yosef arom, ki hesiru et kuttanto shehu hechaluk im ketonet happassim keshehesiru mealav belo chavvana.
Veamro asher alav. nitkavven lehagedil haddavar, ki ketonet happassim hi hayta malbush haelyon, vehesiru kol habbegadim vegam hechaluk, kullam yachad immah, merov hakkaas vehassina.

rashi: Hiv mutzet. lehissaref:

Vehi shalcha el chamiha. lo ratzta lehalebin panav velomar mimmecha ani meubberet, ella leish asher elle lo, amra im yode yode meatzmo, veim lav, yisrefuni, veal albin panav. mikkan amru noach lo laadam sheyyappiluhu lechivshan haesh veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim:
Hakker na. en na ella leshon bakkasha – hakker na voraacha, veal teabbed shalosh nefashot:

Vayyishmeu. vekabbilu minne, vechol shemia shehi kabbalat devarim kegon ze, uchegon vayyishma yaakov el aviv, naase venishma – meturgam nekabbel; vechol shehi shemiat haozen, kegon vayyishmeu et kol Adonai elohim mithallech baggan, verivka shomaat, vayyishma yisrael, shamati et telunnot – kullan meturgam ushemau, ushemaat, ushema, shemia kodamay:
Yirat Adonai senot ra. zehu hammusar shehachachma machrezet labberiyyot:
targum: Dechalta daAdonai sanya vishta geuta veramuta vearcha vishta ufuma haficha sanya ana:

rashi: Vayyomer ketonet beni. hi zo:

Chayya raa achalathu. nitznetza vo ruach hakkodesh, sofo shettitgare vo eshet potifar. velamma lo gilla lo hakkabba? lefi shehecherimu vekillelu et kol mi sheyyegalle, veshittefu lehakkabba immahem (tanchuma), aval yitzchak haya yodea shehu chay, amar heach agalle vehakkabba eno rotze legallot lo:
ohc: Tarof toraf. nitkavven lomar ki shete terefot nitraf: haachat shetterafattu chayya vaharagattu, vehashsheniyya shettarfa gufo limonatah, shebbaze nityaesh levakkesh achar atzmotav lekavram. vezulat ze haya kashe lamma lo hishtaddel yaakov lechappes achar atzmot yosef lekayyem bahem mitzvat kevura, vehem haachim nitchakkemu veamru "zot matzanu", perush, levaddah belo atzamot immah, umizze hirgish ki hachayya gorarto limonatah, velaze lo hitricham lechappes od achar atzmotav:

rashi: Veyosef hurad. chozer leinyan rishon, ella shehifsik bo kede lismoch yeridato shel yehuda limchirato shel yosef lomar shebbishvilo horiduhu miggedullato, veod kede lismoch maase ishto shel potifar lemaase tamar lomar lecha, ma zo leshem shamayim af zo leshem shamayim, sheraata veitzterologin shellah sheatida lehaamid banim mimmennu, veenah yodaat im mimmenna im mibbittah:

ohc: Shimu na hachalom. taam amro "na". lema shepperashti shello hayu rotzim lishmoa, amar lahem "na" leshon bakkasha:

O yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 56.) ki ikkar pitron hachalom hu davka beyomo velo beyom acher, velaze mitannin taanit chalom afillu beshabbat veeno nidche leyom acher. laze amar na perush, atta, velo teacharu lizman acher kede sheyyitkayyem. gam yechavven lomar lahem leval yachshevu oto ki kevar halach lerachamav vididav vesipper lahem hachalom ufitrono letova higgidu, uchefi ze batla machshavto hattova shechashav lekarev livvot echav kemo shepperashti bappasuk shellifne ze, ki en hochacha shebbechezkat ohavim hem ki kevar kadam ikkar happitron ufetaruhu letova, ot laze lo chash lavo etzlam shehagam sheyyifteruhu leraa kevar nitkayyem kappitron harishon, laze amar "na". veim tomar vahalo amru beharoe (berachot noah.) amar rabbi benaa, paam achat chalamti chalom echad vehalachti etzel esrim vearbaa potre chalom shehayu birushalayim, uma sheppatar li ze lo patar li ze, vechullam nitkayyemu bi, ad kan. ulay davka sheen happitronim sotrim, aval im hem sotrim en poter sheni motzi mippitron rishon. vechash yosef sheyyadunu oto baze, veamar shimu na perush, atta hu mesapper haddavar velo kodem sippero lezulat.
Hachalom hazze. amro hei hayedia, leheyot shekkevar higgid lahem shechalom chalam velo peresh hachalom, vechazar lomar: shimu na hachalom hazze shehiggadti lachem shechalamti.

rashi: Reshit darko. kodem beriato shel olam (fesachim ned.):
targum: Elaha varani beresh biryeteh umin kodam ovadoy min resh:

rashi: Vayyet eleha el hadderech. midderech shehaya vah, nata el hadderech asher hi bah, uvilshon laaz dashetaveraneyr:
Hava na. hachini atzmech vedatech lechach. kol leshon hava leshon hazemana hiv, chutz mimmakom sheyyesh letargemo bilshon netina, veaf otan shel hazemana kerovim lilshon netina hem:
Tzar useviv haaretz. hatztzar muchan lavo useviv laaretz hazzot yavo:
targum: Bechen kidnan amar Adonai elohim aka takifa leara veyibbatel minich tokfech veyitbazun birneyatayich:

rashi: Vehaya vichziv. shem hammakom. veomer ani al shem sheppaska milledet nikra cheziv, leshon hayo tihye li kemo achzav (Yirmeyahu 15), asher lo yechazzevu memav (Yeshayahu 58), veim lo chen ma ba lehodienu? uvivra raiti, vattikra shemo shela vgomer pesakat:
Vayyashov reuven. bimchirato lo haya sham, shehiggia yomo lelech uleshammesh et aviv. davar acher asuk haya vesakko uvetaanito al shebbilbel yetzue aviv:
ohc: Vayyashav reuven vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma taanat reuven al echav beamro vaani ana vegomer, halo gam laatzato haya yosef avud babbor. vahagam sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 37:22) "lemaan hatztzil" vegomer lahashivo el aviv, ze haya belibbo lo befiv el echav, veharaya sheamar yehuda (Bereshit 37:26) "ma betza ki naharog et achinu" vegomer achar shehaya babbor. ha lamadta ki hashelachato babbor hayta lahariga, uchemo shepperashnu lemala. umeatta ma maane bilshono "hayyeled vegomer vaani" vegomer?

Achen kavvanat reuven hi ki letzad heyoto hu habbechor, oto yatriach aviv lalechet lechappes acharav missof haolam vead sofo. veim haya babbor haya mevio met mehachayyot shebbabbor, vehaya meshiv leaviv "hinne hu met, chayya raa achalathu", ma sheen ken atta ana yelech meruchot haolam levaksho. vehu amro vaani ana ani va, velaze nitchakkemu vayyishchatu seir izzim vegomer, uvaze salka lah taromet reuven.

rashi: Vehabbor rek en bo mayim. mimmashma shenneemar vehabbor rek, eni yodea sheen bo mayim, ma talmud lomar en bo mayim? mayim en bo, aval nechashim veakrabbim yesh bo (Bereshit Rabba, shabbat 22):

Vayhi baet hahiv. lamma nismecha farasha zo lechan, vehifsik befarashato shel yosef? lelammed shehoriduhu echav miggedullato kesherau vetzarat avihem, amru: atta amarta lemachro, illu amarta lahashivo hayinu shomim lecha:
Vayyet. meet echav:
Ad ish adullami. nishtattef immo:
ohc: Vayyered yehuda vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sota 13) shehoriduhu echav miggedullato, vehaggaon rabbi avraham ibben ezra amar ki tamo ki habba mippeat tzafon shel olam lidromo hu yored, ad kan. devarav tzodkim im lo haya omer hakkatuv tevat "meet echav", shemmore beetzba ki hayerida hayta meechav, od amro vayyet ad ish vegomer, uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha yavo hakkatuv al nachon ki "vayyered" leshon yerida yechavven, vetevat "vayyet" itzterich legufo.

rashi: Chotamcha ufetilecha. izketach veshoshippach – tabbaat sheata chotem bah vesimlatcha sheatta mitkasse vah:
Vattahar lo. gibborim kayyotze vo, tzaddikim kayyotze vo.
Beterem harim hatbau. betoch hammayim:
targum: Kedim ad la nitbeun ture ukedam ramata itbenet:

rashi: Asher al yado hashshani. arba yadot ketuvot kan keneged arbaa charamim shemmaal achan sheyyatza mimmennu. veyesh omrim keneged arbaa devarim shellakach, adderet shinar ushete chatichot kesef shel matayim shekalim uleshon zahav, bereshit rabba:
Vayyikra shemo zarach. al shem zerichat marit hashshani:
Tzadka. bidvareha:

Mimmenni. hi meubberet. verabbotenu zichrono livracha darshu sheyyatza vat kol veamra mimmenni umeitti yatzu haddevarim, lefi shehayta tzenua bevet chamiha, gazarti sheyyetzu mimmenna melachim, umishshevet yehuda gazarti lehaamid melachim beyisrael:
Ki al ken lo netattiha. ki bedin asta, al asher lo netattiha leshela veni:
Velo yasaf od. yesh omrim lo hosif, veyesh omrim lo fasak. vachavero gabbe eldad umedad, velo yasafu, umetargeminan vela pesaku:
ohc: Tzadka mimmenni. lefi ma shekkatavnu lemala, ki ma sheppasku dinah lisrefa haya letzad shebbet dino shel shem gazru al zenut haggoy. achar shennitgalla sheim yehuda zinneta, hi yoter tzaddeket mihuda, ki yehuda lo yada ki challato hi uvechezkat goya hayta uva aleha veavar al gezerat bet dino shel shem, vehu amro "tzadka mimmenni". veze hu shiur hakkatuv: tzadka bidvareha, umimmela tzadka bedinah, veod lah shehi yoter mimmenni betzidkut mittaam shekkatavti. velo nitchayyev yehuda al hodaato shebba aleha bechezkat goya, kevan shekkefi haemet lo goya hayta, vedavar ze dome lemitkavven leechol chatichat chelev veala beyado chatichat shuman.

Veim tomar: sof kol sof bishat maase shebbechezkat goya ba aleha, lamma avar al gezerat bet din? laze kevar tertzu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba parasha 85) ki meAdonai mitzade gaver vetikken alilot lehotzi laor taalumot. vetze ulemad ma shepperashnu befarashat vaychi befasuk (Bereshit 49:9) "gur arye" vegomer:

Ki al ken lo netattiha vegomer. perush, lefi ma sheamar "tzadka yoter mimmenni", gamar omer ki gam lo asta peritzut, ki tamah al asher lo netattiha leshela beni. raata ki avda tikvatah, laze asta haddavar hazze.
O yirtze lomar ki hu haggorem lah laasot ken letzad shello netanah leshela, vehu amro tzadka hi bemaaseha, umimmenni perush, mitztziddi ani hayiti sibba lah ki lo netattiha vegomer:

rashi: Sheloshet yamim hem. siman hem lecha lishloshet yamim, veyesh midreshe aggada harebe (chullin 92):
Vayyifkod sar hattabbachim et yosef. lihyot ittam:
Vayyihyu yamim bemishmar. shenem asar chodesh:

ohc: Haggida na vegomer. tzarich ladaat bamme yada ki shoalo yodea ayye mekom kevodam, lomar elav bifshitut "haggida na". veulay diyyek divre hashshoel beamro "lemor ma tevakkesh", ki tevat "lemor" meyutteret. nitkavven lomar kesheshshaal oto ki hu yomar elav mevukkasho, ki zulat ze en makom lishelat ish nachri asher lo achiv hu levakkesh ladaat ma hu mevakkesh, ella shennitkavven lomar ki shoalo lehaggid lo davar nelam mimmennu, velaze heshivo "et achay anochi mevakkesh" veyavou devarecha atta lehaggid li efo hem roim.

Vayyachalom yosef vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma haya yosef magdil hassina bema shehaya mesapper chalomot gedullato maggidot, uma gam achar yado ki hu sanuy beenehem, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 84:11) befasuk "vayyomer lo hinneni", shemmasar atzmo lemita. veulay ki nitkavven lehodia otam ki min hashshamayim heeluhu lemala, umaase yaakov hi behasekamat elyonim, umizze yechdelu misseno oto.

O yechavven lehodiam ki adayin yitztarchu elav veyavou veyishtachavu lo, veulay ki beyadam ken yarchiku hassina, leval yinkom mehem leet yippelu lefanav, ki hashshevatim yachofu rosham ligzerat el elyon ulemitzbeye.

O yechavven lekarev hallevavot yachad, vehu al derech amram beferek haroe (berachot noah:) ki chol hachalomot holchim achar happe. veamru od sheyyelech etzel merachame leh (rosh sham) veyifterennu lo, veyosef chashav shebbesappero chalomotav lahem yadunu beatzman ki libbo shalem immahem kemishpat haachim haahuvim. uletzad shekkadma sina vekina – ninalu shaare haahava belibbam, vehayu danim hakkol lehistarrut alehem vechulei:

Vayyachalom yosef vegomer. hakkatuv yaid alav ki chalam, lishlol chashad shehaya bode millibbo shechalam lehistarer alehem. gam bachalom sheni hodia hakkatuv (Bereshit 37:9) "vayyachalom" lehatzedik divre yosef.

Vayyagged leechav. perush, shechalam chalom tov shebbaze hayu beenehem kashim kaggidim, velo hizkir hakkatuv hachalom ki hu sheamar besamuch "shimu na", veen lomar shehaya chalom acher, sheim ken lamma lo hodio hakkatuv, veim letzad shello nitkayyem, lamma yesapper hakkatuv chalom shav yedabber. veim lehodia sibbat hassina hinne yaspik hakkodem ushene hachalomot. ella vadday shehu hachalom sheamar besamuch, umittechilla amar lahem setam chalom maala chalamti, uletzad shello hayu rotzim lishmoa lo chalomo letzad sinatam hifsik bassippur vehaya mechalle penehem lishmoa lo veamar "shimu na" vegomer:

rashi: Vaeschat. ketargumo vaatzarit, veharebe yesh bilshon mishna:
Hatippol tzippor al pach haaretz umokesh en lah. befach shennafla alav umokesh en lah:
Hayaale pach min haadama. mimmakom shehutal sham, ella im ken neechaz bo haof, keshehu rotze livroach oker et happach umaalehu mimmekomo meat, veotah shaa kevar nilkad:
targum: Hatippol tzippera bekula al ara vetzayid let leh hayisak kula min ara umechad la achad:

rashi: Vekal beraglav lo yemallet. et nafsho:
targum: Vaachid kashta la yekum udekalil berigle la yishtezev urechiv susaya la yeshezev nafsheh:

rashi: Beet lidtah. uverivka hu omer vayyimleu yameha laledet? lehallan limleim vechan lachaserim:
Vehinne teomim. male, ulehallan tomim chaser, lefi shehaechad rasha, aval ellu shenehem tzaddikim:
Vayyimtzaehu ish. ze gavriel, shenneemar vehaish gavriel (Daniel 9 21):

Vayhi kehayyom hazze. kelomar vayhi kaasher higgia yom meyuchad, yom tzechok, yom ed shellahem, shehalchu kullam levet aza, amra en li yom hagun lehizzakek leyosef kehayyom hazze, amra lahem chola ani veeni yechola lelech (tanchuma):
Laasot melachto. rav ushemuel, chad amar melachto mammash, vechad amar laasot tzerachav immah, ella shenniret lo demut deyukeno shel aviv vechulei kidita bemassechet sota (daf 37):
Rak etchem yadati. ahavti, veattem peshatem bi, al ken vegomer. verabbotenu derashuhu letzad acher bemassechet avoda zara:
targum: Lechod bechon itreeti mikkol zarayat ara al ken asar alechon yat kol chovechon:

rashi: Kaasher yatztzil haroe. davar muat:
Bedal ozen. chaschus deudan:
Ken yinnatzlu bene yisrael. mete meat:

Bifat mitta uvedammesek ares. targum yonatan: bitkof shultan veal dammesek rechitzan. veomer ani sheppitron hattargum: lefi shebbime yehoachaz ben yehu ketiv "ki ibbedam melech aram" (Melachim 2 13:7), veyaravam ben beno hoshiam bemiktzat, shenneemar "velo dibber Adonai limchot et shem yisrael vayyoshiem beyad yaravam vegomer" (Melachim 2 14:27), "hu heshiv et gevul yisrael", vezehu "bifat mitta" pinnat habbayit hi chazko shel bayit, lachen tirgem "bitkof shultan" shel yaravam, veamos nitnabbe bime yaravam, veod nibba shessofan lehissamech al malche aram, vechen asu bime pekach ben remalyahu shennitchabber im retzin, vezehu "uvedammesek ares" ikkar menuchatam umivtacham tehi al dammesek. verabbotenu amru beseder olam: rabbi nehoray omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, ellu aseret hashshevatim shennismechu al chizkiyyahu melech yehuda veal yehuda ufaltu immahem:

Bifat mitta. melammed shello nishtayyer mehem ella echad mishshemona shebbahem, ushear eres hechan hu? bedammesek, lekayyem ma shenneemar "vehigleti etchem mehala ledammasek" (lekamman 5:27). veshamati mishshemo shel rabbi menachem zatzal shehaya mefaresh: zo achat mishshemona, shello neemar "peat" ella "bifat mitta" bemiktzatah beachat mishshete ruchot shel pea vehi sheminit shel mitta, shehare arba peot yesh ushete ruchot lappea. davar acher: matzati bedivre rabbi meir zatzal, bifat mitta baavon achazya ven achav sheshshalach lidrosh bevaal zevuv elohe ekron "haechye mechali ze" (Melachim 2 1:2). uvedammesek ares, ben hadad melech aram sheshshalach lidrosh belohe yisrael (Melachim 2 8):
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai kema dimshezev raaya mippuma dearya tarten karin o chaschos deodan ken yishtezvun bene yisrael deyatvin beshomron bitkof shuletan veal damesek rechitzin:

rashi: Kaallonim. keyshnish belaaz:
Vaashmid piryo mimmaal. sarim haelyonim:
Vesharashav mittachat. sarim hattachtonim. davar acher: hatztzira hayta mesamme enehem milmala umesarastan millemattan:
targum: Vaana shetzeti yat emoraha min kodamehon dichrum arazin romeh vachasin hu kivlutin veshetzeti ibbeh milela vesharashohi milra:

ohc: Vattitpesehu vegomer lemor vegomer. perush: hattora maggedet kavvanatah bitfisat habbeged shekkavvanatah "lemor" vegomer, aval hi lo amra kelum, ella shalcha yadah letafso lehachericho "kum ase".

rashi: Vayyeshev yaakov vegomer. achar shekkatav lecha yishshuve esav vetoldotav bederech ketzara, shello hayu sefunim vachashuvim lefaresh heach nityashshevu veseder milchamotehem ech horishu et hachori, peresh lach yishshuve yaakov vetoldotav bederech arukka kol gilgule sibbatam, lefi shehem chashuvim lifne hammakom lehaarich bahem, vechen atta motze bey dorot shemmeadam vead noach peloni holid peloni, ucheshebba lenoach heerich bo, vechen bey dorot shemminnoach vead avraham kitztzer bahem, umishshehiggia etzel avraham heerich bo. mashal lemargalit shennafla ben hachol, adam memashmmesh bachol vechovro bichvara ad shemmotze et hammargalit, umishshemmetzaah hu mashlich et hatztzerorot miyyado venotel hammargalit. davar acher vayyeshev yaakov, happishtani hazze nichnesu gemallav teunim pishtan, happechami tama ana yikkanes kol happishtan hazze? haya pikkeach echad meshiv lo nitztzotz echad yotze mimmappuach shellecha shessoref et kullo, kach yaakov raa et kol haallufim hakketuvim lemala, tama veamar mi yachol lichbosh et kullan? ma ketiv lematta, elle toldot yaakov yosef, dichtiv vehaya vet yaakov esh uvet yosef lehava uvet esav lekash (Ovadya 1) – nitztzotz yotze miyyosef shemmechalle vesoref et kullam:
ohc: Vayyeshev yaakov vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar pasuk ze, shehalo kevar amar bapparasha hakkodemet (Bereshit 35:27) "vayyavo yaakov vegomer hi chevron asher gar sham avraham veyitzchak", vechol od shello yodia hakkatuv sheyyatza, yodea ani ki sham kana yeshivato. od tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar eretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan, veim leyached hammakom haya lo lomar bechevron, veim lehodia ki hu eretz megure aviv halo kevar amar bapparasha hakkodemet "asher gar sham avraham veyitzchak"?

Achen leheyot shekkadam lomar bapparasha hakkodemet vehodia ki esav achiv yarash et har seir mikkoach zechut aviv, chal al hakkatuv lehodia yerushshat yaakov. veamar vayyeshev vegomer, nitkavven lehodia middat tuvo shello hitnaheg baaretz ella begerut, hagam sheraa sheesav yarash yerushshato vehaadon dikdek lomar elav shennatan lo beyichud et haaretz, uchemo shepperashti bapparasha hakkodemet (Bereshit 35:12) befasuk "lecha ettenenna", af al pi chen lo asa bo roshem vehaya mitgorer begerut kemo shehaya aviv beeretz kenaan perush: shehaya mitnaheg bah keeretz lo lo ella eretz kenaan.

O yomar, hagam shehi eretz kenaan hannittenet lo morasha, af al pi chen haya ger bah ad shennitgalgelu haddevarim al yede toldot yosef, vehu amro elle toldot yaakov yosef vegomer, venimkar lemitzrayim veyardu avotenu mitzrayim, veheela otam hammavtiach lekayyem havetachato el haaretz veyarshu nachalatam.

rashi: Vattitallaf. kisseta faneha, shello yakkir bah:
Vatteshev befetach enayim. biftichat enayim, befarashat derachim sheal derech timnata. verabbotenu darshu befitcho shel avraham avinu, shekkol enayim metzappot liroto (sota 10):
Ki raata ki gadal shela vegomer. lefichach hifkira atzmah etzel yehuda, shehayta mitavva lehaamid mimmennu vanim:
ohc: Ki raata vegomer vehi vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar vehi velo hispik lomar "velo nittena" vegomer, vehaddavar muvan shealeha hu omer. veulay ki shene devarim amar hakkatuv: haechad – ki raata ki gadal shela, vehaddavar muvan shello nitkayyem maamar chamiha sheamar "ad yigdal" vegomer ki odenna bevet aviha, vehashsheni – vehi lo nittena vegomer perush sheraata beruach hakkodesh sheeno rauy shettinnaten hi lo leishsha, velaze amda veasta vehitzlicha. vetze ulemad ma yatza mimmenna laolam – minnashim baohel tevorach.

rashi: Vayhi chishmoa adonav vegomer. bishat tashmish amra lo chen, vezehu sheamra kaddevarim haelle asa li avdecha, inyene tashmish kaelle:
Al michram bakkesef tzaddik. haddayyanin hayu mochrim et mi shehaya zakkay baddin bechesef shochad shehayu mekabbelim miyyad baal dino:

Veevyon baavur naalayim. tirgem yonatan bishne mekomot (lekamman 8:6) bedil deyechsenun, veomer ani shekkach perusho: mattin mishpat haevyon kede sheyyitztarech limkor sadehu shehaya lo ben sedot haddayyanin, veze okef alav venotlah bedamim kallim kede ligdor velinol kol sedotav yachad velo yafsik benehem:
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai al telata chove yisrael veal arbea la eshbok lehon ad dezabbinu bechaspa zakkain vachashichaya bedil deyachasnun:

rashi: Veatta vanim shimu li:
targum: Vehasheta venaya shemaun li vetuvoy leman denatar orchatay:

rashi: Orchat. ketargumo sheyarat, al shem holche orach:

Ugemallehem nosim vegomer. lamma firsem hakkatuv et massaam? lehodia mattan secharan shel tzaddikim, sheen darkan shel arviyyim laset ella neft veitran, sherechan ra, velaze nizdammenu vesamim, shello yizzok mereach ra:
Nechot. kol kinnuse vesamim harebe karuy nechot, vechen vayyarem et kol bet nechoto (Melachim 2 20) – mirkachat besamav. veunkelos tirgem leshon shaava:
Tzare. saraf hannotef meatze hakketaf, vehu nataf hannimne im sammane hakketoret:
Valot. lotita shemo vilshon mishna. verabbotenu pershuhu shoresh esev, ushemo ashetarevalevazeyah bemassechet nidda:

ohc: Ki gunnov gunnavti. taam kefel gunnov vegomer, lemor ki shene genevot naasu bo: genevat hagguf ugenevat daat hakkonim shechashvu shehu eved shebbaze kanu oto mehem, laze amar geneva shete peamim. umeatta hinne hu leatzmo veen gufo kanuy lallokeach. veulay ki nitkavven yosef listor nimus mitzrayim sheen eved molech velo lovesh vechulei (Bereshit Rabba 89,7), uletzad sheraa bachalom ki yaale ligdulla amar lehasir taut hannishma ki hu eved. veefshar shello hikpid Adonai al davar ze ki tzarich adam leharim michsholo, velo hikpid Adonai ella al amro zechartani vegomer.

Veamro vegam po perush, bair hazzot, lo asiti meuma, vechahochacha shehochichu mehassimla keamram zichronam livracha (targum yonatan Bereshit 39:14) ki badku simlat hammirshaat umatzu sheker biminah. veet ze shillem yosef lechohane faro shebbadku hassimla vehotziu mealav lashon hara, laze natan lahem chukkam bammushlam asher katzav lahem paro (Bereshit 47:22), ki zulat ze haya choshev alehem machashavot, ki "veal picha yishshak kol ammi" (Bereshit 41:40) amar elav paro.

rashi: Vehakem zera. habben yikkare al shem hammet:
Vechol yesh lo. hare lashon katzar, chaser "asher":
Ki Adonai itto. shem shamayim shagur befiv:
Seir izzim. damo dome leshel adam:
Hakkuttonet. ze shemah, ucheshehi devuka leteva acheret, kegon ketonet yosef, ketonet passim, ketonet bad, nakud ketonet:

ohc: Bachalomi – perush, leheyot shechalam pitron chalom chavero, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot noah:), laze amar bachalomi, perush, asher chalamti leatzmi:

rashi: Vayyaavru anashim midyanim. zo hi shayyara acheret, vehodiacha hakkatuv shennimkar peamim harebe:
Vayyimshechu. vene yaakov et yosef min habbor vayyimkeruhu layyishmeelim, veyishmeelim lammidyanim, vehammidyanim lammitzrim:
ohc: Vayyaavru anashim midyanim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hizkir avarat anashim midyanim, achar shello haya hammecher ella layyishmeelim, keamro "vayyimkeru et yosef layyishmeelim". vechen muchach mehakketuvim (Bereshit 37:25) "vehinne orchat yishmeelim vegomer lechu venimkerennu layyishmeelim", im ken sippur "vayyaavru anashim midyanim" lo noda kavvanato.

Od roani sheamar od hakkatuv achare ze (Bereshit 37:36) "vehammedanim machru oto" vegomer, im ken muchach ki lammedanim mecharuhu, vechatuv rishon machchisho. od amar hakkatuv achar kach (Bereshit 39:1) "veyosef hurad mitzrayma vayyiknehu potifar miyyad hayyishmeelim", hare heemid hammecher shehaya layyishmeelim kaamur bitchillat hainyan velo lammedanim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 84:22) amru melammed shennimkar mechirot harebe, veen mityashshevim peshate hakketuvim baze, vehaven:

Vehannachon hu ki perush shel devarim hu al ze hadderech, ki mittechilla hodia hakkatuv "vehinne orchat yishmeelim" vegomer (Bereshit 37:25), vedivre yehuda sheamar "lechu venimkerennu layyishmeelim". veleheyot sheorchat yishmeelim zo enam socharim lehittager bechol min kinyan zulat bema shehayu nosim, veen metziut sheyyiknu et yosef, asher al ken hizmin Adonai anashim midyanim socharim, perush shemmakkirim kol min sechora asher tizdammen liknotah leharevacha. veteda ki hassocher eno baal hakkis ella baal hayedia vehahekker, uvaal hakkis yikne al piv, kemo sheyyadua ze befinnot gedolot baolam, uveemtzaut ellu hassocharim nigmar haddavar shel hammecher layyishmeelim.

Vehu sheamar hakkatuv vayyaavru anashim midyanim socharim, uveemtzautam machru yosef layyishmeelim, ki zulatam lo hayu hayyishmeelim konim. vehinne kevan shebben shenehem, hammedanim vehayyishmeelim, haya hammecher, hare yesh lammedanim chelek barevach letzad ki hem hakkonim, velayyishmeelim chelek barevach letzad ki hem baale kisim asher natnu esrim kasef. velaze amar vehammedanim machru oto el mitzrayim (Bereshit 37:36) vegomer, ki letzad shehaya lahem chelek bo vegam hem hayyodim haerech, hem hayu hammochrim, lo hayyishmeelim ki enam bekiim beshiur shavyo. aval gufo shel yosef haya beyad hayyishmeelim, ki hem haikkarim shennatnu bo kaspam, velaze amar vayyiknehu potifar miyyad hayyishmeelim (Bereshit 39:1). dikdek lomar miyyad ki beyadam haya shehoriduhu shamma, veen metziut liknoto potifar zulat mimmi shehaya beyado. vegam lo hayu yishmeelim yecholin lemachro hem levaddam mibbeli hammedanim, millevad taam shehen habbekiin beshavyo veyadu kamma shiuro, gam letzad sheyyesh lahem chelek barevach tzarich sheyyaskimu hem al hammecher. velaze amar hakkatuv shehammedanim machru velakchu miyyad hayyishmeelim, uvaze nityashshevu hakketuvim kaftor vaferach. vedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru shennimkar peamim rabbot, ze derech derash. veulay ki leheyot shehayu chalakim harebe bilkichato yechashev mechirot rabbot. ufeshat hakkatuv hu kemo shekkatavti, vehadderasha tiddaresh.

Vayyimkeru et yosef. ulay sheachar shehippiluhu kol kach uvizzuhu beerom uvehashlachato labbor, nach ketzat rugezam venitratztzu baatzat yehuda. ucheneged ma sheamru (Bereshit 37:20) "venire ma yihyu chalomotav" shennire shehayu mevakshim ofen lishlol behechlet heyot haddavar, ulay shechashvu ki beemtzaut pechitut ze shemmecharuhu hare hu muchlat leeved yosef, ki hakkonehu rishon hare hu leeved lo umin hannimna latzet mittachat yado zulat bemecher acher lezulat, umeatta kana shem avdut olam, vehu amro (Tehillim 105:17) "leeved nimkar yosef", vahare hu muchlat hechlet gamur mehishshanot leven chorin veen tzarich lomar mealot ligdulla.

rashi: Baazoz. keshehigbir mayenot tehom:
targum: Vechad agrim anane milel vechad ashin mayene tehuma:

rashi: Vayyachsheveha lezona. lefi sheyyoshevet befarashat derachim:
Ki chisseta paneha. velo yachol lirotah ulehakkirah. umidrash rabbotenu ki chisseta paneha, keshehayta bevet chamiha hayta tzenua, lefichach lo chashadah:
Hashshoafim al afar eretz. al afar eretz shehem holchim alehem kol sheafam vechol machashavtam berosh dallim hu ech yigzelu otam veyittelu et shellahem, sheifa golushir belaaz:
Vederech anavim yattu vegomer. hachalashim notim middarkam veholchin derech akalton mippene yiratam, kema deat amar "yattu evyonim middarech" (Iyov 24:4):
El hannaara. hameorasa:
targum: Deshaytin beafra deara beresh maskena vedin chashichaya mastan ugevar veavuhi azlin al ulemta bedil leachla yat shema dekudeshi:

rashi: Zoafim. atzevim kemo sar vezaef (Melachim 1 20), zaaf Adonai essa (Micha 7):
ohc: Vehinnam zoafim. taam zeifat pene shenehem, al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (berachot noah:), shekkol echad chalam gam pitron chalom chavero. laze sar hammashkim haya zoef bema sheraa befitron chavero ki ra hu, yare gam lenafsho venivhal, vesar haofim hagam shechalam pitron chavero letova, im kol ze leheyoto muchan lappuranut mazzalo maggido velibbo lo nachon immo.

rashi: Vechol benotav. rabbi yehuda omer achayot teomot noldu im kol shevet vashevet unesaum, rabbi nechemya omer kenaaniyyot hayu, ella mahu vechol benotav? – kallotav, sheen adam nimna millikro lachatano beno ulechallato vitto:
Vaymaen lehitnachem. en adam mekabbel tanchumin al hachay vesavur shemmet, sheal hammet nigzera gezera sheyyishtakkach min hallev velo al hachay (Bereshit Rabba):
Ered el beni. kemo al beni, veharebe el meshammeshin bilshon al, el shaul veel bet haddamim (Shmuel 2 21), el hillakach aron haelohim veel mot chamiha veishah (Shmuel 1 4):

Avel sheola. kifshuto leshon kever hu – beevli ekkaver, velo etnachem kol yamay. umidrasho, gehinnom; siman ze haya masur beyadi mippi haggevura, im lo yamut echad mibbanay bechayyay, muvtach ani sheeni roe gehinnom:
Vayyevk oto aviv. yitzchak, boche haya mippene tzarato shel yaakov aval lo haya mitabbel, shehaya yodea shehu chay:
ohc: Vayyakumu chol banav vegomer. lo huzekar kan divre nechama.

Venire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi, ki kesherau banav kol kach avelut vesak bematnav yamim rabbim, amru: "ze yaasehu adam shemmet lo beno yechido, o afillu eno yechido im hayu lo banim muatim yakpid al chesron mehammuat". laze nitchakkemu laasot davar shebbeemtzauto yitnachem meatzmo, vehu shennitkabbetzu yachad kol banav, achad asar banim veachad asar banot uvenehem uvenotehem rabbim hem, vehalchu veamdu etzlo utehi zot nechamato. ki mi sheyyesh lo kol kach banim uvanot en rauy lo lehitztaer kol kach al ben katan im nedar min habbanim, vehu amro vayyakumu chol banav vechol benotav yachad, vekima zo shel kullan yachad hi lenachamo kesheyyire ki rabbu banav uvenotav. veaf al pi chen lo hoil lo davar ze vaymaen lehitnachem, vayyomer hattaam "ki ered el beni", perush begeder sheen li ella hu meyuchad, ki en keday bechol banav uvenotav lehitnachem alav ki ahevo mikkol echav lattaam hayyadua bedivre hazzohar (chelek 1 180:).

Od yirtze beamro vaymaen vegomer ki ered vegomer, perush: hagam sheraa shemmeen hinnachem, lo lamad mizze sheyyosef chay veen mekabbelin tanchumin al hachay, ki amar taam meniut hannechama letzad taam "ki ered el beni". veamru zichronam livracha siman haya masur beyado vechulei ad kan:

Vayyevk oto. perush, kesheamar devarav chazar livkot alav. vedikdek lomar aviv lishlol kol banav vechol vegomer shello bachu behazekarato ki im aviv. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bereshit Rabba 84:21) shehu yitzchak aviv shel yaakov vehu derash.

rashi: Hayelchu shenayim yachdav. sheattem omrim lanneviim lo tinnavu, kelum hanneviim mitnabbeim millibbam ella im ken nitztauu, kelum devarim naasim ella al pi darkam:
Bilti im noadu. ella im ken kavu moed lalechet yachdav lemakom peloni:
targum: Hayahachun teren kachada elahen im izdamanu:

rashi: Salle chore. sallim shel netzarim kelufim chorin chorin, uvimkomenu yesh harebe, vederech mochre fat kissanin, shekkorin avebaleysh belaaz, letittam beotam sallim:
ohc: Vayyar sar haofim ki tov. perush, hu shechalam pitron sar hammashkim raa ki tov patar, perush: al nachon, vehu ed sheraa, ma sheen ken sar hammashkim efshar shello yatzdik vadday ki hu ze happitron.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: ki tov dibber lo befitrono, ucheillu amar ki patar tov velo ra, vechashav sheulay gam oto yevasser besora tova. vetikvato mappach nafesh, ki heruhu haggalut shel yisrael asher yochlu haammim hannimshalim leofot, keamro (Bereshit 15:11 vetargum yonatan sham) "vayyered haayit al happegarim", et yisrael harmuzim lallechem, dichtiv (Tehillim 14:4) "ochle ammi achlu lechem". gam ramaz beamro al roshi ki yisrael hem elyonim al kol haammim. vetimtza shebbachalom sar hammashkim lo hizkir sheshshata paro et hakkos ella netinato beyado lechavod ulemaala, ma sheen ken chalom sar haofim shehiggid achilat haofot min hassal.

rashi: Eravon. mashkon:
Eretz vechutzot. eretz yisrael ushear aratzot (taanit 10.):
Verosh afrot tevel. adam harishon (sanhedrin lach.):
targum: Ad la avad ara venachale veresh afra detevel:

rashi: Velo yachlu dabbero leshalom. mittoch genutam lamadnu shivcham, shello dibberu achat bappe veachat ballev:
Dabbero. ledabber immo:
Hinneni. leshon anava uzerizut, nizdarez lemitzvat aviv, veaf al pi shehaya yodea beechav shessonin oto:
ohc: Lecha veeshlachacha vegomer. perush "lecha" etzel achecha, veim atta choshesh lesinatam hareni melavvecha vesholchacha bidvar mitzva shettelech bishlichuti, usheluche mitzva enam nizzokim (fesachim 8:).

rashi: Velo yada itto meuma. lo haya noten libbo lichlum:
Ki im hallechem. hi ishto, ella sheddibber belashon nekiyya:
Vayhi yosef yefe toar. kevan sheraa atzmo moshel, hitchil ochel veshote umesalsel besaaro, amar hakkabba avicha mitabbel veatta mesalsel bisarcha, ani megare vecha et haddov, miyyad:
Ana ani va. ana evrach mitztzaro shel abba?

Yom hulledet et paro. yom ledato, vekorin lo yom genuseya. uleshon hulledet, lefi sheen havvalad notzar ella al yede acherim, shehachayya meyalledet et haishsha, veal ken hachayya nikret meyalledet, vechen umoldotayich beyom hulledet otach (Yechezkel 16) vechen achare hukkabbes et hannega (Vayikra 13), shekkibbuso al yede acherim:
Vayyissa et rosh vegomer. menaam im shear avadav, shehaya mone hammeshartim sheyyeshartu lo bisudato vezachar et ellu vetocham, kemo seu et rosh (Bamidbar 1), leshon minyan:
Vayyaal al gozze tzono. vayyaal timnata laamod al gozze tzono:
Nechocha. yeshara:
Chamas vashod. mamon shel gazel:
targum: Vela yadin lemebad orayta amar Adonai di malan otzrehon chatof uviza bevirneyathon:

rashi: Paratzta. chazakta alecha chozek:
ohc: Ma paratzta vegomer. perush, ki leheyot sheyyad harishon taggid ki hu hakkarov latzet kodem achiv, veaf al pi chen dechafo ze larishon vesatar haamadato kodem lo, ze yaggid haderaga gedola. vehu amro ma paratzta al derech amro (tehillim 104:24) "ma rabbu maasecha" vegomer. veamro alecha paretz mefareshet devareha ma hi happirtza sheasa, veamra "alecha paretz", perush, ki hannoten yad yaggid ki hu ba alav bahazeraa, ki hannichnas acharon bazzera yotze rishon, veim ken hu ba alav ufaratz gedero veyatza rishon. vehu amro "alecha paretz" vehaven. uchefi ze peretz rishon bahazeraa verishon balleda ki lo hammelucha nesucha tikkon olam.

rashi: Lirot et tzon. nakud al et, shello halchu ella lirot et atzman:

ohc: Ze pitrono. taam amro chen befitrone hachalomot, nitkavven lehashelit haddibbur shel happitron al hammachshava, shebbaze hachalomot holchim achar happe, ki hammachshava mithappechet kefi haddibbur hashsholet aleha. vedavka im yomar "ze pitrono" shebbaze mashlit haddibbur. uchemo chen timtza sheddibber bederech ze befitron chalom paro, kaasher avaer sham beezrat hashshem yitbarach.

rashi: Sarigim. zemorot aruchot, shekkorin 126 belaaz:

Vehiv cheforachat. dome leforachat vehi cheforachat – nidma li bachalomi cheillu hi forachat, veachar happerach alta nitztza, venaasu semadar, ashepaneyr belaaz, veachar kach hivshilu, vehi kad afrachat appekat lavlevin ad kan targum shel porachat netz gadol mipperach kedichtiv uvoser gomel yihye nitztza (Yeshayahu 18), uchetiv vayyotze ferach, vahadar vayyatzetz tzitz (Bamidbar 17):
Ma betza. ma mamon, ketargumo:
Vechissinu et damo. venaalim et mitato:
Hattabbachim. shochate behemot hammelech:
Vayyitnakkelu. nitmalleu nechalim vearmumit:
Oto. kemo itto, immo, kelomar, elav:
ohc: Vayyiru oto vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro uveterem vegomer, im hu gezera lema shellefanav al ze hadderech: "vayyiru oto merachok beterem yikrav alehem", o hu hatechalat hodaa lema shelleacharav al ze hadderech: "beterem yikrav vegomer hitnakkelu elav" vegomer? ulechol tzad kashe: im nimshach lema shellefanav haya lo lomar "beterem yikrav", veim hu nimshach lema shelleacharav haya lo lomar "uveterem vegomer hitnakkelu". veulay ki nitkavven betosefet vav lehosif harechaka, perush, shello tomar sheharichuk hu sheadayin lo karav alehem, ella "uveterem yikrav" rauhu muflag berichuk.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vayyiru oto merachok – perush: merichuk hallevavot, shello rauhu kiriyyat achim laachihem ella keish meruchak mehem. uveterem yikrav vegomer – perush: ureiyya zo hayta gam ken terem vegomer, veim lo haya omer "uveterem" betosefet vav haya nishma ki hu ze perush "merachok" sheamar, laze amar betosefet vav lomar ki hu davar acher. veyesh od leyashshev hakkatuv beofen acher, ella shennire ki ze tzodek yoter.

rashi: Vechatati lelohim. bene noach nitztauu al haarayot:
ohc: Baasher at ishto. perush, lo shechasach otach mimmenni betzav latzav, ella letzad sheat ishto hu haddavar hammachsich otach mimmenni. o lishlol tzad hammaala.
Veech eese vegomer. perush, ki baze ani mafsid kol hattov hammussag etzli.
Veod ani machsir atzmi mimmekor hanneshamot, ki davar ze hu asur gam livne noach, vehu amro "vechatati lelohim".

Veod yirtze, ki en lah liton ki tastir haddavar velo yeda adono, venimtza omed bematztzavo been machsor. laze amar "vechatati lelohim", vehu sheasaani bematztzav ze, umimmennu lo yissater davar, venimtza mafsid matztzavo hattov.

rashi: Ehav. kemo eehav:
Ohavay. ohaveha ketiv, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani ohaveha shel tora ehav. zo shamati merabbi aharon, beshem rabbi natan:
Yimtzaunni. nun yetera: chamishshim shaare vina amtziennu:
targum: Ana rachama rachamay veilen dimkadmin li yishkechunani:

rashi: Shamar et haddavar. haya mamtin umetzappe matay yavo, vechen shomer emunim (Yeshayahu 26), vechen lo tishmor al chattati (Iyov 14) – lo tamtin:
ohc: Vaykanu vo echav. bachalom ze hesiru hassafek shehaya lahem bachalom rishon, shebba hachalom lesibbat machshevotav, ki vadday shello chashav velo ala al dato lehistarer al aviv, veen ze ella hodaat davar mehashshamayim, velaze nichnesa bahem kina.

rashi: Reu hevi lanu. hare ze lashon ketzara – hevi lanu, velo peresh mi hevio, veal baalah omeret ken:
Ivri. meever hannahar, mibbene ever (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vattikra leanshe vegomer. letzad sheyyada tzedek yosef beene adono velo yaamin lidvareha, laze nitkavvena vattikra lahem shehem yomru bevo adone yosef, vehu amro lemor, uvaara bam esh hakkina lehaid, vehu amro reu hevi lanu vegomer letzachek banu, shittaftam betzaratah ki gam alehem giddelo vehu ish nachri.
O yirtze beamro reu ki yaidu al haddevarim ki ken rau, vehu amro "lemor reu", gam nitchakkema lehitraem neged habbaal, shebbaze im yalitz tova alav tomar: "af zo min hattochachot alecha telunnati".

rashi: Arye shaag mi lo yira. kach hakkadosh baruch hu dibber el hanneviim lehinnave, mi lo yinnave:
targum: Arye nahem man la yidchal Adonai elohim malel man la yekabbel nevuata:

rashi: Linzirim. tirgem yonatan: lemalfin, shehayu ferushin middarche am haaretz veoskim battora. en nezira bechol makom ella leshon perisha:
Haaf en zot. bitmiha, kelomar kelum attem yecholim lehachechish et zot:
targum: Vaakimet mibbenechon linviin umeulemechon lemalfin haaf let da bene yisrael amar Adonai:

rashi: Shachanti arma. etzel arma, shekkevan shellamad adam tora, nichnas bo armimut shel kol davar (sota ka:):
targum: Ana chachmata daret arimuta yediata vetarita mashkecha ana:

rashi: Bet hachoref al bet hakkayitz. mittoch shehayu meunnagim hayu bonim lahem haashirim shete vattim, echad lechoref veechad lekayitz:
Batte hashshen. dimchabbeshin beshen defila:
targum: Veemche bet sitva al bet kayta veyevdun battin dimchabbeshin beshen defil visufun battin sagiin amar Adonai:

rashi: Baasher Adonai itto. bishvil she itto:
Lishkav etzlah. afillu velo tashmish:
Lihyot immah. laolam habba:
Vayyitten yad. hotzi haechad yado lachutz, uleachar shekkashra al yado hashshani hechezirah:
ohc: Al yado shani lemor. perush, nitznetza vamyalledet ruach hakkodesh veasta velo yada ma asta. hi kashra al yado shani, veze romez ki hu sheni lo rishon, aval hi amra ki ze yatza rishona. vehu amro lemor "ze yatza rishona", perush, hi amra chen, aval kefi haemet lehefech yaggid shem hassiman, ki yesh em lammasoret.

rashi: Hu haya ose. ketargumo bememre hava mitaved:
ohc: Hu haya ose. targum peresh "al memreh". velidvarav lamma lo yedabber hakkatuv tzachot veyomar beferush "al piv hayu osim"? veulay shennitkavven hakkatuv beshannoto et tamo lehodia gam ken shehagam shehaya hu hammanhig, lo haya mitnaheg bisrara umonea atzmo mittashmish davar asher hayu osim sham haasurim, ella yado keyad kullan shava, veze yaggid mezeg tivo ki tov hu umatza chen vesechel tov beene Adonai veadam.

Vayhi bevet adonav vegomer. hinne yesadder hakkatuv hadderagot hammaalot asher heela Adonai oto, ki mikkodem keshekkenao netano laavod avodat avadim haovdim avodat chutz, ki haggedolim lo yaamidu lesharet bevattehem ella asher yihye ish rauy umatzliach, velaze tzivva Adonai itto et hahatzlacha uvaze haya bevet adonav hammitzri mishshomre habbayit, vehu amro vayhi bevet adonav velo bishar avodot, veod lo madrega acheret kesheraa adonav vegomer vaysharet oto perush yichado lesharet oto beyichud, shebbaze yihye chashuv velo yichye chayye tzaar kechayye haavadim hashshefalim. veod lo vayyafkidehu al beto hare ze kana maala al kol kinyan adono. veod lo vayyaazov kol asher lo vegomer, veod lo shello yada itto vegomer shello haya yodea hannichnasim vehayyotzim venaasa hu shallit, perush 316 belaaz, bechol kinyan hammitzri:

rashi: Veal begadim chavulim yattu. tirgem yonatan: al metavvat shavveyayn demashkon mistacharin, zokfin milve al haaniyyim umemashkenim otam veosim bigdehem matztzaot umesubbin alehem bahataya beet seudatam bvet elohehem. bevet avoda zara shehayta lahem etzel mizbeach:
Yattu. leshon mesibba, shekkol mesibbat seuda bahataya hi, shehu nismach al semolo:
Veyen anushim. sheonshim otam mamon veshotim bo yayin:
targum: Veal shavyan demashkon mesacharin bistar kol egorehon vachamar onasa shatan bet taavathon:

rashi: Achar haddevarim haelle. lefi shehirgila otah arura et hatztzaddik befi chullam ledabber bo ulegannoto, hevi lahem hakkabba surchanam shel ellu, sheyyifnu alehem velo elav, veod shettavo harvacha latztzaddik al yedehem:
Chatu. ze nimtza zevuv befayyli poterin shello, veze nimtza tzeror biglusekin shello:
Vehaofe. et pat hammelech, veen leshon afiyya ella befat, uvelaaz 605:

Elle toldot yaakov. veelle shel toldot yaakov, ellu yishshuvehem vegilgulehem ad shebbau lichlal yishshuv, sibba rishona yosef ben 17 vegomer, al yede ze nitgalgelu veyardu lemitzrayim, zehu achar yishshuv peshuto shel mikra lihyot davar davur al afnav. umia doresh tala hakkatuv toldot yaakov beyosef mippene chamma devarim, achat, shekkol atzmo shel yaakov lo avad etzel lavan ella verachel, veshehaya ziv ikonin shel yosef dome lo, vechol ma sheera leyaakov era leyosef: ze nistam veze nistam, ze achiv mevakkesh lehargo veze echav mevakkeshim lehargo, vechen harebe bivra. veod nidrash bo vayyeshev, bikkesh yaakov leshev beshalva, kafatz alav ragzo shel yosef – tzaddikim mevakkeshim leshev beshalva, amar hakkabba lo dayyan latztzaddikim ma shemmetukkan lahem laolam habba, ella shemmevakkeshim leshev beshalva baolam hazze:
Vehu naar. shehaya ose maase naarut, metakken bisaro, memashmesh beenav, kede sheyyihye nire yafe:
Et bene vilha. kelomar veragil etzel bene vilha, lefi shehayu echav mevazzin otan vehu mekarvan:

Et dibbatam roe. kol raa shehaya roe veechav vene lea haya maggid leaviv, shehayu ochlin ever min hachay, umezalzelin bivne hashshefachot likrotan avadim, vachashudim al haarayot, uvishlashtan laka: vayyishchatu seir izzim bimchirato velo achaluhu chay, veal dibba shessipper alehem shekkorin laachehem avadim – "leeved nimkar yosef", veal arayot shessipper alehem, vattissa eshet adonav vego:
Dibbatam. kol leshon dibba 414 belaaz, kol ma shehaya yachol ledabber bahem raa, haya mesapper:
Dibba. leshon dovev sifte yeshenim (Shir 7):
ohc: Elle toldot. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Bereshit Rabba perek 12) kol makom shenneemar elle vegomer, vechan pasal toldot esav, veim laze kivven lo haya tzarich, ki kevar nifsal esav vehayyotze mehappasul pasul.

Od tzarich ladaat amro toldot yaakov yosef, vehechan hem asara shevatim? verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 84:6) mehem amru ki yechavven lomar shehu haikkar, umehem amru ki kemo sheera laze era laze, ze nolad mahul veze nolad mahul, veze mehadderash.

Veyerae kavvanat hakkatuv hi al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit 37:2), bikkesh yaakov avinu leshev beshalva, kafatz alav rugezo shel yosef, vehu amro "elle toldotav shel yaakov", perush: ma sheavar alav meharogez, shehakkatuv ba lehodia mechirat yosef vetzaaro shel yaakov. hu yaakov haggorem bema shebbikkesh leshev, dichtiv "vayyeshev yaakov", uvaze toldotav hem elle "yosef ben" vegomer venitgalgelu haddevarim, ki haadam gorem leatzmo et kol asher tavona alav. ki en davar ra ba mehaadon hattov lakkol, uvifrat lididav, yaakov vechayyotze bo.

Od yirtze lehodia shehagam sheavru kamma meoraot raot al yaakov miyyom heyoto, nirdaf meesav millavan amus hattelaot, yechashvu kullam keayin beerech meora ze shel yosef, vehu amro elle pasal meoraot sheavru alav ki chullam keayin yechashvu al yaakov haregashotehem.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota lo:) rauy haya yosef lehaamid 12 shevatim keyaakov, ella al yede maase potifar "vayyafozzu zeroe yadav" – asara hemma hatztzaddikim yatzu measara etzbeotav, velo nisharu lo ella shenayim – efrayim umenashshe, vehu sheramaz kan beamro elle toldot vegomer, pasal perat echad mehayv shello hayu baolam mehattaam hannizkar.

Od yitbaer al derech amro besefer tehillim (77:16) "bene yaakov veyosef sela". veamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 19:) shettaam sheyyiches bene yaakov leyaakov uleyosef, leheyot sheyyosef zanam bishne raav ufirnesam nikreu al shemo, ad kan. vehu atzmo sheramaz kan beamro toldot yaakov yosef, perush: beemtzaut yosef haya kiyyum lechol toldotav. o yirtze al ze hadderech, toldot yaakov vegam yosef. veharebe mikraot medabberim ken, dichtiv (Shemot 1:2) "reuven shimon", ucheillu amar "veshimon". gam kan keillu amar "veyosef", venatan hakkatuv taam likriat shem kullam alav bema sheggamar omer ben sheva esre vegomer, venitgalgelu haddevarim veyarad mitzrayma veala ligdulla vehutzrechu echav elav ufirnesam veet tappam, uletaam ze yikkaru al shemo ki hu hazzan umefarnes lechullan:

Ben sheva esre. taam shehutzrach lesapper shene yosef, nitkavven lehodia amram zichronam livracha bemassechet berachot (55:) leolam yetzappe adam lachalom tov ad esrim ushetayim shana vechulei, veim ken im lo haya modia hakkatuv ben sheva esre shana lo hayinu yodim ze:

Od yirtze al derech amram baggemara (kiddushin 29:), hay daadifna mechavray denasivna beshitsar vechulei, hare ki beshitsar lo yitgabber hachomer veyetzer hara al haadam kemo beshivsar, vehu ma shehutzrach hakkatuv lehodia ki yosef haya ben sheva esre shana, ki beemtzaut haggaat hazzeman haya bo tzad tigboret enoshit lehitgarot beechav ulehavi dibbatam raa vegomer, veayyen besamuch:

Haya roe vegomer. kashe, haya lo lomar "haya roe hatztzon et echav", ki lo leechav haya roe. od tzarich ladaat hakkavvana beamro vehu naar vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba parasha 84) amru haya ose maase naarut, uledivrehem lamma et bene vilha, uferesh Rashi vehaya ragil et bene vilha, vehu perush rachok. od tzarich ladaat amro neshe aviv, mi lo yada ki hem neshe aviv? od tzarich ledakdek amro vayyave yosef et dibbatam vegomer, ma hi dibbatam raa, veal mi samach alav hakkatuv lehavin et haddevarim, velo ba hakkatuv listom ella lefaresh.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: haya roe et echav beinyan hatztzon, perush bederech achilat tzon. veamro vehu naar perush mizzeman heyoto naar vehu mitgorer umitchabber im bene vilha. veamro neshe aviv perush lechashvam begeder neshe aviv been hefresh mimmennu alehem, uvaze lo kashe shekkore oto naar vehu ben sheva esre shana ki chozer el zeman hakkodem. umimmotza davar atta lamed meamro roe et echav bedin hatztzon – ha lamadta shennechshedu etzlo bifrat ze, umeamro "et bene vilha vegomer neshe aviv" – ha lamadta ki hu haya choshev ken velo zulato. umeatta kesheamar hakkatuv "vayyave yosef et dibbatam raa el avihem" hu al peratim hannirmazim besamuch, vehu sheamru zichronam livracha beruach kadsham sheamar alehem shehayu ochlim ever min hachay, vehu hannirmaz batztzon, vegam amram shehayu mezalzelim bivne hashshefachot, hu hannirmaz beamro "neshe aviv", ki lo machshevotav machshevotam, umizze yatza lahem lezalzel bahem. veulay ki gam mittaam ze yatza chashad arayot kesheyyihyu nechshavim beenehem kishfachot velo bemadregat nashim, vechashav yosef ki kavvanatam shel haachim kedaat harambam (hilchot avadim perek 9) bedin habba al shifchato setam, shehavvalad eved ad sheyyefaresh beferush shebba aleha leshem ishut. umeatta kesheechav mezalzelim bivne hashshefachot gillu datam ki min hassetam havvalad eved, vehashshefachot en lahem mishpat eshet av ella kimfuttat aviv vaanusato shehayu muttarot lahem lehizzakek lahem, vachashadam sheyyishkevu haanashim immahem veen ra lisvaratam. velisvarat yosef ippaska halacha kedaat harif (perek 2 divamot) shehabboel setam asaah bat chorin vehavvalad kasher, vedin neshe aviv lahem. veal perat ze gam ken nitkavven beamro dibbatam raa, veneenash yosef al haddavar ech yachshov batztzaddikim sheyyitu baddavar, shehalo gam ledaat harambam yode beadam tzaddik keyaakov ki min hassetam leshem ishut baal. veod shebbeferush ittemar (targum yonatan ben uziel vayyetze 30:4) keshennetanum rachel velea kede sheyyihyu bechezkat meshuchrarim netanum, umin hassetam yadu hashshevatim baddavar.

Vetaam shemmatzinu hashshevatim shehayu yachad beetza achat bimchirat yosef, uvichlalam hayu gam bene hashshefachot. ulay sheggam bahem dibber perat issur ever min hachay. o efshar shennasu fanim leshishsha bene haggevira vehiskimu laatzatam bimchirato, hagam shehaya libbam shalem immo.

rashi: Bechukko chug al pene tehom. kesheraka chug haaretz al hammayim, chok gevul bal yaavor:
Chug. leshon hekkef, kemo "uvammechuga yetaarehu" (yeshaya 44:13). konpash belaaz:
targum: Kad atken shemaya taman havet vead chag chugeta al appe tehoma:

rashi: Vayyachalmu chalom shenehem. vayyachalmu shenehem chalom, zehu feshuto, umidrasho kol 1 chalam chalom shenehem – shechalam et chalomo ufitron chavero, vezehu shenneemar vayyar sar haofim ki tov patar:
Ish kefitron chalomo. kol echad chalam chalom haddome lefitron heatid lavo alehem:
Veshichet artza. dash mibbifnim vezore mibbachutz (Bereshit Rabba):

ohc: Vayyomru vegomer ufoter en oto. perush, en poter bammetziut lefotro beshum ofen, veze hefech mehaamur befaro (Bereshit 41:8) "veen poter otam", perush, shehayu potrim ella lo patru et hachalom pitron hammitkabbel.
Halo lelohim pitronim. rotze lomar ki hu yiftor. venitchakkem shello yachshevuhu ki mitgaddel baddavar, veamar ki Adonai yesh lo potre chalomot harebe vehu echad mehem, vehu amro "sapperu na li".

Od nitkavven beamro pitronim leshon rabbim, al derech amram beharoe (berachot noah:), ki esrim vearbaa potre chalomot hayu birushalayim, ufatru chalom shel rabbi benaa, uma sheppatar ze lo patar ze, vechullam nitkayyemu, ad kan. veze hu amro lelohim pitronim, perush sheyyimmatze lachalom harebe pitronim vechullam tzodkim.

Vedikdek lomar tevat na lishne teamim: haechad ki pitron hachalom lo yatzdik ella im yifterennu beyomo velo leachar zeman, ki chol divre hachalom yechuvvenu yachdav beyomo. uchemo chen timtza sheen mitannin taanit chalom ella beyomo vaafilu beshabbat (shabbat 11.), laze amar sapperu na li, perush, atta, lishlol shello yeacharu ad yom o yomayim achar sheyyusar itztzevon nafsham.

Vetaam sheni, al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot noah:) ki hachalomot holchim achar happe, velaze chash yosef sheyyakdimu lesapper chalomotam lezulat mibbaladav veyitkayyem pitron hazzulat. laze amar sapperu na, perush: atta sapperu li kede lehakedim pitrono. vahagam sheamru beferek haroe ki esrim vearbaa potre chalomot hayu birushalayim, vechullan patru chalomo shel rabbi benaa uchemo shekkatavnu besamuch, omer ani ki davka im lo yihyu happitronim sotrin ze et ze, aval im hayu sotrim, kemo shettomar: rishon yomar ki yotziuhu mehammishmar ligdulla vesheni yomar sham yeshev ad mot – en mitkayyem ella rishon, velaze amar yosef sapperu atta, shebbaze yivtach ki yitkayyem pitrono.

rashi: Mesacheket betevel artzo. kol dorot harshaim shehayu meadam vead noach uminnoach vead avraham hayiti mesacheket alehem:
Veshaashuay. tzafiti ad bo dor hammidbar vikabbeluni:
targum: Chadya havet betevel areh veshibbuche bivne nasha:

rashi: Ki amar vegomer. kelomar, doche haya otah bekash, shello haya vedato lehassiah lo:
Ki amar pen yamut. muchzeket hi zo sheyyamutu anasheha (ketuvot 43):
Ki lo yaase adonay. elohim davar ella im ken gala sodo oto sod el avadav hanneviim:
targum: Are la chashrin pitgamin demitabbedin min kodam Adonai elohim elahin gela razeh leavdohi neviyaya:

rashi: Tikkach lah. yihye shellah ma shebyadah:
Pen nihye lavuz. im tevakkeshenna od yitparsem haddavar veyihye genay, ki me alay laasot od leammet devaray:
Hinne shalachti haggedi hazze. lefi sherimma yehuda et aviv bigdi izzim shehitbil ketonet yosef bedamo, rimmuhu gam hu bigdi izzim (Bereshit Rabba):
Mippeninim. margaliyyot:
Lo yishvu vah. lo yidmu leshavyah:
targum: Metul detava chachmeta min kefe tavata vechol midaam la fachem lah:

rashi: Hakkedesha. mekuddeshet umezummenet liznut:
Amon. gedela etzlo, leshon "haamunim ale tola" (Eicha 4:5):
Yom yom. alpayim shana (tehillim 90:4; Vayikra Rabba 19:1):
targum: Vahavet betzidoy mehemanta vechidshibbuchin havet kol yoma veyoma chadya ana kodamoy bechol zeman:

rashi: Meemek chevron. vahalo chevron bahar, shenneemar vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron (Bamidbar 13), ella meetza amukka shel oto tzaddik hakkavur bechevron, lekayyem ma shenneemar leavraham ben habbetarim ki ger yihye zaracha (Bereshit 15:13):
Vayyavo shechema. makom muchan lefuranut, sham kilkelu hashshevatim, sham innu et dina, sham nechleka malchut bet david, shenneemar vayyelech rechavam shechema (Melachim 1 12):
ohc: Lech na ree vegomer. atta hu mefaresh shelichut hammitzva sheose, veamar vahashiveni davar – asao shaliach lehachezir lo teshuva, shebbaze afillu leman deamar (fesachim 8:) sheluche mitzva enam nizzokim davka bahalichatan aval lo bachazaratan, bimtziut ze asao shaliach gam bachazarato, umeatta hare hu batuach sheyyashuv beshalom etzel aviv.

Vahagam shehayu echav sonim oto ushechiach hezzeka, sover yaakov kedaat rabbanan shecholkim im pelimo bifsachim (daf 8) veze leshono: tanya, chor shebben yisrael learmay bodek ad makom sheyyado maggaat, pelimo omer, kol atzmo eno bodek mippene hassakkana, ufarich, vehaamar rabbi elazar sheluche mitzva enam nizzokim, umeshanne hechi dishchiach hezzeka shani vechulei ad kan. vachachamim shecholkim im pelimo sovrim sheyyesh lechallek ben metziut shellefanenu limtziut shemuel, ki sham shechiach vadday hezzeka ki yishma shaul shemmosheach et david lemelech bimkomo, veen lecha shechiach hezzeka kazo, ma sheen ken chashash shemma haggoy yaalil alav eno karuy shechiach hezzeka. umimmenna nishma lema shellefanenu sheechav lo hayu vadday shechiach hezzeka, ki lo yaale al daat yaakov shekkol kach yisneuhu begeder shello yatztzil miyyadam shelichut mitzva. vegam hahu desullam raua sheamru bekiddushin (daf lat:) shechiach hezzeka hu yoter mibbedikat chor shebben yehudi legoy umimmetziut haachim sheenam chashudim kol kach lehara laachihem. veulay gam lisvarat pelimo yesh lomar sheeno chashuv shechiach hezzeka bimtziut ze shel bene yaakov, ushelichut mitzva matztzelet min hannezek.
Veim tomar, im ken lamma haya ma shehaya leeved nimkar yosef? yesh lomar shennezek shettachlito hatava umaala gedola eno chashuv nezek.

Veod taam yesh baddavar, vehu ki yaakov alav hashshalom dikdek bidvarav bashshelichut halo achecha roim bishchem lecha veeshlachacha alehem. hare gilla dato beferush ki shelichuto hu lishchem, ucheshehalach yosef velo metzaam bishchem vehalach lechazzer acharehem bemakom acher, hare hu sheliach atzmo, ki aviv lo shelacho lalechet lemakom acher veen kan shelichut mitzva, asher al ken haya ma shehaya. veyaakov nitkavven bema sheyyiched lo hammakom shetztzafa beruach hakkodesh ki lemakom acher yikraennu ason kaasher karahu, uvederech shechem lo timtzaehu raa. veyosef alav hashshalom chashav ki ma sheamar lo aviv shechem, haya more makom lo veen haddevarim bediyyuk, vehashshem gilgel gilgulim laasot asher zamam laasot.

Vayyavo shechema. makom asher shelacho aviv shamma, velo metzaam, vehaya mechazzer acharehem. velo hutzrach lomar haddavar, ki haddavar muvan meamro "vayyimtzaehu ish vehinne toe" achar shebba shechema.

rashi: Lo nakkennu nafesh. makkat nefesh, zo hi mita:
ohc: Vayyatztzilehu miyyadam. perush, lefi shehaadam baal bechira veratzon, veyachol laharog mi shello nitchayyev mita, ma sheen ken chayyot raot lo yifgeu baadam im lo yitchayyev mita lashshamayim, vehu amro vayyatztzilehu miyyadam, perush, miyyad habbechiri, uvaze satar amro "venire ma yihyu chalomotav" vegomer, ki habbechira tevattel haddavar, veen reaya im yaharguhu ki sheker dibber.

Lo nakkennu nafesh. perush, lehedya, ella nihye gormim lo mita, vehu amro achar kach al tishpechu dam hashelichu vegomer, zo hayta taanato lahem, vehu tamo kamus immo, shehu lehatztzilo lahashivo el aviv, ki yada neemana ki chayyat hassade hashlema lo, velo yareu velo yashchitu hannechashim vehaakrabbim bezera yaakov, gam lo yeakkevennu sham lamut baraav, uchemo shekken timtza shettechef vayyashav reuven el habbor shechazar elav lehotzio mehabbor.

rashi: Velo zachar sar hammashkim. bo vayyom:

Vayyishkachehu. leachar mikkan. mippene shettala vo yosef lezachro, huzkak lihyot asur shete shanim, shenneemar ashre haggever asher sam Adonai mivtacho velo fana el rehavim (Tehillim 40) – velo vatach al mitzrim, hakkeruyim rahav:
ohc: Velo zachar sar hammashkim vegomer. perush, hagam shello shechacho battechilla, lo zachar shemo kaasher tzivva alav yosef, dichtiv (Bereshit 40:14) "zechartani".

Veod modia hakkatuv sheshshechacho gam millibbo. vehakkavvana baze ki letzad shehechlit shello lezachro, nishkach millibbo, ki im haya belibbo uvedato tzad echad lezachro, beemtzaut ze haya ketzat nizkar, ella letzad hechlet haddavar nishkach mimmennu (millibbo). veulay yirmoz od vayyishkachehu shehaya mashkicho millibbo umiddato et alot al zichrono ad et ketz sheppakad Adonai et yosef vayyizkerehu. veulay sheyyirmoz beamro vayyishkachehu al ze hadderech: vayyishkach hu, aval hakkadosh baruch hu lo shechacho vayyizkerehu letova, vayhi mikketz vegomer, veaz sar hammashkim zachar oto beal karcho.
Chassalat parashat vayyeshev

rashi: Besumo layyam chukko. vegazar al yam suf keshebberao, al menat lehibbaka lifne moshe (Shemot 14:21):
Bechukko mosde aretz. bechikkato, milleshon chukko; kemo "al kappayim chakkotich" (yeshaya 49:16); vechen "umechek haaretz" (Yechezkel 43:14):
targum: Vechad sam leyama techumeh umaya la avrin leh (vechad) sam shatasaya deara:

rashi: Vattissa eshet adonav vegomer. kol makom shenneemar achar samuch:

ohc: Vayyishal vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar asher itto vemishmar, gam lamma hutzrach lomar bevet adonav?

Venire ki yitten hakkatuv taam lishelat yosef lishne sarim "maddua penechem", ki en ze mehilchot derech eretz levakkesh ladaat machshevot haggedolim. vehu amro vayyishal yosef et serise faro, perush, hagam shehu yosef kayyadua eved vehem serise hammelech, af al pi chen shealam. vehattaam hu "asher itto vemishmar" – yesh baze shene teamim: haechad, ki leheyotam immo bammishmar chash ki zapam immo hu, vehashsheni, ki letzad shehem itto bammishmar kol happanim shavim vechullan yikkaru asurim, uletzad ze lo chash ligdullatam. veod shehayu bevet adonav, veefshar ki nogea zaaf ze laadono, veshaal mishpat eved neeman laadono lefakkeach beinyanav, velaze shealam lemor elav "maddua" vegomer.
Dikdek lomar hayyom, ki en lomar sheppenehem raim letzad asram bevet mishmar, ki davar ze eno chadash, vehaya lahem lihyot ken gam etmol gam mishshilshom.

rashi: Veal devarav. al dibbatam raa shehaya mevi laavihem:
ohc: Vayyomru lo echav vegomer. taam kefel hamaloch im mashol: lihyot ki yesh beferush hachalom shete derachim, haachat malchut mammash, vehashsheniyya memshala. vehinne hammalchut hi begeder safek bappitron, aval hammemshala begeder muchlat. laze heshivuhu al sefek malchut veal hechlet memshala. keneged malchut amru "hamaloch" – hammistappek atta limloch afillu begeder safek? ucheneged hechlet memshala amru "im mashol". velaze tirgem uneklos bemalchut "at medamme" uvememshala "at sevir". vetaam kefel "hamaloch timloch" velo hispik lomar "hatimloch alenu hatimshol banu" – nitkavvenu lomar shete temihot: haachat al hammalchut mitztzad atzmah, afillu lo yihye melech ella al pinnat haammim davar gadol hu, velo day ze ella "timloch alenu". shekkevar baa lahem hakkabbala ki yehuda melech al kullam, veech yavo hachizzayon lehefech kabbala amittit? vegam amro "hatimshol" yitkavvenu el hadderech atzmo.

Od yechavvenu lomar bechefel haddevarim al ze hadderech: leheyot sheatta choshev limloch, laze ba hachalom shettimloch vegomer, uchemo chen hamashol vegomer, vehakkavvana baze "rayonach al mishkevach seliku" (Daniel 2:29).

Vayyosifu od vegomer. lefi ma shepperashti shello haya ella chalom echad, taam amro al chalomotav leshon rabbim. leheyot shehayu bachalomo harebe peratim: kama alummati 1, vegam nitztzava 2, vehinne tesubbena vegomer, laze amar leshon rabbim.
Veal devarav. perush, sheddibber alehem hachalom, lo yihye shechalam ken lo haya motzi mippiv kaddevarim haelle:

Od yirtze al derech amram beferek haroe (berachot 56.) amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua vegomer, hirher kuleh yoma, leorta vechulei, rayonach al mishkevach vechulei, velaze chashdu leyosef ki leheyoto choshev machshavot histarrut alehem rayonav vechulei, vehu amro al devarav perush al derech amro (Kohelet 3:18) "al divrat bene haadam" vegomer, ki al yede maasav umachshevotav asher hitassek behistarrut al haachim hu hassovev lachalom kol min den.

O yomar al derech amram beferek haroe (berachot noah:) kol chelma dela vechulei keiggarta dela mikkarya, vehu amro al chalomotav veal devarav sheeno maalimo vehu mevakkesh lekayyemo bema shemmesappero umevakkesh pitrono, hare ze maggid ki chafetz hu limshol beechav, vedavar ze yachpil hassina behafelaga.

O yomar al devarav, shemmedabber immahem kerea keach ulevavo choresh aven lahem, velaze tigdal hassina besibba zo. od al devarav sheeno mitbayyesh ledabber leechav haggedolim mimmennu panim befanim sheyyimloch alehem, veze yaggid gova libbo bifshitut medabber gedolot vechoshev ki haddavar pashut ad geder shello yakpidu al haddavar, velaze gadla sinatam vehaya ma shehaya.

rashi: Hashemiu. attem bene felishtim uvene mitzrayim vehacherizu zot veimru bearmenotechem sheyyeasfu al hare shomron lirot meal heharim betoch hair et darkam haraa:
targum: Basaru al birneyat beashdod veal birneyat beara demitzrayim vaamaru itkenashu al ture shomron vachazo shigoshaya sagian begavah vaanusin begavah:

rashi: Meallemim alummim. ketargumo measserin esarin – omrin, vechen nose alummotav (tehillim 126), vechamohu bilshon mishna vehaalummot notel umachriz:
Kama alummati. nizkefa:
Vegam nitztzava. laamod al amdah bizkifa:
ohc: Vehinne anachnu vegomer. amar shalosh peamim vehinne. da ki hachalom asher yihye mare hannevua vehodaa mehammodiim shellifne Adonai, haot vehammofet hu im yihye hachalom lacholem bahir vetzahir kayyom yair, sheyyihye haddavar beenav keillu hu behakitz mammash, ba haot vehammofet lehodia ki machaze shadday yecheze. ki hachalomot asher tzeirim yeshachaku vo yihye bilbul harayon vehagezamat hannidme. al ken sipper yosef veamar "vehinne" bechol perat, shekkol davar sheheruhu haya barur beene sichlo keillu haya roehu atta shehu behakitz behashelamat dato, veen ze ella chalom tzodek.

Vehinne anachnu vegomer. heruhu bachalom haalummot, hem chavilot chavilot shel mitzvot sheosim kullam yachad, veheruhu shechavilato yoter mitkomemet mikkullan bemaase sheavar alav im eshet potifar, vegam nitztzava shehaya shallit venitztzav al kol eretz mitzrayim, veod shekkol haalummot shel haachim muchnaim umushpalim lifne zechuto shel yosef ki hu davar hammaamid lechullan, vezan ufirnes otam, venitkavven lehodiam ze ulay yasiru sinatam beyadam haddevarim.

rashi: Lehanechil ohavay yesh. yesh itti nachala rabba:
targum: Deorit lerachamay shenaya sagiata vesimathon amale:

rashi: Ki im zechartani ittecha. asher im zechartani ittecha, meachar sheyyitav lecha kefitroni:
Veasita na immadi chased. en na ella leshon bakkasha:
ohc: Ki im zechartani vegomer. ulay shehitna alav shello yitkayyem happitron hattov ella bitnay "im zechartani", vetaam yosef shessam bitchono bo letzad ki raa chalomo yaggid besora tova, ki yisrael nimshelu legefen keamram befasuk (chullin tzav.) vehinne gefen lefanay vegomer, veim lo ba hachalom ella ledavar hannogea lesar hammashkim haya day laAdonai lehareoto shennoten hakkos al kaf paro, ella vadday heruhu al yosef shehu haggefen shehaya lefanav sham bevet hassohar. veamro vehi cheforachat perush shettafriach vetaale haggefen. nitztzah perush yitalle mimmadrega lemadrega. vehu shehodio mikkelal happitron veamar lo "ki im zechartani" vegomer.

Veachar haemet ken haya, sheal yado nitalla yosef, vesavar yosef sheyyefaresh lo haddavar hanneemar lo bachalom vegilla lo sodo. vetaam shenneenash yosef, ki taa bechashvo ki mertzono shel sar hammashkim tihye maalat yosef, velo chen hu, sheemet ki Adonai yaase haddavar al yado aval lo lirtzono, uchemo shekken haya sheal karcho dibber el paro "vesham ittanu" (Bereshit 41:12). uvemare hachalom shehodio haddavar lesar hammashkim kede sheyyitbasser yosef baddavar, lo sheyyasim bitchono bo.

rashi: Kenaani. tagra (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Bat ish kenaani. perush, socher. vehaggaon rabbi avraham ben ezra katav: "veyittachen shehu kemashmao". vaani omer ki lo yittachen sheyyidbeku bene yaakov bedavar shehikpidu alav avotehem shelashtan yachad, ucheamram bifsachim (fesachim 50.), vehakkatuv shamar et haddavar bema sheddikdek lomar "bat ish kenaani" – perush aviha kenaani velo hi kenaanit, uveeze ofen yihye haddavar im lo shettomar socher. veillu haya kenaani mammash umodia hakkatuv ki asa yehuda davar bilti hagun, ken haya lo lomar: "vayyar sham bat kenaanit" o "ishsha kenaanit veshem aviha shua". veen baze tosfot teva al hammichtav asher katav, uleinyan gilluy milleta kaze nomar lishtok, velichtov vadday.
Vayyikkacheha. perush, kedin likkuche ishsha.

rashi: Nasu mizze. hissiu atzman min haachva:
Nelcha dotayna. levakkesh lecha nichle datot sheyyemitucha vahem. ulefi feshuto shem makom hu, veen mikra yotze mide feshuto:
ohc: Nasu mizze ki shamati vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hutzrach lomar nasu mizze velo hispik amro "shamati omrim nelcha" vegomer? verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 84) darshu ki higgid lo shennasu mehaachva vehalchu levakkesh nichle datot sheyyemituhu bahem. uledivrehem kashe lamma lo nirta yosef lachzor laachorav, sheen lecha shechiach hezzeka kaze, vechas veshalom haya kemitchayyev benafsho lehistakken beatzmo.

Veulay ki yosef lo hevin divre haish kemo sheppershu zichronam livracha. verabbotenu zichronam livracha pershu ken achar shennitgalla ma sheasu haachim, ma sheen ken yosef hevin haddevarim kifshutan al ze hadderech: "nasu mizze" – perush mikkol hammachoz hahu, veen lo levakkesh od beoto machoz, vehattaam ki shamati omrim nelcha. umizze yada ki akru diratam mikkol hammakom hahu, velo haya yachol lomar "halchu dotayna" shello yada beverur shehalchu ledotan ella middivrehem, vesipper sidran shel devarim. uletzad shehaya bedato shel yosef ki ze haish hu meovre derech velo malach Adonai, hevin haddevarim kifshutan. uchefi ze yavo al nachon ma sheamar hakkatuv vayyelech yosef achar echav vayyimtzaem bedotan, shehaya lo lomar "vayyelech yosef achar echav ledotan vayyimtzaem". ulefi ma shepperashti yavo al nachon, shello hechlit lo hammalach shehalchu ledotan ella shennasu mehammakom hahu, laze haya mevakkesh ledarko bimkomot acherim vayyimtzaem bedotan, vehaven. uderashat rabbotenu bimkomah omedet, ki hattora hodia sheddibber elav hammalach veramaz sod davar.

Od yirtze amro achar echav, perush ki yosef darash divre hammaggid kidrashat razal, vehevin gam ken haddevarim kifshatan, vehichria happerush sheen kavvanato lomar elav shennasu min haachva, ella ki odam echav vereav, vehu amro achar echav, perush, achar haamadatam bematztzav echav, uferesh divre hammaggid kifshatan kemo shepperashti lemala.

Veim tomar, im ken ma hoil hammalach behodaa zo, kevan shello nishmar yosef? veulay ki nitkavven leharebot secharo kesheyyelech achar haachva kaasher ken asa. uvaze gam ken lo yikshe ech hammalach yigrom levattel et asher Adonai chashav laasot lehorid yosef lemitzrayim lesibbot yeduot gedolot veniflaot. ella sheyyada sheen devarav mevattelin hainyan, ella yesh bahem harevachat zechut shel yosef. veulay ki beemtzaut davar ze hishlim Adonai gedishat sea gedola vechavod asher hissig achar kach bemitzrayim.

rashi: Adonav. shel yosef:
Meik. targum shel metzik:
Tachtechem. et chaniyyatchem:
Taik haagala. mikkoved massa shealeha:
targum: Ha ana mayte alechon aka umaik lechon beatrechon kema deayka eglata ditina amira:

rashi: Venire ma yihyu chalomotav. amar rabbi yitzchak mikra ze omer darsheni, ruach hakkodesh omeret ken, hem omrim nahargehu vehakkatuv mesayyem venire ma yihyu chalomotav – nire devar mi yakum im shellachem o shelli. veie sheyyomru hem venire ma yihyu chalomotav, shemmikkevan sheyyaharguhu batlu chalomotav:
ohc: Veatta lechu vegomer. perush lechu, shekodem sheyyaggia hu etzlam hem yelchu likrato, velaze dikdek lomar veatta beoto et atzmo lechu. vetamam letzad hazzerizut vehammehirut asher lo yachlu lisbol ad sheyyaggia alehem. velaze timtza shello ikkevu behaggio etzlam ella techef umiyyad kaasher ba asu ma sheasu, veamram venahargehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava kamma 26:) asara bene adam shehargu adam echad im kullam yachad peturim. laze nitchakkemu veamru venahargehu yachad, shebbaze yihyu peturim middine adam:

Veamro venashlichehu vegomer veamarnu – perush, shekkeshennashlichehu babborot, min hassetam chuleda uvardelas hammetzuyim babborot yochluhu, uvaze nuchal lomar "chayya raa achalathu", lo sheyyomru "chayya raa haragathu", uvaze en motziin mippihem devar sheker.

Veim tomar: al mi samchu shivte yah laharog et hannefesh, uma gam nefesh tzaddik achihem? vahagam sheyyaatzu laharog oto bederech sheenam chayyavin kemo shekkatavnu, af al pi chen enan peturim middine shamayim, vaAdonai yavo bemishpat.

Ulay shehaachim danu bo din ed zomem, ki matzinu shehu hevi dibbatam raa el avihem veamar devarim sheyyitchayyevu mita al eduto. hahu amar sheachlu ever min hachay, hahu amar shehem baale arayot, veal kol achat mehem bene noach mitchayyevim mita, uven noach neherag al pi ed echad belo edim uvelo hateraa veal edut hakkerovim gam ken (282 hilchot Melachim perek 9). asher al ken danu bo mishpat ed zomem ufeturim hem middine shamayim. ella diltzad dine adam enam peturim ki en lahem hazama, laze nitchakkemu lahamito kullan yachad shebbaze en chiyyuv lechullan kemo shekkatavnu, aval ledin hashshamayim hem peturim mittaam sheyyadu neemana ki hu bikkesh lehargam. vechol ze hu sibbat hassibbot laasot Adonai asher zamam. veulay sheramzu bedivrehem sheyyaasu teshuva levassof veen lecha davar sheomed bifne hatteshuva, vehu amro veatta, veamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba perek ka) veen veatta ella teshuva, veze derech derash.
Venire ma yihyu vegomer. nitkavvenu lehochiach ki dibber sheker bachalomotav, o letzad ki rayonav al mishkavo seliku, veharaya kesheyyaharguhu ze lecha haot ki haya bode millibbo o rayonav vechulei:
