rashi: Ole timnata. uveshimshon hu omer vayyered shimshon timnata (Shoftim 14)? beshippua hahar hayta yoshevet, olin lah mikkan veyordin lah mikkan:
Cholalti. nivreti:
targum: Ad la nehevon tehome ityelidet vead dela nehevon mayene ishune demaya:
Are beyom asaruti chove yisrael alohi veasar al defalchin leegoraya bevet el veyitkatfan karnat egora veyippelun leara:
Di li hi tarita umilkana uveyuna vegibbaruta:
Vechulan galyan leenash demitbayen uteritzin leilen detzavin bidiata:
Metul dekusheta rane pumi verichuka desifvati risha:
Kabbilu veashidu bevet yaakov amar Adonai elohim elohe tzevaot:
Kabbilu yat pitgama haden di gezar Adonai alechon bet yisrael al kol zarayata deaskit meara demitzrayim lememar:
Vaana asket yatchon meara demitzrayim vedabberet yatchon bemadbera arbein shenin lemerat yat ara deemoraa:
Bearchata detzidketa mehalecha ana bego shevile dedina:
Metul ana ravrevane mitravrevin vesarche kulhon dayane ditritzuta:
Tavin piryay min dahava sennina umin dahava ovrizin vaalalti min sanya gavya:
Utra vikara dili mamona umazala vetzidketa:
Veyevad bet ekuke midkalil udetakif la yachasin cheleh vegibbar la yeshezev nafsheh:

bart: Harchava. hashshevakin shebbair:
Vehatteva. shemmannichin bah sefarim:
Vehassefarim. shekkonim bene hair lilmod bahem:

Vehakkotev chelko lannasi. mefaresh baggemara dehachi katane, uma takkanatan, yichtevu chelkan lannasi, kelomar ellu shennadru hanaa ze mizze vaasurim lehishtammesh birchovah shel ir uvatteva uvassefarim, yichtov kol echad mehem chelko sheyyesh lo barchava uvatteva uvassefarim lannasi, veachar kach yuchal kol echad mehem lehishtammesh bahem, shebbemamon shel nasi hem mishtammeshim veen echad mehem nehene mishshel chavero:

Rabbi yehuda omer. im yirtzu yichtevu chelkam lehedyot, ella sheim katvu lannasi en tzarich lezakkot lo al yede acher, demishshum chashivuto shel nasi kone af al pi shello zikka lo al yede acher, uvahedyot lo kana ad sheyyezakke lo al yede acher:

Anshe galil en tzerichin lezakkot. anshe galil kanteranim hayu uvechaasan hayu nodrim hanaa ze mizze, amdu avotehen vechatvu chelkehen lannasi, sheim benehem acharehem yidderu hanaa ze mizze lo yihyu asurim barchava shel ir o batteva o bassefarim, dimmon nasi hem:

Ezehu aris. shennotnim lo avodato arba ammot kaavodat hakkerem af al pi sheeno ella shura achat, vearis hu shemmesargim kannim kemo eres, kederech shemmesargim et hammittot, umadlin aleha sarige haggefanim. veallibba devet hillel kavae deamre leel beferek 4‏ eno cherem ad sheyyihyu sham shete shurot, uvearis modu divshura achat nammi have cherem:

Min haggader velassade. kegon im hayu haggefanim netuim lemizrachah shel gader vehazzemorot olim al haggader, im ba lizroa lemaaravah shel gader en monin arba ammot meikkaran shel gefanim shehen lehala min haggader, ella tzarich leharechik arba ammot min haggader shessarige haggefanim mudelot alav. vezo mikkulle vet shammay vechumre vet hillel:

Toim kol haomrim ken. dilolam lo amru vet hillel dearis shel shura achat shel gefanim kerem lehatzerichah sheyyarchiku mimmenna lassade arba ammot, velo huzkar din arba ammot bearis ella leinyan ze sheim yesh arba ammot meikkar gefanim laggader shehen mudelot aleha, notnin lo et avodato shishsha tefachim kemo shennotnim legefen yechidit, vezorea et hammotar ad haggader, veim en arba ammot meikkar haggefanim ad haggader lo yavi zera lesham, mide dahava aggefen shehi netua vaggat o vanneka deamar rabbi yose befirkin dilel im en sham arba ammot lo yavi zera lesham. verabbi yochanan ben nuri verabbi yose amru davar echad vehachi meforash behedya bayrushalmi:
Rabbi akiva omer shelosha tefachim. hi avodat gefen yechidit. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Konam yayin. ad shettechshach. shekken derech leshon bene adam, kesheomrim hayyom rotzim lomar ad hashelamat hayyom:
Shabbat zo. haya omed beemtza hashshavua veamar shabbat zo asur bechol hashshavua:
Vehashshabbat lesheavar. veasur nammi beyom hashshabbat, ki hu bichlal hashshavua sheavar:

Chodesh ze asur bechol hachodesh. im omed beemtza hachodesh veamar chodesh ze, asur ad tashlum hachodesh, veyom rosh chodesh lehabba, umuttar beyom rosh chodesh ki hu nimne im hachodesh habba, vaafillu haya rosh chodesh beyom sheloshim lachodesh sheavar. vechen shana zo, im amad beemtza hashshana veamar shana zo, asur ad tashlum hashshana, umuttar berosh hashshana, shehu nimne im hashshana haatida lavo:
Shavua ze. haya omed beemtza hashshemita veamar shavua ze, asur ad tashlum hashshemita, vehashsheviit bichlal shemita sheavra:

Im amar yom echad, shabbat echat, chodesh echad, shana echat, shavua echad, asur miyyom leyom. im omed beemtza hayyom veomer yom echad, asur ad lemachar kaet hazzot. vechen im omed bishmona lachodesh veamar chodesh alay, asur ad 8‏ lachodesh habba. vechen beshana. vechen bishmita. vechen im amar konam alay yayin yom setam, o shabbat, o chodesh, o shana setam, af al pi shello amar yom echad, shabbat echat, chodesh echad, dino meet leet. vehaomer konam alay yayin hayyom, af al pi shehu muttar keshettechshach, tzarich sheela lechacham, gezera kesheamar hayyom shemma yavo lehattir kesheyyomar yom setam, demichallaf leh ben yom lehayyom, o ben shabbat zo leshabbat setam. vechen kullam:
Chutz lizmannan. al menat leachlan chutz lizmannan o chutz limkoman:
Yissarfu. middichtiv bachattat baesh tissaref, limmed al kol pesulim shebbakkodesh shehen bisrefa:
Asham taluy. im shechato vekodem zerikat damo noda lo shello chata, dehashta have chullin baazara:

Chattat haof habbaa al hassafek. kegon ishsha shehippila safek valad safek ruach, kevan dechattat yoledet min haof hu kedichtiv (Vayikra 12) uven yona o tor lechattat, meviatah al hassafek, dehoil veenah nikteret lo ichpat lan i zarak dam al hassafek, veenah neechelet, deshemma lav valad hava vechullin hi zo unevela, deen chullin neechalim bimlika, vetissaref, dehavya kishar kadashim pesulim:
Yetilenna laamma. ammat hammayim hayta overet baazara veyotzet lenachal kidron. veayde deof rach hu mitmakmek veyotze bekilluach hammayim:
Kol hannisrafin lo yikkavru. dilma chafar eynash umashkach lehu veachel lehu:

Vechol hannikbarin lo yissarfu. mishshum dechol hannikbarim afaran asur. vechol hannisrafin kegon chametz uteruma vechilayim, afaran muttar lechibbus begadim. vechen kol hannisrafin dehekdesh, nammi afaran muttar, chutz mitterumat haddeshen dechatav beh rachamana (sham 6) vesamo etzel hammizbeach. vetanya, vesamo, benachat. vesamo, kullo. vesamo, shello yefazzer:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda bechol hanach telata bave dematnitin:
Dag dagim sheeni toem. lo dag velo dagim vehakkol bammashma:
Tefelin. mibbeli melach:
Betarit terufa. dag shechotchim oto chatichot chatichot umochrim oto, veyesh lo shem bifne atzmo veeno bichlal dag vedagim:
Tzir. mayim hayyotzim min haddagim hammeluchim:
Umuryas. shumman hayyotze middagim meluchim:
Tzachana. taarovet mine dagim terufim nikraim tzachana. vedugmato bemassechet avoda zara [daf 40.] hahi arba detzachanta:
Umuttar betzir uvemuryas. hoil veen ikkar mammashut haddag muvla bahem:
Hannoder mittarit terufa asur betzir uvemuryas. dechevan dehizkir terufa, mikkol davar shemmeorav bo min dag mashma:
Muttar betavshil sheyyesh bo taam yayin. kerabbanan derabbi yehuda:
Natan lah kesafim hare ellu muttarim. liknot mehen behema lekarban vesolet limnachot:
Yenot shemanim uselatot asurim. aval chittim vaasaan solet zetim vaasaan shemen anavim vaasaan yayin, hare ellu muttarim, dedarshinan shenehem, hem velo shinnuyehen velo valdotehen:

Natan lah mukdashim. kegon hifrish tale al pischo uleachar zeman amar lezona hibbaali li vehimmani al pischi beetnanech. salka datach amena hoil veadam rashshay lemannot acherim al pischo, mamoneh hu, veema lechul aleh etnan, kamashma lan delo. deamar kera lechol neder, lehotzi et hannadur kevar:
Ofot. shel chullin:
Hare ellu. pesulim lehakerava, sheetnan umechir chal alehen:
Ofot sheen hammum posel bahen. deamar kera (Vayikra 22) tamim zachar [babbakar] bakkesavim, tammut vezachrut bivhemot, veen tammut vezachrut beof:
Lechol neder. kol, lehavi et haof, sheaf hu ba beneder, sheetnan umechir chalim alav:
Veellu hen hannikbarim. mishshum deissure hanaa ninhu:
Hippila shilya tikkaver. deen shilya belo valad:
Usear nazir. tame. deillu sear nazir tahor keshemmegalleach beyom melot yeme nizro, bisrefa hu velo bikvura:

Chullin shennishchatu vaazara yissarfu. mishshum demichallefi bekadashim sheera bahem pesul tuma o pesul notar, vetau lememar behu nammi yikkavru, vaanan yalfinan middichtiv bachattat baesh tissaref, limmed al kol pesulim shebbakkodesh bisrefa, hilkach chullin shennishchatu baazara nammi bisrefa:

Vechen chayya shennishchata vaazara. veaf al gav dechayya lekka lemigzar bah dilma tau likbor kadashim pesulim, deha kulle alma yade dechayya bammukdashim lekka velo ate leichallofe, afillu hachi tissaref. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kol haasurin legabbe mizbeach. shehen pesulim lehakerava. vekachashiv lehu veazel:

Osrin bechol shehen. vaafillu nitarvu echad beelef kullan asurim lammizbeach, im eno nikkar. vechullehu mashkachat la deen nikkarim, chutz min hatterefa delo mashkachat la sheenah nikkeret ella kegon shennitarva derusat haari vehazzeev binkuvat hakkotz:

Harovea vehannirba vehammuktze vehanneevad. pesulin lammizbeach. deamar kera (Vayikra 22) ki mashchatam bahem mum bam, vetanya, kol makom shenneemar mashchatam eno ella erva vaavoda zara. erva, dichtiv (Bereshit 6) ki hishchit kol basar et darko. avoda zara, dichtiv (Devarim 4) pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel. verovea venirba ditnan bematnitin, kegon derovea o nirba al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim, deenah niskelet bechach aval pesulot hen lekarban:
Muktze. behema shehiktzuha laavoda zara. veenah pesula lehakerava ad sheyyaasu bah maase leshem avoda zara, kegon sheavdu bo hakkemarim im hu shor o gezazuhu im hu se:
Veneevad. eno asur bahanaa af al pi sheavaduhu, sheen baale chayyim neesarim bahanaa kesheovdim otan, aval nifsalim lammizbeach:
Veetnan umechir. behedya paslinhu kera (sham 23) lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev:
Vechilayim. tayish habba al harachel:
Vehatterefa. dichtiv bemaaser (Vayikra 27) kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet, perat litrefa sheenah overet, vekarban mizbeach yalef mimmaasar behema:
Veyotze dofen. shennikrea immo vehotziu haubbar derech haddofen. umaatinan mikkera dichtiv (sham 22) ki yivvaled, perat leyotze dofen:
Hu asur. lammizbeach:
Uma shealav muttar. deha lo neevad:
Hu uma shealav asur. hu asur lammizbeach, umuttar afillu baachila, kedilkamman besamuch. uma shealav, tachshitim shealav, asurin bahanaa shehare neevdu veyesh bahen tefisat yede adam:
Ze vaze. hammuktze vehanneevad:
Chal al hakkol. vaafillu bivhema temea uvaavanim:

Umoalin begiddulehen. shehammakdish behema levedek habbayit, moel bachalavah. veim hikdish tarnegolet, moel bevetzatah. ma sheen ken bekadshe mizbeach, shechalav shel mukdashim uvetzat torim lo nehenim velo moalim:
Veen bahen hanaya lechohanim. aval bekadshe mizbeach yesh mehem shehabbasar neechol lakkohanim veyesh mehen shennehenin baor:

Vezorim betocho. dechashev hefsek ureshut acheret kevan deamok asara verachav arbaa umefullash. aval pachut measara o mearbaa o afillu amok asara verachav arbaa veeno mefullash ella shehakkerem makkifo mishshalosh ruchot, en zorim betocho, shehare hi kegat shennechleku vah rabbi eliezer verabbanan lekamman, verabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar kerabbanan deasre lizroa begat:
Shomera shebbakkerem. tel gavoah shehashshomer omed alav lishmor hakkerem veroe lemerachok:
Zorim betochah. uveha lo pelige rabbanan al rabbi eliezer, lefi shehi gevoha veen avir hakkerem makkifah, aval begat sheavir hakkerem makkifah asre rabbanan, vechen halacha:
Veim haya sear kotesh. shehassarigim shel haggefanim shehen keruyin sear hayu mitarvim umistabbechim lemala al gabbe hashshomera ze al gabbe ze kaali bammachtesh:
Vahalo af hannedava ola. perushe kamfaresh may benayhu:
Bizman shehi vaa chova. shehi muttelet al hayyachid lehakerivah. somech aleha kulei:
Veim haya chohen. oto shehifrish asham venitkapper beacher venitteko larishon biriyya:
Avodatah veorah. shel ola hakkenuya middeme oto asham, shello hi, shehu atzmo makrivah venotel haor, vaafillu eno min hammishmar shel otah shabbat:
Eno somech aleha. denidvat tzibbur en bahem semicha:

Veaf al pi shehu chohen avodatah veorah leanshe mishmar. shehare shel tzibbur hu veen kohen shel mishmar acher rashshay lehakeriv, dichtiv (Devarim 18) levad mimkarav al haavot, ma shemmachru haavot ze laze, tol atta et shabbattecha vaani ettol et shabbatti. vahalacha kedivre chachamim:

Shura achat betoch shello veshura achat betoch shel chavero. umayre kegon sheshshura achat shel shete gefanim veshura achat shel shalosh. vaafillu rabbi shimon deamar lekamman gabbe hamesakkech gafno al gabbe tevuato shel chavero lo kiddesh deen adam oser davar sheeno shello, hacha mode demitztarfin leesor hazzeraim, kevan deikka shello veshel chavero:
Vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim. sheen echad mehem rachav shemone ammot, divrochav shemone ammot amrinan beshilhe pirkin deen mitztarfot:
Hare ellu mitztarfot. lihyot keruyin kerem vetzarich leharechik arba ammot:

Im ersan millemala. sheheela rashe haggefanim al gabbe haggader umitarvin otam shebbetzad haggader mizze im otam shebbetzad haggader mizze. veersan hu leshon eze aris ditnan lekamman beresh perek 6, kelomar sheasa lahen eres:

Hakkol ilan serak. desavar rabbi meir kol shear ilanot adam mevattel etzel gafno, verabbi yose savar dechol min shergilin litta mimmennu sadot shelemot chashuvim hen veen adam mevattelan mippene gafno, vahalacha ketanna kamma deilan sheeno ose ferot hu devatel legabbe gefen:

Sheat osa eni ochel ad happesach. hachi mashma, sheat osa achshav eni ochel ad happesach, aval leachar happesach ani ochel. aval kol ma sheat osa ad happesach eni ochel, mashma, kol ma sheat osa mehayyom ad sheyyavo happesach eni ochel oto leolam afillu leachar happesach:
Hannoder min hayyarak. lo matzati ella deluin. veim min yarak hu ammay lo zevin leh:
Ken haddavar. umishsham ani mevi reaya. shemma omer lo matzati ella kitnit. umiddeka ate lehimmalech al haddeluin alma min yarak hu. vahalacha kachachamim:
Min hammadrega. mittel gavoah asuy kemin madrega:

Im keshehu omed lematta baaretz. yachol lelakket haanavim hatteluyin bearis, roim et kol hearis keillu hu mekom ikkar haggefanim vesharshan, veoser arba ammot bassade lechol ruach missefat hearis velachutz, vedavka lechattechilla hu deoser lizroa, aval eno mekaddesh ella shishsha tefachim mide dahava ammotar piske aris dilkamman beferek 7:

Veim lav. sheeno yachol lilkot kol haanavim ad sheyyaale bammadrega o vassullam, en asur lizroa ella tachat hearis bilvad, vechutza lo muttar, vaafillu betoch arba ammot shel ikkar haggefanim shel aris, hoil veomdim al hammadrega, vechen halacha:

Af hannotea shura achat baaretz veshura achat bammadrega. mishshete shurot shetztzarich kede sheyyechashvu kerem, vehasheta lo mayre bearis ella bishte shurot shel gefanim shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotzet zanav. im hammadrega gavoah asara, en shete shurot mitztarfot lihyot kerem ella din gefen yechidit yesh lechol shura veshura. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Asur befol hammitzri yavesh. dedagan kol mide demiddegan mashma, kol davar sheosin mimmennu keri, veha nammi middegan hu:
Hannoder min haddagan asur bakkol. mine kitniyyot sheosin mehen keri. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Im hazzevalim o im hammayim. keshemmezabbel karmo o kesheppoteach ammat hammayim lehashekot hakkerem peamim yesh immahem zeraim, vechol hanne shello vechavvana nizreu share, delo tizra karmecha bechavvana mashma:
Siarattu haruach. shehaya omed bassade vezorea veholicha ruach seara et hazzera bakkerem:
Leacharav muttar. deshello vechavvana haya velo raa sheholich haruach et hazzera letoch hakkerem:
Ulefanav asur. im siarattu haruach lefanav veraa asur:
Ketzad yaase im asavim yofach. yacharosh vihappech sharshe haasavim veshuv lo yitzmechu:
Im aviv. shekkevar tzamach hazzera ella shello hevi shelish:
Yenappetz. hazzera min hashshibbolet, vehakkashshin muttarin vehaddagan asur:
Veim hevia dagan tiddalek. vehakkol asur:
Tachat chattat o tachat ola. satam velo amar tachat chattat zo o ola zo:
Lo amar kelum. dichtiv (sham 27) lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto, ad sheyyihye hahekdesh yadua umeyuchad keshemmemir bo:
Tachat chattat zo. vehayta chattat omedet lefanav:
Hare ellu leola. mashma lidme ola. dei inhu gufayhu bae leakrove, hava amar hare ellu ola:

Velad chattat. sheavra shenatah. lo chazya lehakerivah chattat, devat shenatah ketiv. mihu mishshum hay pesula lechodeh enah meta, ella tire ad shettistaev ad deikka tarte leriuta, sheavra shenatah veavda, o sheavda venimtzet baalat mum. vehachi metaretz lematnitin baggemara, dehay vesheavda dekatane, ole lechan ulechan, vehachi kaamar, sheavra shenatah veavda, vesheavda venimtzet bah mum:
Im mishshekkipperu habbealim. im leachar shennimtzet zot kipperu habbealim beacheret:

Tamut. vaafillu lerabbanan diflige aleh derabbi lekamman befirkin veamre deen chattat meta ella shennimtzet leachar shennitkapperu habbealim, beha modu, hoil veikka tarte leriuta, deavra shenatah veavda, o avda venimtzet baalat mum. aval avda lechoda, hoil venimtzet kodem kappara, af al gav shelachar shennimtzet nitkapperu habbealim beacheret, enah meta ella tire:
Lo nehenim. midderabbanan:
Velo moalin. im nehenu mehen, peturim mikkarban meila. dechevan delo hi velo dameha kerevim, azla kedushshatah:
Veim ad shello chipperu habbealim. shello ratzu lehitkapper beacheret:
Tire ad shettistaev. veaavra shenatah kae. deotah sheavda venimtzet baalat mum, timmacher miyyad veyavi bedameha acheret:
Veosa temura. hoil vedameha omdim likkarev. dedavar haomed kede sheyyire veyistaev ose temura:
Ketzad maarimin al habbechor. lehafekio mikkohen ulehakrivo lechovato:
Yalda zachar yikrav ola. divchor lo kaddish ella merechem, vechevan demeikkara atpeseh bikdushsha acharita, tu lo chayla aleh kedushshat bechora:

Veim nekeva zivche shelamim. lav bimvakkeret mayre, deen hannekeva kedosha bivchora devae leaarome ala. ella bevehemat kadashim, deim chattat hi venitabbera verotze lehaarim shello yelech lemita, divlad chattat lemita azel, yeshannehu likdushsha acheret. [vekamashma lan] valdot kadashim bahavayatan kedoshim velo bime imman, vechevan daadayin lo kadshu kedushshat imman, matze learkove alayhu kedushsha achariti, dilchi mityelid lo have chattat:
Piske aris. mefaresh la veazel:
Shemone ammot vaod. kelomar mosif od al shemone ammot davar muat, vehi shishshit amma dehaynu tefach:
Shecharav meemtzao. kegon shennata achad asar gefanim betzad haggader vecharav gefen haemtzai venaasu shete arisin, sheen aris pachot mechamesh gefanim:

Shemone ammot vaod notnin lo avodato. lerabbi yochanan ben nuri delo chashev aris kerem noten shishsha tefachim laze veshishsha tefachim laze vezorea et hammotar, uleman dechashev leh kerem tzarich sheyyitten arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze veeno yachol lizroa ella oto vaod. mihu afillu man dechashev aris kerem lav lechol mile, middelo vae befiske aris shesh esre amma kemo vekarachat hakkerem, veod dehazzorea arba ammot bakkerem mekaddesh vehazzorea motar piske aris mishshishsha tefachim veelach lo mekaddesh kedilkamman [perek 7 mishna 3]:
Kerem shehu natua al pachot mearba ammot. sheen ben shura leshura arba ammot:
Eno cherem. umarchik shishsha tefachim vezorea et hashshear, dechevan sheen yachol lacharosh bishvarim benehem en shem kerem alav:

Vachachamim omrim kerem. deroim et haemtzaiyyim keillu enam umitztarfin hachitzonim im yesh benehem revach harauy lahem. lefi shedderech bene adam litta shurot retzufot harebe beyachad, veotan sheruyin lehitkayyem uleheasot kerem yishshaaru kerem, vehashshear yihyu leetzim. hilkach ellu haemtzaiyyim hannetuim betoch harevach haruyim lihyot ben shura leshura roim otam keillu hem etzim bealma, vehachitzonim mitztarfim lihyot kerem:

Kesheaggia lo. af al pi shehosif matayim ad shello higgia lo muttar, meachar sheeno mitatztzel bakkilayim, aval kesheechezor asur mishshum denitatztzel venityaesh, vedichvatah gabbe mechitztzat hakkerem shennifretza, dichshennityaesh velo gedarah kiddesh, aval lo nityaesh shemmitassek kol shaa ligdor velo hispik ad shehosif matayim lo kiddesh. vechetzad meshaarin im hosif matayim, roim keshechotchim yarak ze o min shel tevua zo min hamechubbar, bechamma zeman yavash shello tishshaer bo lecha, hagga beatzmecha sheyyavash bemea shaa, im nishtaha baaretz chatzi shaa mishshehiggia lo velo likketo hare hosif matayim veasur, shekkeshem shehu yavesh millachuto bechol chatzi shaa chelek mimmatayim keshehu betalush, kach mosif bachatzi shaa chelek mimmatayim keshehu bimchubbar:

Mimmaase retachta. ochel asuy mikkemach shehurtach bakkedera. uchelala demilleta, bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam lefi hazzeman vehammakom, vei ikka ducheta dekaru letzali mevushshal velimvushshal tzali, hannoder min hamevushshal asur betzali, vechen kol kayyotze baze. vei rubba kare leh hachi umiuta kare leh hachi, lo amrinan zil batar rubba, ella have sefek nedarim, vechol sefek nedarim lehachemir:

Maase bevet choron vechulei. baggemara mefaresh dematnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, veim hochiach sofo al techillato asur, umaase nammi bevet choron beechad shehochiach sofo al techillato vechulei:

Veenan lefanecha ella chede sheyyavo abba veyochal. alma lo netanam ella kede sheyyavo aviv veyochal, veasur. aval im amar hare hen lefanecha veim retzoncha yavo abba veyochal, muttar. veim seudato mochachat alav, shehirba basseuda yoter mimma shehaya tzarich venikkarin haddevarim shebbishvil aviv asa kede sheyyavo veyochal, asur:

Appifyarot. etzim o kanim arugim sheti vaerev, umadlim alehem sarige haggefanim umashkivim otan bahen keshehen arukkot harebe. veim hidla haggefen al miktzat haarig asur lizroa tachat hammotar, veaf al pi sheen alav zemorot, veim zara lo kiddesh:
Veim hillech hechadash. sheggadal haggefen vehotzi sarigim umille kol haappifyarot:
Asur. hazzera shennizra tachat hammotar im hosif matayim leachar shehillech hechadash alehen:

Vechen hammadle gefen al ilan serak. dino kedin appifyarot, lefi sheadam mevattelo al gabbe gafno vahave keillu kullo gefen, aval ilan maachol sheen adam mevattelo al gabbe gafno, oto motar sheen haggefen mudlet alav chashuv bifne atzmo velo have kegefen umuttar lehavi zera lesham:

Rabbi eliezer omer kiddesh. shekken bearviyya mekayyemin kotzim bakkerem kede sheyyiru gemallehem, umeachar shemmiktzat bene adam mekayyemim otam bisdotehem havu chilayim bechol makom, deshappir karinan bo asher tizra, demashma ma shebbene adam nohagim lizroa verotzim bekiyyuman:
Lo kiddesh ella davar shekkamohu mekayyemim. beoto makom, kegon kotzim bearviyya lefi shellesham mekayyemim otam, aval bishar mekomot sheen mekayyemin otan muttar. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hairus. min yarak shealav rechavim venotnin oto battavshil, vekorin lo baaravi 378:
Vehakkissom. 206 belaaz shemmadlin oto al hachanuyyot veal hachallonot:
Veshoshannat hammelech. 273 belaaz:
Vechol mine zeraim enan kilayim bakkarem. min hattora, aval midderabbanan havu chilayim, dehachi muchach bimnachot [daf 15]:
Kanbos. 237 belaaz uvaaravi 162:
Vachachamim omrim kilayim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hakkinras. baaravi 606 uvelaaz 310, vehu dardar haamur battora (Bereshit 3) vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach:

Hammuddar hanaa mechavero veyesh lo merchatz uvet habbad vechulei. reuven shenneesar alav lehenot benichse shimon veyesh leshimon bair merchatz uvet habbad shehiskiran laacherim, uva reuven lehishtammesh bahen, roim im nishar leshimon makom beze hammerchatz uvet habbad shello hiskiro, kegon bor bevet hammerchatz vechayyotze baze, asur liruven lehishtammesh bahem. veim lav, muttar:
Umet o shemmecharam leacher muttar. dechevan sheamar betcha sadcha, lo nitkavven ella bizman shehem shello. aval im amar bayit ze o sade zo, asaram alav leolam:
Yachazirennu. lammakom shehaya techilla veyizra hammotar:
Aziz. shem makom:
Amar lo muttar. sheen adam mevattel teenato mippene gafno:
Bet hamagganya. shem makom:
Saddan shel shikma. shoresh shel ilan shikma, vehu ilan teena haggadel bayarim, vechotchin mimmennu korot levinyan:
Tachat kora zo asur vehashshear muttar. sheani roe kol kora vekora keilan bifne atzmo:
Eno asur ella min hakkavush shel yarak. distam kavush shel yarak hu:
Kavush sheeni toem. mashma kol mine kavush. vechen shaluk, tzaluy, maliach, belo hei, mashma kol minim shel shaluk, veshel tzaluy veshel maliach:
Dargash. mitta ketanna shennotnin otah lifne mitta gedola, umimmenna olin lammitta haggedola:
Litchumah shel ir. alpayim amma lechol ruach sevivoteha:
Ibburah shel ir. habbattim hayyotzim mimmenna betoch shivim amma veshirayim. keishsha meubberet shekkeresah bolet lachutz:
Haagaf. [mekom] neilat haddelet. vedugmato, yagifu haddelatot, besefer (Ezra) [nechemya 7] veen halacha kerabbi meir bechullah matnitin:
Mechol hakkerem. makom panuy ben kerem laggader saviv, kemo mecholot hannashim keshemmerakkedot besibbuv, leshon az tismach betula bemachol (yirmeya lo):

Im yesh sham shetem esre amma. kedivre vet hillel, noten arba ammot laavodat kerem vezorea hashshear. aval im en sham shetem esre amma lo yavi zera lesham, dearba ammot delahade cherem avodat hakkerem, vearba ammot delahade kotel kevan delo mizdare mippene tikkun hakkotel, kede sheyyehallech adam al gabbe karka samuch lakkotel veyihye heafar niddosh veyitchazzeku yesodotav, afkore mafkar lehu. veemtzaiyyot i ikka arba ammot chashive vei lo vatle legabbe cherem, vehacha lo vainan shesh esre, sheen haissur ella mitztzad echad. vechol hanach ammot beamma bat shishsha tefachim:
Kerem shecharav. eser gefanim levet sea. sheyyesh bakkarka shel bet sea eser gefanim lo fachot mikken:
Unetuot kehilchatan. dehaynu shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotza zanav, veen rechokot zo mizzo shesh esre ammot velo fachot mearba ammot:
Kerem dal. sheggefanav muatim, veaf al pi chen din kerem yesh lo. veen ze karachat hakkerem, deoto charav meemtzao veze necherav mikkol tzad:
Irbuveya. sheen haggefanim mechuvvanim keshura:

Im yachol lechavven. bechol hakkerem shetayim keneged shalosh, kegon sheyyavi chut umoteach umotze haggeza mechuvvan shetayim keneged shetayim veechad yotze zanav, af al pi shehannof eno mechuvvan hare ze cherem. aval im motze hannof mechuvvan vehaggeza eno mechuvvan en ze cherem:
Ketavnit keramim hare ze charem. uvae harechaka shesh esre ammot, veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Haomer lezona. achat nachrit veachat yisreelit, vehu shettihye mechayyave lavin, veen tzarich lomar mechayyave keretot umitot bet din. aval etnan shel penuya vehi yisreelit eno pasul lammizbeach, deen ze etnan zona, shehare lo neesra lichhunna bevia zo. vechen etnan shenatna ishsha leish, eno pasul. aval etnan zachar, pasul:

Afillu mea kullan asurim. hitna immah latet lah tale echad beetnanah veshalach lah afillu mea, lo amrinan chad deatne immah have etnan vehanach acharine kullam mattana, ella kullehu chashive etnan vaasurin:

Vetalin shifchatcha etzel avdi. beeved ivri sheen lo ishsha uvanim mayre, sheen reshut beyad rabbo limsor lo shifcha kenaanit leholid mimmenna avadim kevan shello hayta lo ishsha mittechilla, hilkach etnanah asur ledivre chachamim. verabbi deamar lo have etnan, let leh hay sevara, devadday afillu en lo ishsha uvanim rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit. i nammi, afillu it leh hay sevara, savar hoil veeved ivri huttar mikkelalo beshifcha kenaanit, la chashiv etnan zona. veen halacha kerabbi:

Haya echad min hashshuk vechulei. lehodiacha kocho derabbi eliezer ben yaakov nakat la, daafillu echad min hashshuk sheen lo chelek bechatzer share leh rabbi eliezer ben yaakov likkanes mittaam berera. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

Yesh bekadshe mizbeach. shekkadshe mizbeach osim temura. vedavka behemot shel kadshe mizbeach. aval ofot umenachot en osin temura. vekadshe bedek habbayit en osin temura, leel besof perek kamma memaatinan lekadshe bedek habbayit mikkera delo avde temura:

Mishshum piggul venotar vetame. kullehu bishlamim ketive, ushelamim bichlal kol hakkodashim hayu, velamma yatzu, lehakish alehen, lomar lach ma shelamim meyuchadim kadshe mizbeach, af kol kadshe mizbeach:

Veladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan. chalavan, dichtiv basar, velo chalav. veladan, kegon deiabbar lifne pidyonan veolid leachar pidyonan, delet lehu takkanta leakrovinhu, demikkoach kedushsha dechuya ka atya. lifrekinhu, lo allima milleta lemitpas pidyonan. aval nitabberu leachar pidyonan, kivlad tzevi veayyal ninhu umuttarim. uvekadshe bedek habbayit afillu iabbur kodem pidyonan muttarim, delo akdeshinhu ella ledame velo chamira kedushshatayhu kulle hay:
Veen notnim mehem. mikkadshe mizbeach:
Laummanim. shebbonim bammikdash:
Bischaran. shehem notlim sachar mikkadshe bedek habbayit, deamar rachamana (Shemot 25) veasu li mikdash, li mishshelli, dehaynu mikkadshe bedek habbayit:

Veyavi vedamav ola. veresha dekatane hare ellu keola gabbe valad shel temura, mishshum dehekdesh rishon shebbau ellu kullam mikkocho hu karev, dezachar hu. aval hacha bemafrish nekeva leola, hekdesh rishon shekkullam baim mikkocho nekeva hi veenah kereva, hilkach eno keola ella yimmacher veyavi bedamav ola:
Hammafrish nekeva leasham. veen asham ba min hannekeva:

Tire ad shettistaev. ad sheyyippol bah mum. uvaggemara parech, vetimmacher belo mum, dehoil velo chazya lemilleteh mum gamur hu ze velo kaddesha ella ledame, vetimmacher miyyad veyavi bedameha asham. umeshane, hoil unechat la kedushshat damim, nachata la nammi kedushshat hagguf leha milleta devainan mum:
Im karav ashamo. vetu lo tzarich leasham:
Yippelu dameha lindava. lashshofarot shebbammikdash shemmehen hayu notlim lehavi lenidvat tzibbur:

Timmacher shello bemum. dehoil velo chazya leasham en lecha mum gadol mizze, velo kaddesha kedushshat hagguf, vetimmacher miyyad veyavi bedameha asham. veaf al gav degabbe mafrish nekeva leola lo paleg rabbi shimon devaya mum, hatam hu deikka shem ola binkeva, deashkechan olat nekeva beof, aval asham nekeva lo matzinu, hilkach hayenu muma velo kaddesha ella ledame. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Temurat asham vechulei. kullan yiru, dahalacha hi kol shebbachattat meta, baasham roa, utemurat chattat meta:
Yamutu. deit leh lerabbi eliezer kachattat kaasham, ma bachattat meta af baasham meta:
Yavi vidmehen olot. demotarot lenidvat yachid azle velo lenidvat tzibbur:
Asham shemmetu vealav o shekkipperu vealav beacher. divchattat tamut, uvaasham yire ad sheyyistaev:
Chametz befesach. matnitin rabbi yehuda hi, deamar [pesachim koach:] notar beval totiru vechametz beval totiru, ma notar bisrefa af chametz bisrefa. veenah halacha:

Uteruma temea. dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) vaani hinne natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay, bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma tehora veachat teruma temea, uchetiv lecha, shellecha tehe lehassikah tachat tavshilcha:
Arla. mikkile hakkerem gamar, vechile hakkerem dichtiv (Devarim 22) pen tikdash, tukad esh:
Et sheddarko lissaref. aarla vechile hakkerem kae, ochalim shel arla veshel kile hakkerem sheddarkan lissaref yissarfu, mashkin sheen darkan lissaref yikkavru:

Umadlikin befat uveshemen shel teruma. mishshum dechalal teruma temea im chametz befesach vearla vechile hakkerem deissure hanaa ninhu, ki hechi delo tite lomar sheggam teruma temea asura bahanaa, hadar tanna umadlikin lehanot befat uveshemen shel teruma temea:
Ad happesach asur ad sheyyaggia. devilshon bene adam, ad velo ad bichlal:
Ad sheyyehe, asur ad sheyyetze. demashma kol zeman shehu hove:

Ad lifne happesach rabbi meir omer asur ad sheyyaggia. delo meayyel eynash nafsheh assefeka, vedavar hamevorar likrot pene happesach kaamar, vehayenu ad sheyyaggia. verabbi yose savar, meayyel eynash nafsheh leesor bechol ma sheyyuchal lehistappek. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hare ellu chivchor uchemaaser. kikdushshat bechor umaasar behema, sheen nishchatim beitlis, dehaynu bashshuk shemmochrin bo habbasar, afillu leachar shennafal bahen mum venifdu:
Chutz mehabbechor vehammaaser. mippene sheen hanaa lahekdesh bimchira, didme bechor lakkohen, udeme maaser labbealim umishshum hanaa didhu lo mezalzelinan bakkadashim:
Uvain michutza laaretz laaretz chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. sheenan baim lechattechilla michutza laaretz, kedimfaresh taama lekamman. aval im bau temimim, yikrevu:
Labbealim. bechor lakkohen, umaaser leyisrael:
Amar rabbi shimon ma taam. shehabbechor vehammaaser enan bain michutza laaretz kishar kadashim:
Shebbechor umaaser yesh lahem parnasa vimkoman. yesh lahem takkana bimkoman sheyyiru ad sheyyistaavu veyeachlu bemuman labbealim:

Ushear kol hakkodashim. af al pi shennafal bahen mum hare hen bikdushshatan, vetzarich atta lifdotan ulehaalot demehen ulehakrivan, vehoil vesofan lehaalot demehen, yaalu hen atzman veyikrevu. ufesak hahalacha, divchor umaaser shealu michutza laaretz temimim lo yikrevu, dichtiv (Devarim 14) veachalta lifne Adonai‏ elohecha vegomer‏ maasar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha, mimmakom sheatta maale maaser vedagan atta maale bechor, umimmakom sheen atta maale maasar dagan, en atta maale bechor. umaasar behema nammi ittakkash lemaasar dagan:

Yavi meellu umeellu. yearvem yachad. dechevan demittarvayhu mayte, lo have chattat shennitkapperu bealeha beacheret. aval i hava mayte mechad minnayhu, medachu acharine, dahavu lehu deme chattat shekkipperu bealeha beacheret:
Vehashshear yippelu lindava. dahavu kishar motarot shel chattat deazli lindava:

Vahare chattat baalat mum. aval im chattat temima, tikrav hi vehammaot yelchu leyam hammelach, hoil vechipperu habbealim beacheret. vechol hanach allibba derabbi deamar avuda bishat haferasha kegon hanach maot denimtzeu kodem kappara, azle leyam hammelach:

Vehashsheniyya tamut divre rabbi vachachamim omrim kulei. hakkol modim bemitkapper besheenah avuda, sheavuda meta. lo nechleku ella bemitkapper baavuda, derabbi savar hammafrish leavud keavud dame, kelomar hammafrish tachat karban avud, dino keavud. vechi hechi deim nitkapper besheeno avud, haavud hannishar kesheyyimmatze dino sheyyamut, hachi nammi ki nitkapper beechad mehen vaafillu baavudim, yelchu sheenan avudim leyam hammelach. verabbanan savre, lo amrinan hammafrish leavud keavud dami, vedavka hammitkapper besheenah avuda vehaavuda nishara, haavuda meta veaf al pi shennimtzet kodem kappara. aval im nitkapper baavuda venishara sheenah avuda, enah meta, ella tire ad shettistaev. vahalacha kachachamim:
Temurat ola temurat shelamim. garsinan, velo garsinan utemurat shelamim:
Hare zo temurat ola. ditfos lashon rishon:

Devarav kayyamin. vechetzyah temurat ola vechetzyah temurat shelamim. vehay delo kaamar temurat ola ushelamim veamar temura attarvayhu, mishshum desavar i amena temurat ola ushelamim tihye kedosha velo kereva, kedin haomer chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim shehi kedosha veenah kereva, vetaa behachi vesavar emar temura akkol chad vechad ki hechi deteheve kedushsha gemura likkarev, hilkach af al gav deamar ki hay lishana, letarvayhu ikkavvan, vetire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher veyavi bidme chetzyah ola uvidme chetzyah shelamim, uvehachi askinan, kegon shehayu lefanav ola ushelamim keshehemir et zo bahen. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Veal shiggatan chattat. shegaga shechayyavim aleha chattat hi, kegon habba al achat min haarayot kesavur shehi ishto, vehaoved avoda zara shemmishtachave lah kesavur zibbuach vekittur venissuch asra tora velo hishtachavaya, vehamechallel et hashshabbat kesavur chol hu, vechen kol kayyotze baze sheyyodea beikkar haissur ella shennelam mimmennu ze hammaase sheose. aval haomer muttar legamre, deoker kol hagguf, kegon haomer en shabbat battora, en avoda zara battora, lo shogeg hu ze ella anus gamur hu ufatur:
Lo hoda. kegon shene zetim echad shel chelev veechad shel shumman, achal echad mehem veeno yodea eze mehen achal. ishto vaachoto immo bammitta, ba al achat mehen veeno yodea al ezo mehen ba:
Asham taluy. lefi shebba al hassafek karuy asham taluy, shettole umagen alav min hayyissurim, veeno mechapper, sheim noda elav achar kach beverur shechata, mevi chattat kevua:
Hammetamme mikdash vekadashav. shennichnas lammikdash keshehu tame, o achal kadashim betuma:
Mippene shehu veole veyored. veen asham taluy ba ella al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat kevua, vehay hoil veshiggato beole veyored, en belo hoda shello asham taluy:

Af hamegaddef. en meviin al shiggato chattat, veal lo hoda shello nammi en chayyavim asham taluy. derachamana amar gabbe chattat, laose bishgaga, perat limgaddef sheen bo maase. vahalacha kachachamim:
Veachat yotza zanav. kegon shelosha gefanim netuot beshura achat, ushetayim beshura sheniyya keneged shetayim min hashshalosh:
Veachat bentayim. shehashshetayim keneged shetayim vehachamishshit keneged aviran:
Veachat baemtza. kegon gefen hannetua vearba gefanim learba ruchoteha:
Neka. bekaim shebbassadot keen gummot:
Notnim lah avodatah. shishsha tefachim shezzo hi avodat gefen yechidit:
Vezorea et hammotar. velo amrinan demechaze kechilayim, kevan shehaggefen vehazzeraim betoch haggat o vetoch hanneka:
Im en sham arba ammot asur. kedin mechol hakkerem defirkin dilel denoten arba ammot laavodat hakkerem. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Vehabbayit shebbakkerem. shessevivot habbayit yesh gefanim:
Zorim betocho. velo amrinan hoil vehaggefanim makkifim oto mearba ruchotav en hammechitztzot moilot:
Muttar berotev uvakkippa. rotev hannikpe beshule hakkedera nikra kippa:
Rabbi yehuda oser. hoil veyesh bo taam basar. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ematay bizman sheamar basar ze alay. dechevan sheamar basar ze, shavveye aleh chaticha deissura veasur betaamo. aval im amar konam basar alay, lo asar atzmo ella bedavar hannikra basar:
Happerach hayyotze. milleshon hafarcha haggefen (Shir HaShirim 6), kelomar ma sheggadal min haggefen yotze uvolet chutz learis:

Metuttelet. hu habbarzel shehabbonim moridim bachevel lematta al pene hachoma lirot bo et habbinyan [im] hachoma yeshara, uvo meshaarim im hazzeraim mechuvvanim tachat happerach. vehacha mayre kegon sheggadlu zemorot hearis yoter meavodato ufarach lachutz, divtoch avodato afillu en sham perach asur:
Vechen bedalit. vechen meshaarin begefen yechidit hammudlet al gabbe kelunesot sheenah aris im parcha chutz leshishsha tefachim shehem avodatah:
Tachteha asur. tachat hazzemora, aval min hatztzedadim mikkan umikkan muttar:

Sippekah bechevel. shello hayta hazzemora arukka shettaggia meilan leilan vekashar beroshah chevel o gemi lehaarich otah kede shettaspik ad hailan, tachat hazzemora asur, tachat hassippuk muttar. aval im asa hassippuk kede sheyyehallech alav hechadash, asur lizroa tachtav:
Tachat zo chalifat zo temurat zo. kullan leshon temura hen:
Mechullelet. leshon chillul hu. velo amar kelum, sheen behemat kodesh temima yotza lechullin:

Veim haya hekdesh baal mum yetze lechullin. af al pi sheeno shave kemo hahekdesh baal mum. didvar tora afillu hekdesh shave mea mane shechillelo al shave peruta, mechullal. veaf al pi sheyyatza lechullin min hattora, tzarich laasot damim midderabbanan, kelomar, lehashelim haddamim shello yitanne hahekdesh. aval min hattora en onaa lehekdesh, dichtiv (Vayikra 25) al tonu ish et achiv, achiv velo hekdesh:
Sheat nehenet li ad happesach im holechet at levet avich ad hechag. mi shehaya omed achar hechag veasar hanaato aleha ad happesach im telech levet aviha ad hechag:
Leachar happesach belo yachel devaro. kelomar, im halcha leachar happesach, overet beval yachel lemafrea al ma shennehenet mimmennu kodem happesach:
Veachar kach nimtzet harishona tamut. dahave chattat shennitkapperu bealeha beacheret:
Yelchu leyam hammelach. kol hecha dei haveya chattat haveya meta, maot nammi azle leyam hammelach:
Hakkanim hayyotzim min hearis. shebboltin chutz leseder hearis:
Vechas alehen lefaskan. shello hinnichan sham mechamat sheddato lehadelot alehen haggefen ella mippene shechas alehen bilvad:
Kenegdan muttar. lefi sheenan chashuvim min haappifyarot, hilkach muttar lizroa tachtehen:
Kede sheyyehallech alehen hechadash. sheyyadle al gabban sarige haggefen kesheyyitzmechu veyagdilu:
Hannotea shete shurot. shel shete shete gefanim, veen bahen achat yotza zanav:

Im en benehem shemone ammot lo yavi zera lesham. demitztarfin lihyot kerem, aval rechokim shemone chutz mimmekom haggefanim en mitztarfim vahare hen kegefen yechidit, umarchik shishsha tefachim mishshura zo veshishsha tefachim mishshura zo vezorea shesh ammot shebbaemtza:

Ben shura lachavertah shesh esre amma. dechevan deikka shalosh shurot havu kecherem gadol, vehammakom shebben kol shete shurot mehen niddon kedin karachat hakkerem shehu shesh esre amma. aval charva hashshura haemtzait, ledivre tanna kamma lo vainan benehem shiur karcha kevan delo nishtayyer kerem, velo dame lecherem ben arba vechamesh shurot dechi charva haemtzait akkatti nishar kerem, hilkach bae hammakom hammukrach shesh esre amma:
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer afillu charva hashshura haemtzait. meachar shehaya kevar kerem af atta din kerem yesh lo vetzarich shesh esre amma:

Sheillu mittechilla netaan. kelomar sheim lo higgiu leolam lichlal kerem velo haya notan mittechilla ella shete shurot lo haya tzarich lihyot benehen ella shemone ammot kidamrinan leel, achshav shennetaan shalosh vehiggiu lichlal kerem af al pi shecharva emtzait velo nisharu ella shetayim hare hen kecherem shecharav beemtzaito vetzarich shesh esre amma. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

Echad natal asara telaim veechad natal tisha. telaim: vachelev. keneged haasara telaim shennatal chavero. haasara telaim shekkeneged hattisha vachelev, kullam asurim mishshum mechir kelev. vehattisha sheim hakkelev muttarim. uvaggemara parech, ammay shekkeneged hakkelev kullam asurim, neppok chad lahade kalba vehanach kullehu lishteru. umeshane, hacha bemay askinan, kegon ditfe deme kelev mechad minnayhu, sheen beotan shekkenegdo tale shave deme hakkelev, dehashta shayche deme hakkelev bechullehu. kegon sheotan shekkenegdan shavin kol echad dinar, dahave asara dinarin, veotan tisha sheimmo shavin kol echad dinar chaser maa, dehaynu tisha dinarim pachot tesha maot, vehakkelev shave dinar vetesha maot, nimtza beotan asara shekkeneged hattisha vachelev yesh bahen tisha, shebbechol echad mehen yesh bo maa mechir kelev, vehaasiri kullo mechir kelev:

Shenayim velo arbaa. shenehem dechatav kera palgina leh keillu katav shenayim hen. shenayim, ashmoinan davka etnan zona umechir kelev, velo arbaa etnan kelev umechir zona. vehen, mashma hen velo valdotehen:
Hareni alecha cherem. hanaati tihye asura alecha becherem shello tuchal lehanot mimmenni:
Hammuddar asur. af al pi shello ana amen. sheadam yachol leesor al chavero shello yehane mimmennu:
Hare at alay cherem. sheasar al atzmo kol hanaa shettavo lo mechavero, hannoder asur:

Bedavar shel ole vavel. kegon bor shel ole regalim shehayu olim mibbavel leeretz yisrael laregel, vehaya oto habbor beemtza hadderech veyadan shel kol yisrael shava bo, vahave kehefker, velo kedavar shehu shel shuttafim:

Aris shehu yotze min hakkotel mittoch hakkeren vechale. kegon chamesh gefanim hannetuot betzad gader, veen machazikot et kol haggader, ella shalosh berosh hakkeren mizze ushetayim berosh hakkeren hashsheni mizze, uveemtza hakkotel en sham gefanim ella bishne zaviyyot hakkotel omdot:
Notnim lo avodato. shishsha tefachim mikkan veshishsha tefachim mikkan, vezorea shear hakkotel, veaf al pi sheen orech hakkotel arba ammot:

Rabbi yose omer im en sham arba ammot vechulei. rabbi yose letaameh deasar befirkin dilel gabbe gat veneka im en sham arba ammot. vehacha ka mashma lan delo tema davka begat veneka shessetumim mearba ruchot hu dematzrich rabbi yose arba ammot, aval etzel kotel sheeno mukkaf mearba ruchot ema lo. vei ashmeinan beha, [hava amena] beha matzrich rabbi yose arba ammot mishshum deyesh kan [chamishsha] gefanim ben shene keranot shel kotel, aval gabbe gat veneka sheen sham ella gefen yechidit ema lo, tzericha. uleel katavnu deen halacha kerabbi yose:
Haomer. al veladah shel behema meubberet:

Veladah shel zo ola vehi shelamim devarav kayyamin. shehare kedushshat havvalad kadma. aval amar hi shelamim beresha, lah ulechol deit bah akdesha, vehave kemakdish shete behemot lishlamim, vechi hadar veamar veladah ola, have havvalad shelamim. vehacha lo shayyach lememar bahavayatan uvime imman, dechi amrinan bahavayatan velo vime imman, hane mille behikdishah ulevassof nitabbera, deihu lo atpeseh laubbar shum kedushsha, ella mikkedushshat immeh ka kaddish. aval bemakdish meubberet, chashiv ubbar lekabbole kedushsha. verabbi meir it leh tefos lashon rishon:
Im lechach nitkavven mittechilla. kesheamar hi shelamim lo nitkavven livladah:
Hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat. sheen happe yachol ledabber shene devarim keachat:
Devarav kayyamin. deaf bigmar devarav adam nitpas:

Nimlach veamar veladah ola. af al pi shechazar bo toch kede dibbur veamar veladah ola, lo amar kelum, hoil uveshaa shehikdish immo lishlamim lo nitkavven sheyyihye havvalad ola. mishshum dekayma lan kol toch kede dibbur kedibbur dame, chutz mimmakdish umemer umegaddef veoved avoda zara umekaddesh umegaresh, dehanach shishsha en hachazara moelet bahen af al pi shechazar bo toch kede dibbur. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Kol haasurim al gabbe hammizbeach. kegon behema shennirbea keshehi chullin veachar kach nitabbera veyalda, havvalad muttar lekarban, shehazzachar shel hetter shebba al behema zo vehi shehi asura, shenehen garmu lavvalad sheyyavo, veze veze gorem muttar. aval nirbea keshehi meubberet, havvalad pasul lekarban, dehi uveladah nirbeu:

Velad terefa. lo yikrav. aval lehedyot divre hakkol share, delav miggufah ka rabbi. ufelugta hi beellu terefot [daf noach], ikka leman deamar terefa yoledet, veikka leman deamar terefa enah yoledet. leman deamar terefa yoledet mashkachat la kegon shennitrefa ulevassof ibbera, uveha pelige, derabbi eliezer savar ze veze gorem asur, verabbanan savre ze veze gorem muttar. uleman deamar terefa enah yoledet mashkachat la kegon sheibbera ulevassof nitrefa, uveha pelige, derabbi eliezer savar ubbar yerech immo hu, verabbanan savre ubbar lav yerech immo hu. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa pesula. kol oto hayyom sheyyanka meet leet hi pesula lehakerava, hoil vichola laamod al oto chalav belo achila acheret, veeno mitakkel mimmeeha ad sheyyishlam meet leet. aval leachar shennitakkel mimmeeha mode rabbi chanina shehi keshera, daafillu behema shennitpattema becharshine avoda zara hakkol modim shehi keshera lammizbeach. veen halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos:
Sheen podim et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim. devifsule hammukdashim shennifdu ketiv tizbach veachalta basar, vedarshinan tizbach velo gizza, veachalta velo lichlavecha, basar velo chalav:
Hannoder min habbayit. shello yikkanes labbayit. muttar likkanes laaliyya, delav bichlal bayit hu:
Hannotea et karmo shesh esre amma. shekkol shura shel gefanim rechoka mechavertah shesh esre amma:
Muttar lehavi zera lesham. veen tzarich leharechik ella shishsha tefachim min hashshura, kaavodat gefen yechidit:
Tzalmon. shem makom:

Hofech sear shete shurot. kerem gadol haya, shekkol shura rechoka mechavertah shesh esre amma, velo haya rotze lesakkech gafno al gabbe tevuato, vehaya metzaref hashshurot shetayim shetayim, verashe haggefanim dehaynu hassear shel kol shetayim ushetayim hofech letzad echad ellu kelappe ellu, venishar hammakom panuy mitztzad ze umitztzad ze, vezorea, ella shemmanniach shishsha tefachim, uleshana acheret ose lehefech. shekkach haya darkam, makom shezzorim bo shana achat leshana acheret mannichim oto bur belo charisha uvelo zeria:

Af hannotea et karmo al shemone shemone ammot muttar. kasavre kevan dirchokot hashshurot shemone ammot hava leh kegefen yechidit, umanniach samuch lashshura shishsha tefachim vezorea et hashshear, velo vainan shesh esre amma ella becherem charev, aval benotea meikkara ki marcheke shemone ammot dayyo. vechen halacha:
Bet shammay omrim kerem. vetzarich leharechik mimmenna arba ammot kede avodat hakkerem:
Eno cherem ad sheyyihyu shete shurot. veen tzarich leharechik ella shishsha tefachim kegefen yechidit:
Hazzorea arba ammot. kelomar betoch arba ammot shel avodat hakkerem:
Bet shammay omrim kiddash shura achat. dechi amra tora (Devarim 22) pen tikdash hammelea hazzera asher tizra utevuat hakkarem, shura achat mikkarya kerem:
Uvet hillel omrim kiddash shete shurot. deen nikra kerem pachot mishshete shurot, hilkach utevuat hakkerem deamra tora dekiddesha shete shurot mashma:
Hannoder min hamevushshal. sheamar konam mevushshal alay:
Muttar batztzali uvashshaluk. kol shennitbashshel yoter mibbishshulo harauy nikra shaluk:
Maase kedera rach. shenneechal im happat:
Ave. shenneechal belo pat:
Betzat teramita. mevushshelet bemayim chammim umeshammerim otah shello tikpe:
Uvidlaat harmutza. delaat shettomnim otah baremetz, hu efer cham, umitmattek bechach:
Sheloshim vashesh keretot. leover bemezid belo hateraa:
Habba al ishsha uvittah. uvat bittah uvat benah bichlal. vechen bitto uvat bitto uvat beno, chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv, kullam bichlal ze:
Hamegaddef. mevarech et hashshem:
Vehaoved avoda zara. kederech avodatah. o hamezabbeach vehamekatter vehamenassech vehammishtachave afillu sheen derech avodatah bechach:
Baal ov. veyiddeoni bichlal. sheshshenehem belav echad neemru, vetanna nakat ov shehu rishon bammikra:
Vehamechallel et hashshabbat. beachat meavot melachot arbaim chaser achat vetoldotehen:
Notar. kadashim leachar sheavar zemannan:
Piggul. kadashim shechashav leachlan chutz lizmannan o chutz limkoman:
Hashshochet. kadashim bachutz chayyav, af al pi shello heelan. dichtiv (Vayikra 17) veel petach ohel moed lo hevio dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach venichrat:
Umaale. nammi becharet, dichtiv (sham) asher yaale ola o zavach veel petach ohel moed lo yeviennu. veim shachat veheela beshogeg, chayyav shete chattaot:
Vehamefattem et shemen hammishcha. bemishkal sammanim uvemiddat hashshemen kemo sheasao moshe bammidbar. vehu sheyyaasennu lasuch bo, aval hamefattemo lehitlammed o lemasro latztzibbur eno chayyav:

Vehamefattem et hakketoret. achad asar sammane hakketoret im lakach mikkol echad mehem kefi mishkalo hakkatzuv bedivre chachamim veervam kadderech shehayu mearvim hakketoret shemmaktirim bevet hammikdash, chayyav karet. vehu sheyyaasennu lehariach bah, aval asaah lehitlammed o lemasrah latztzibbur, patur:

Vehassach beshemen hammishcha. sheasa moshe, shello letzorech kehunna umalchut, chayyav. shello hayu notnim meoto shemen ella al rosh hakkohen gadol, vaafillu haya ben kohen gadol moshchim oto beoto shemen sheasa moshe bammidbar. umimmennu moshchim malche bet david. veen moshchin melech ben melech im lo haya sham machaloket, kemo shemmashchu shelomo mippene machlukto shel adoniyyahu, veyoash mippene machlukto shel atalyahu, vihoachaz mippene yehoyakim achiv shehaya gadol mimmennu. umeshichat hakkohanim hi sheyyotzkim min hashshemen al rosho umoshchin ben gabbot enav kemin 30 yevanit. umeshichat hammelachim kemin nezer:

Happesach vehammila bemitzvot ase. veyesh bahen karet, veen karban al shiggatan. aval kullehu hanach lo taase ninhu, vechayyavim al shiggatan karban, deen karban ella al lav. degabbe karban ketiv (Vayikra 4) veasa achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai‏ asher lo teasena:
Sitvaniyyot. anavim raim hannisharim baggefanim bimot hassetav, veenam reuyim leyayin veosim mehem chometz:
Kol sheshshem toladto keruya alav. veaf al pi shennishtanna nikra al shem ikkaro. kemo, devash temarim, chometz sitvaniyyot:

Vachachamim mattirin. ikka ben tanna kamma lachachamim, detanna kamma savar hannoder besitvaniyyot muttar bachometz hayyotze mehen veasur besitvaniyyot, vachachamim mattirin bassitvaniyyot atzman, dechevan desitvaniyyot lav bene achila ninhu, ki nadar missitvaniyyot dato al hachometz hayyotze mehen, lo al hassitvaniyyot atzman. vahalacha kachachamim. perush acher, vachachamim mattirin chometz hassitvaniyyot kemo devash temarim, disvira lehu lachachamim deven bidvarim haruyim laachila ben sheenan reuyin laachila haoser davar echad al atzmo muttar bayyotze mimmennu:

Mochrah veyavi vedameha acheret. demikki mecharah leacher, chashiva keillu enah baolam. aval kol zeman shehi tachat balah beshaa shennitkapper beacheret, tamut. verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar, kol zeman shehi baolam leachar shennitkapperu habbealim beacheret, ben shehi tachat balah ben beyad acherim, tamut. veen halacha kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon:
Konam maase yadayich alay. asar kol ma shehi osa umechina lo. veim nata ilan, giddulav asurin:
En meshannin otan mikkedushsha likdushsha. kadshe mizbeach lo yaase shelamim ola, velo ola shelamim, vechen hekdesh levedek hahechol en meshannin oto levedek hammizbeach, vechol kayyotze baze:
Umakdishin otan. akkadshe mizbeach kae:

Hekdesh illuy. kegon im amar al ola hare zo levedek habbayit, maalin otah bedamim lefi ma sheyyesh lo bah venoten laggizbar, keditnan baarachin, macharim adam et kadashav, im nadar noten demehen, veim nedava noten et tovatan. kelomar, im behema zo hayta neder kegon deamar hare alay ola vehifrish zo lenidro, kevan deim meta o nigneva chayyav beacharayutah, nimtzet kullah shello, venoten kol dameha lecherem lakkohen. vehu haddin nammi im hitpis levedek habbayit kadshe mizbeach. veim nedava, deamar hare zo ola, deim meta eno chayyav beacharayutah, nimtza sheen lo chelek bah ella tovat hanaa, derashshay littol davar muat kede sheyyitten ola zo leven bitto kohen, veotah tovat hanaa noten levedek habbayit:

Umacharimin otan. im hecherim kadshe mizbeach, noten lakkohen et hailluy kedifrishit. aval kadshe bedek habbayit shehitpisan ben lekadshe mizbeach ben lacharame kohanim, lo asa velo chelum, sheenan shello, veen adam makdish davar sheeno shello. kach katav rambam:
Veim metu. kadshe mizbeach, afillu leachar shehumemu, aval adayin lo nifdu:

Yikkavru. veeno yachol lifdotan ulehaachilan lichlavim. vaafillu leman deamar podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim, hane mille keshennitrefa, deefshar lah behaamada vehaaracha, aval mishshemmetu dei efshar lekayyem behu veheemid veheerich, en podin otan:
Rabbi shimon omer kadshe vedek habbayit im metu yippadu. kasavar rabbi shimon delo neemar veheemid veheerich ella bekadshe mizbeach velo bekadshe bedek habbayit. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kaflotot. min mimmine hakkartiyyim haggedelim beeretz yisrael:

Shehu shem levay. habba lomar yarkot sade tzarich lechabber shem layyarak velomar yarkot sade. vechen kullam. aval bashsheviit lefi sheen yarkot ginna metzuyin, sheen gedelin belo avoda, veochlim yarkot sade, lefichach yerakot setam bishviit havu yarkot sade. ma sheen ken bishar shene hashshavua:
Shelosha tefachim. dechol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame. vehu shiur kede sheyyikkanes haggedi:
Hare hu kimchitztza. umuttar lismoch gefanim mitztzad ze uzeraim mitztzad ze:
Niddon kefetach. vaafillu kenegdo muttar lismoch, aval yoter meeser lo chashiv kefetach vetzarich harechaka keneged hammakom happarutz:
Veim happarutz merubbe al haomed asur keneged happarutz. aval keneged haomed muttar im hu rachav arbaa, aval pachot mearbaa af keneged haomed asur:
Besak biria uvachamila. mine vegadim gassim veavim beyoter, veen bene adam regilim lehitkassot bahem:
Muttar begizze tzemer. shello nitkavven ella leveged tzemer:
Hakkol lefi hannoder. lefi sheat hanneder. kevan shennikkar shemmechamat koved massao nadar, muttar lehitkassot. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. im hechlifan lechattechilla asur hammachlif bidmehen, derabbanan gazru al deme issure hanaa. vegiddule konam asurim kegiddule hekdesh:
Sheeni ochel sheeni toem. lo asar alav ella achila uteima mehem bilvad:
Aval bedavar sheen zaro chale. kegon betzalim, vechayyotze bahen, afillu giddule giddulim have kemo guf haissur, kevan sheen hazzera kale:
En ze ella geder hakkerem. makom shebben gader lakkerem geder hakkerem hu karuy, vaafillu en sham ella shesh ammot marchik arba ammot vezorea et hammotar:

Veezehu mechol hakkerem. shetztzarich shetem esre ammot, makom shebben shene cheramim. vetanna kamma savar makom shebben shene cheramim kecherem shecharav beemtzao hu niddon. uvayrushalmi mochiach delo amar rabbi yehuda ezehu mechol hakkerem ben shene hakkeramim ella kegon sheen shurot hakkeramim shavot shel zo lazo, kegon decherem shel tzad ze shel machol shuroteha min hammizrach lammaarav veshebbetzad acher min hatztzafon laddarom, deim hayu mechuvvanim mode rabbi yehuda denire kekarachat hakkerem uvae shesh esre amma. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ezehu gader. hammafrish ben hakkerem sheyyachol lehanniach kerem mitztzad ze velizroa mitztzad acher, vechen charitz:
Kum. hu nasyove dachalava, mayim hayyotzim min haggevina:
Abba shaul omer kulei‏ ben melucha ben tefela. delo tema haggevina hameyuchedet shebbaggevina mashma veen derech leachlah belo melach. vahalacha keabba shaul:
Ispargos. min keruv hu, ella sheen keruv nikra beshem ispargos. perush acher, ispargos, hammayim sheshshalku bahem hakkeruv:
Min haggerisin asur bammikpa. sheaf al pi shehem netunim letoch hammikpa adayin shem gerisin alehem:
Verabbi yose mattir. dekasavar mikpa shel gerisin mikkeru, gerisin gereda lo mikkeru:
Mikpa. tavshil av shel kitnit o shel tzike kedera:
Hannoder min hammikpa asur beshum. regilim hayu latet shum bechol mikpa kede sheyyitten taam, vehashshum hu hammikpa:
Asur baashishin. pesolet shel adashim. veen halacha kerabbi yose bitlata bave dematnitin:
Chitta chittim sheeni toem. chitta mashma pat afuya, chittim mashma lachos:
Hannotea yarak bakkerem o mekayyem. sheroehu shetztzomeach veyannichehu:

Hare ze mekaddesh vechulei. kelal mishnatenu hu shelleolam mekaddesh shesh esre amma lechol ruach agullot. veaf al gav ditnan leel hazzorea arba ammot shel avodat hakkerem eno mekaddesh ella shete shurot, hecha dezorea ben haggefanim mekaddesh shesh esre keshiur kerem gadol demitztaref ad shesh esre. amnam eze kerem sheyyihye merubba sheloshim ushetayim ammot al sheloshim ushetayim ammot vehayyarak natua binkuddat emtzaito, keshenneaggel betocho iggul yihye hekkefo betzalot hamerubba veyihye alachsono sheloshim ushetayim ammot, yitkaddesh haiggul kullo shehu shesh esre amma lechol ruach min hayyarak. vehinne im haggefanim netuot

Al arba arba. perush sheyyesh ben kol shura veshura arba ammot, vehifrashnu mizze hakkerem merubba sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim, yihye hamerubba tesha shurot orech al tesha shurot rochav, veyippol mehen betoch haiggul shiva shurot orech al shiva shurot rochav uvechol shura shiva gefanim shehem arbaim vetisha gefanim, yatzu mehen arbaa bazzaviyyot chutz laiggul veyishshaaru betoch haiggul arbaim vechamesh gefanim, vezo tzuratah [tziyyur 12 besof hammassechet] [haggaha zohi hashshura haemtzait shealeha hiksha harosh zichrono livracha lamma lo teaser od gefen achat kan vechen achat kenegdah vechen bishne hatztzedadin haacherim]. vechatav harosh zichrono livracha kashe li ammay en neesarin od bechol shura seviv ellu hashsheva shurot haemtzaiyyot shebbashshura mearba ruchot [haggaha perush gefen echad lechol ruach], ki omdin betoch shesh esre amma shel gefen haemtzai, nimtza oser arbaim vetisha gefanim, veyesh lomar shearba ammot shebben gefen legefen hayenu belo ikkar haggefanim, nimtza sheim haggefanim yesh yoter mishshesh esre, ad kan. uchesheyyihye natua al

Chamishsha chamishsha. vechakaknu merubba mishsheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim, yippol betoch hamerubba sheva shurot orech al sheva shurot rochav, veyikkach amma mishshura sheminit mikkan veamma mishshura teshiit mikkan. vechen kav haiggul shealachsonah sheloshim ushetayim yotze chutz min hashsheva shurot amma lechol ruach, mippene shehashsheva shurot yesh benehem shishsha merchakim bechol merchak chamesh ammot, veanu tzerichin sheloshim ushetayim, veyihye merchak ben kav haagulla uven kav hashshura hassemucha lo chutz lamrubba arba ammot veze tzurato [tziyyur 13 besof hammassechet]. vehinne haggefanim hannichnasim baagulla sheloshim vesheva gefanim bilvad, vehinne kevan shello nishar ben alachson haagulla uven hashshura hassemucha lo mibbachutz ella arba ammot vehu shiur avodat hakkerem, lefi shehashshiur metzumtzam rainu keillu haagulla nimshecha ad shehiggia lashshurot hachitzonot shehaya benehem uven ketze haalachson arba ammot, venittosaf baalachsono arba ammot lechol ruach ad sheyyihye baiggul alachson shel arbaim al arbaim, dechevan sheanu roin haiggul shel sheloshim ushetayim keillu male yarak bechol makom, [vehaarba ammot hayeterot] maggia laavodat hakkerem hu, venimtzeu haggefanim kullam shehem besheva shurot al sheva shurot nichnasot betoch haiggul chutz mearba shebbearba hazzaviyyot, vehinne atta [haggaha perush achar sherainu keillu haagulla nimshecha] betoch haiggul arbaim vechamesh gefanim, veyihye tzuratah ketzurat harishona [haggaha mittoch haddevarim mashma ketzat shetztzarich haya laasot iggul betoch iggul happenimi, kaasher atta roe, vehachitzon maggia ad hatztzelaot chutz laarba ammot harmuzot baarba tzedade hatztzura, uvaze yihye haiggul hachitzon dome mammash latztzura harishona shel arba arba. ad kan]. ella shebbimkom arba hu chamesh, nimtza atta mekaddesh arbaim amma bechol ruach. vezehu ma shehitzricho lattanna lomar hare ze mekaddesh arbaim vechamesh gefanim, ki meachar shehashshoresh hakkadum hu shesh esre amma lechol ruach haya lo lekatztzer velomar hare ze mekaddesh shesh esre amma lechol ruach vechulei, uvema shekkatavnu metoratz, shei efshar lo lomar beal chamesh chamesh mekaddesh shesh esre amma lechol ruach, kevan shehu mekaddesh esrim lechol ruach, ulefichach amar mekaddesh arbaim vachamishsha gefanim, veze i efshar ella leachar shennosif [haggaha perush hayenu rainu keillu haagulla nimshecha sheamar berosh devarav] baagulla kemo shebbearnu. vehattaam shello amar bizman shehen netuot al chamesh chamesh mekaddesh esrim amma lechol ruach, mippene sheikkar hakkiddush hu shesh esre amma lechol ruach vearba ammot hu tosefet, huchrach lekarev haalachson lashshurot mittaam shekkatavnu [haggaha lefi shehen arba metzumtzamot]. veim tomar kevan shekkeshehem arbaa al arbaa mekaddesh shesh esre amma bilvad, lamma hifrisho hattanna mikkelal shesh esre amma lechol ruach devachaluka desefa denema hayu netuot al arba arba o al shesh shesh, vetzeref oto im keshehen netuot al chamesh chamesh. veyesh lomar deal arba vechamesh tzurotehen domot zo lazo, ki yippol betoch haiggul bechol achat mehen sheva shurot al sheva chutz mearba zaviyyot, vegam ken hen shavin beminyan haggefanim [haggaha perush otan shemmitkaddeshot en hefresh ella shebbearba al arba hem bedikduk uvechamesh al chamesh hem betosefet] veyoter tov hu lehodienu minyan haggefanim shemmekaddesh. aval keshehen netuot al shesh shesh o al sheva sheva en minyan haggefanim shemmekaddesh kesheyyihye al shesh shesh kefi minyanam kesheyyihye al sheva sheva kemo shennevaer, ulefichach lakach bahen ikkar shekkolel hakkol veamar mekaddesh shesh esre amma:

Hayu netuot al shesh vechulei. vehifrashnu min hakkerem agulla shealachsonah sheloshim ushetayim ammot, yotze kav haagulla mikkol shura hachitzona amma achat, uminyan haggefanim shebbetoch haagulla arbaa veesrim, veze tzuratah [tziyyur 14 besof hammassechet]. [haggaha betzura shel sheva sheva bimkom haalef taase bet uvimkom chamishsha avirin shelemim sheatta roa tetzayyer arbaa avirin]. velo mashachnu haalachson [haggaha perush lo rainu keillu nimshechu kaasher amarnu beal chamesh chamesh] ad sheyyaggia bearba shurot hachitzonot sheetzel haiggul kemo sheasinu bechamesh al chamesh, mippene shennishar ben ketze haalachson uven shura hassemucha lo chamesh ammot, vaafillu nire keillu haagulla melea yarak yishshaer benah uven hashshurot hachitzoniyyot yoter mimma shetztzarich laavodat hakkerem betosefet amma, veal karchacha lo hosafnu berochav haagulla kelum. veim yihye natua

Al sheva sheva. venafrish min hakkerem agulla shealachsonah sheloshim ushetayim ammot, yippelu betoch haagulla chamesh shurot orech [haggaha perush hechamesh shurot yesh lahem arbaa avirim shel sheva al sheva shehem esrim ushemone ammot, ushetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan hem sheloshim ushetayim ammot] al chamesh rochav chutz mearba zaviyyotav, veyotze haalachson mitztzalot hamerubba sheyyesh bo chamesh al chamesh shete ammot lechol ruach, nishar ben ketze haalachson uven shura hachitzona hassemucha lah chamesh ammot, umippene ze lo mashachnu [haggaha perush rotze lomar lo rainu keillu nimshecha] haalachson lashshurot hachitzonot, uminyan haggefanim hannimtzaim kol echad vetzuratah kemo hatztzura hakkodemet beshinnuy shiva bimkom shishsha vechulei. zehu ma shepperesh harambam zichrono livracha al mishna zo bekitztzur devarav kol haefshari. ulefi sheraiti echad mehachachamim hakkadmonim shekkatav al ze happerush hen hen haddevarim shenneemru lemoshe vegam ken harosh zichrono livracha hiskim leze happerush vedacha perush harav rabbi shimshon zichrono livracha, lo huzkakti lichtov perush harav rabbi shimshon zichrono livracha al mishna zo:

Yalda shene zecharim. bevehemat chullin mayre. dei bevehemat kadashim, hiach deikdisha ola leheve ola, veidach kae bikdushshatah deimmeh. ella vadday bevehemat chullin, ulefichach hay delo kaddish damav chullin. umihu al shenehem chala kedushshat ola, deha amar im zachar ola, umishshum deihu lo nadar ella chada, hilkach yikrav haechad lenidro vehashsheni yimmacher letzarche ola vedamav chullin:

En kedushsha chala alehen. devaldot kadashim bahavayatan hen kedoshim velo mimmee imman, vechevan dehanach bitziatan min harechem enan reuyin lehakerava, lo kaddeshe. vachachamim pelige al rabban shimon ben gamliel vesavre devaldot kadashim bikdushshat imman kayme. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
